introduction:
Introduction About ACNETOIN I 20MG CAPSULE

ACNETOIN I 20MG CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take ACNETOIN I 20MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

ACNETOIN I 20MG CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.
uses: Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
usesDetails:
Uses Of ACNETOIN I 20MG CAPSULE
Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of ACNETOIN I 20MG CAPSULE for Acne:

ACNETOIN I 20MG CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How ACNETOIN I 20MG CAPSULE Works

ACNETOIN I 20MG CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

Swallow the capsule whole with a glass of water; do not crush or chew it.

What if I Forget to take ACNETOIN I 20MG CAPSULE:

If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose—do not double the dose to make up for it.

Overdosage of ACNETOIN I 20MG CAPSULE –

In case you or anybody else accidently take too much of ACNETOIN I 20MG CAPSULE, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of ACNETOIN I 20MG CAPSULE overdose are severe headache, abdominal pain, nausea, dizziness, redness of face, vomiting, somnolence, irritability, and itching.

warningsRaw:
Warning & Precautions
Pregnancy
CONTRAINDICATED
Human and animal studies have shown that isotretinoin is teratogenic in nature. Birth defects such as abnormalities of the face, eyes, ears, skull, central nervous system, cardiovascular system, and thymus and parathyroid glands or IQ less than score of 85 have been reported in female patients who were pregnant or became pregnant while on therapy with isotretinoin. Therefore, ACNETOIN I 20MG CAPSULE is considered unsafe for use during pregnancy.
Women of childbearing potential must use a reliable contraceptive method to avoid becoming pregnant. If you accidentally became pregnant while taking this medicine, stop taking it and consult your gynaecologist for further evaluation.
It is also not recommended for you to get pregnant for one month after stopping isotretinoin tablets because some medicine may still be left in your body. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Breastfeeding
CONTRAINDICATED

It is not known whether this medicine is excreted in human milk. Because of the potential for adverse effects, nursing mothers should not receive ACNETOIN I 20MG CAPSULE

Driving and Using Machines

introduction:
Introduction About CLINSOL GEL

CLINSOL GEL is a combination of Clindamycin and Nicotinamide which belongs to a group of medicines called Lincomycin antibiotics and Vitamin B3 complex, respectively. CLINSOL GEL is used to manage mild to moderate acne which is a skin condition that occurs when hair follicles become plugged with oil and dead skin cells which may occur due to variety of causes such as genetics, fluctuating hormone levels, stress, high humidity or using oily or greasy personal care products which may affect people of all ages.

It is characterized by symptoms such as open or closed plugged pores, small red & tender bumps, pimples, large, solid or painful lumps under the skin and painful & pus-filled lumps under the skin.

Before using CLINSOL GEL inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, lung or heart diseases. Avoid applying CLINSOL GEL to a cut, scrapped, sunburnt or eczema affected skin.

CLINSOL GEL should be used with caution in pregnant and in breastfeeding women. CLINSOL GEL is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 12 years). Consult your doctor before applying.

The most common side effects of using CLINSOL GEL are skin inflammation, contact dermatitis (red, itchy rash), inflammation of hair follicles, itchy skin, dry skin and peeling of skin. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage mild to moderate acne
usesDetails:
Uses Of CLINSOL GEL
Manage mild to moderate acne
mechanismOfAction:
How CLINSOL GEL Works

CLINSOL GEL helps to manage acne, where Clindamycin reduces free fatty acid concentrations on the skin and suppresses the growth of Propionibacterium acnes (Corynebacterium acnes), a bacteria found in sebaceous glands and follicles and Nicotinamide exerts anti-inflammatory effect in acne and interrupts sebum production.
usageDetails:
How to use CLINSOL GEL

Apply CLINSOL GEL as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Before applying the medicine normally wash and dry the affected area and apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area. Managed areas on the face need not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Do not apply this medicine beyond the recommended duration. Avoid applying CLINSOL GEL around your eyes, including eyelids. Rinse it off with water if you accidentally get it in these areas.

name: MELACARE Cream 25gm
introduction:
Introduction About MELACARE CREAM

MELACARE CREAM is a combination of Hydroquinone, Tretinoin, Mometasone furoate which belongs to the group of medicines called Depigmenting agents, Retinoids and Corticosteroids respectively. It is used in adults for the management of moderate to severe melasma (dark spots on the skin) in association with sun-avoidance measures, like using sunscreens and wearing protective clothing. Melasma is one of the most frequently acquired hyperpigmentation (excess melanin production) disorders with symptoms such as symmetrical brown patches on sun exposed areas mainly on face.

It is advised to avoid exposure to sun during management with MELACARE CREAM for better results. While going out apply sunscreens and wear full covering protective clothes. Before using MELACARE CREAM inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung or heart diseases.

Safety and efficacy of MELACARE CREAM is not established in pregnant women and in children below 12 years of age. Ask for your doctor’s advice before using. MELACARE CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of using MELACARE CREAM are mild burning, stinging, redness and dryness. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.
uses: Manages moderate to severe melasma (dark spots on the skin)
usesDetails:
Uses Of MELACARE CREAM

It is used in adults to

Manages moderate to severe melasma (dark spots on the skin)
mechanismOfAction:
How MELACARE CREAM Works

MELACARE CREAM helps in managing melasma where Hydroquinone is a skin bleaching agent that blocks enzyme tyrosinase which is responsible for the production of melanin that cause pigmentation. Thus, it helps for fading of dark spots in skin. Tretinoin helps to recover the damage to the skin caused by sun exposure (photodamage) by thickening skin layer and loss of keratinized cells.it helps to rejuvenate the skin. Mometasone furoate blocks prostaglandin synthesis and reduces redness, swelling and itching caused by tretinoin and other skin infections.
usageDetails:
How to use MELACARE CREAM

Apply MELACARE CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before and after applying MELACARE CREAM. Wash your face with a mild soap and dry properly. Apply MELACARE CREAM at night and gently massage it in until it is absorbed. Avoid contact with your eyes, nose, mouth, mucous membrane. Avoid exposure to sunlight while using this medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ACNOVATE GEL

ACNOVATE GEL is a combination of Adapalene, Clindamycin and Zinc acetate which belongs to a group of medicines known as Retinoids, Antibiotics, and Minerals. It is indicated to manage acne vulgaris.

Acne vulgaris is a long-term skin condition that occurs when hair follicles plug with oil and dead skin cells which may be triggered by bacteria. It is characterised by uninflamed blackheads to pus-filled pimples or large, red and tender bumps.

Before using ACNOVATE GEL, inform your doctor if you have areas of cuts, scrapes or sunburned skin or if you have a skin condition called eczema, diarrhoea and inflammatory bowel disease.

ACNOVATE GEL is not recommended for use during pregnancy. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding woman as it is excreted in breastmilk and may pass to the baby consult your doctor for advice.

ACNOVATE GEL is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 12 years of age. Consult with your physician.

mechanismOfAction:
How ACNOVATE GEL Works

ACNOVATE GEL is a combination of adapalene, clindamycin and zinc acetate which manages pimples (acne). Adapalene is a form of vitamin A which manages accumulation of the sebum (skin’s natural oil), unblocks the pores and allows natural exfoliation of the outer layers of skin. Clindamycin belongs to antibiotic which works by penetrating into the skin and works against acne-causing bacteria. Zinc acetate reduces the sebum production, inhibits the neutrophils and TNF production (substances responsible for inflammation), increases the tissue healing capacity and it also supress the bacterial growth.

introduction:
Introduction About ADAFERIN GEL

Adaferin Gel is used in the management of acne, skin soreness, itching, blackheads, acne scars, spots and pimples. It contains a medicine called Adapalene which reduces oil production in the skin and increases the peeling of dead skin cells (skin turnover) which unclogs clogged pores, reduces acne breakouts and soothes irritated skin.

Apply Adaferin 0.1 gel as directed by your dermatologist. Wash your hands before and after application. Always use a sunscreen recommended by your dermatologist while getting exposed to sun as a precaution.

Before using this gel, inform your doctor if you are using any other medicines or products for treating acne, or have any skin cuts, scrapes or other skin inflammatory conditions. Do not use this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor.

Adaferin gel might cause mild skin irritation and sun sensitivity. They are usually mild and gets adjusted to your skin faster.

mechanismOfAction:
How ADAFERIN GEL Works

Adapalene works by binding to specific receptors in the skin, called retinoic acid receptors (RARs), which regulate cell growth and differentiation. This helps to speed up the turnover of skin cells, preventing the clogging of pores that leads to acne. Additionally, adapalene has anti-inflammatory effects, reducing redness and swelling associated with acne.

Wait a few minutes: Allow your skin to completely dry (about 10-15 minutes) to prevent irritation.
Apply a pea-sized amount: Squeeze a small pea-sized amount of adapalene gel onto your fingertip.
Spread it thinly: Gently apply the gel in a thin layer to the affected areas of your face, avoiding the eyes, lips, and inside the nose.
Wash your hands: After applying, wash your hands to remove any remaining product.
Use once daily: Apply adapalene at night, as directed by your doctor, typically once daily.

moreInfo:
More Information

Acne is a common skin condition that occurs when hair follicles become clogged with oil (sebum) and dead skin cells. This leads to the formation of pimples, blackheads, whiteheads, and sometimes cysts or nodules. Acne typically appears on the face, neck, chest, back, and shoulders, and it can be triggered by factors such as hormones, excess oil production, bacteria, and inflammation. It is most common in teenagers but can affect people of all ages.

faqs.answer: A: Apply this medicine as advised by your physician. It is best applied at night and washed off in the morning since it is sensitive to sunlight. Consult your doctor for further queries.

faqs.question: Q: Can ADAFERIN GEL cause skin irritation?
faqs.answer: A: This medicine may cause a slight sensation of warmth and stinging after applying it for the initial 2-4 weeks. However, during long-term usage, this side effect usually disappears. Consult your doctor in case of any queries.

faqs.question: Q: Can ADAFERIN GEL be used daily?
faqs.answer: A: In many cases, ADAFERIN GEL products are initially used once daily in the evening. However, some individuals may be advised to start with less frequent applications to allow the skin to adjust and then gradually increase the frequency.

faqs.question: Q: Are there any natural remedies to cure back Acne?
faqs.answer: A: Yes, some natural remedies may help in managing acne, though their effectiveness varies from person to person. While these remedies can help with mild acne, its important to consult a dermatologist for more severe cases.

faqs.question: Q: Can ADAFERIN GEL make skin darker?
faqs.answer: A: ADAFERIN GEL doesn’t make skin darker. Instead, it can slightly make the skin lighter by healing acne, pimples, blackheads, and spots. Consult your doctor for further queries.

faqs.question: Q: Can I go in sun after applying ADAFERIN GEL?
faqs.answer: A: Yes. You can go in sun after using this gel. But, make sure you apply a sunscreen and carry an umbrella, as this gel may slightly increase your skin's sensitivity to sun light.

faqs.question: Q: Can we cure acne scars completely?
faqs.answer: A: Yes. Completely curing acne scars is difficult, but they can be significantly improved with various treatments. While some treatments may fade or reduce the appearance of scars, completely eliminating them may not always be possible. Here are some natural ways to cure acne scars.

faqs.question: Q: Can ADAFERIN GEL be applied under makeup or moisturizers?
faqs.answer: A: Yes, ADAFERIN GEL can be applied under makeup or moisturizers once it has been fully absorbed into the skin. It's important to allow the gel to dry completely before applying any other skincare products to avoid potential interactions or reduced effectiveness.

faqs.question: Q: Can ADAFERIN GEL be used for acne scars?
faqs.answer: A: ADAFERIN GEL is primarily indicated for the management of acne scars and may help improve the appearance of post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation (dark spots) caused by acne. However, it may have limited efficacy in managing deeper acne scars or pitted scars. Consult your healthcare provider for more information.

faqs.question: Q: Can ADAFERIN GEL be used during pregnancy?
faqs.answer: A: Adaferin Gel is not recommended for use if you are pregnant or are planning to be pregnant. If you become pregnant while using this medicine, discontinue use and consult your doctor immediately.

Introduction About FACECLIN GEL

FACECLIN GEL is a combination of Clindamycin and Nicotinamide which belongs to a group of medicines called Lincomycin antibiotics and Vitamin B3 complex, respectively. FACECLIN GEL is used to manage mild to moderate acne which is a skin condition that occurs when hair follicles become plugged with oil and dead skin cells which may occur due to variety of causes such as genetics, fluctuating hormone levels, stress, high humidity or using oily or greasy personal care products which may affect people of all ages.

It is characterized by symptoms such as open or closed plugged pores, small red & tender bumps, pimples, large, solid or painful lumps under the skin and painful & pus-filled lumps under the skin.

Before using FACECLIN GEL inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, lung or heart diseases. Avoid applying FACECLIN GEL to a cut, scrapped, sunburnt or eczema affected skin.

FACECLIN GEL should be used with caution in pregnant and in breastfeeding women. FACECLIN GEL is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 12 years). Consult your doctor before applying.

The most common side effects of using FACECLIN GEL are skin inflammation, contact dermatitis (red, itchy rash), inflammation of hair follicles, itchy skin, dry skin and peeling of skin. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

Introduction About SOTRET 10MG CAPSULE

SOTRET 10MG CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take SOTRET 10MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

SOTRET 10MG CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.
uses: Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
usesDetails:
Uses Of SOTRET 10MG CAPSULE
Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of SOTRET 10MG CAPSULE for Acne:

SOTRET 10MG CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How SOTRET 10MG CAPSULE Works

SOTRET 10MG CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

introduction:
Introduction About COSMELITE CREAM

COSMELITE CREAM is a combination of Hydroquinone, Tretinoin, Mometasone furoate which belongs to the group of medicines called Depigmenting agents, Retinoids and Corticosteroids respectively. It is used in adults for the management of moderate to severe melasma (dark spots on the skin) in association with sun-avoidance measures, like using sunscreens and wearing protective clothing. Melasma is one of the most frequently acquired hyperpigmentation (excess melanin production) disorders with symptoms such as symmetrical brown patches on sun exposed areas mainly on face.

It is advised to avoid exposure to sun during management with COSMELITE CREAM for better results. While going out apply sunscreens and wear full covering protective clothes. Before using COSMELITE CREAM inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung or heart diseases.

Safety and efficacy of COSMELITE CREAM is not established in pregnant women and in children below 12 years of age. Ask for your doctor’s advice before using. COSMELITE CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of using COSMELITE CREAM are mild burning, stinging, redness and dryness. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.

mechanismOfAction:
How COSMELITE CREAM Works

COSMELITE CREAM helps in managing melasma where Hydroquinone is a skin bleaching agent that blocks enzyme tyrosinase which is responsible for the production of melanin that cause pigmentation. Thus, it helps for fading of dark spots in skin. Tretinoin helps to recover the damage to the skin caused by sun exposure (photodamage) by thickening skin layer and loss of keratinized cells.it helps to rejuvenate the skin. Mometasone furoate blocks prostaglandin synthesis and reduces redness, swelling and itching caused by tretinoin and other skin infections.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

faqs.question: Q: Do I need to take any precaution while using COSMELITE CREAM?
faqs.answer: A: It is advised to reduce exposure to sun during management with COSMELITE CREAM for better results. While going out apply sunscreens and wear full covering protective clothes. Exposure to sunlight or ultra-violet light will cause repigmentation of lightened skin. Do not apply COSMELITE CREAM to broken skin.

faqs.question: Q: What is the best time to use COSMELITE CREAM?
faqs.answer: A: It is advised to use COSMELITE CREAM before bedtime. This will reduce the chances of exposure of the managed skin to sun. However, ask for your doctor’s advice before using.

introduction:
Introduction About TRETIVA 20MG CAPSULE

TRETIVA 20MG CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take TRETIVA 20MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

TRETIVA 20MG CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.
uses: Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRETIVA 20MG CAPSULE
Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of TRETIVA 20MG CAPSULE for Acne:

TRETIVA 20MG CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How TRETIVA 20MG CAPSULE Works

TRETIVA 20MG CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.
usageInstructions: Take TRETIVA 20MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor.
Swallow the capsule whole with a glass of water; do not crush or chew it.
It is recommended to take the capsule with food to improve absorption and reduce stomach discomfort.
Take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels of the medication in your body.
Follow the prescribed dosage and duration carefully. Do not stop the medication abruptly without consulting your doctor, even if your symptoms improve.
Regular follow-ups and blood tests may be required to monitor your progress and ensure safe usage.
Avoid alcohol, excessive sun exposure, and waxing or laser treatments during the treatment period. Use sunscreen and moisturizers as recommended by your doctor.

What if I Forget to take TRETIVA 20MG CAPSULE:

If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose—do not double the dose to make up for it.

Overdosage of TRETIVA 20MG CAPSULE –

In case you or anybody else accidently take too much of TRETIVA 20MG CAPSULE, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of TRETIVA 20MG CAPSULE overdose are severe headache, abdominal pain, nausea, dizziness, redness of face, vomiting, somnolence, irritability, and itching.

Warning & Precautions
Pregnancy
CONTRAINDICATED
Human and animal studies have shown that isotretinoin is teratogenic in nature. Birth defects such as abnormalities of the face, eyes, ears, skull, central nervous system, cardiovascular system, and thymus and parathyroid glands or IQ less than score of 85 have been reported in female patients who were pregnant or became pregnant while on therapy with isotretinoin. Therefore, TRETIVA 20MG CAPSULE is considered unsafe for use during pregnancy.
Women of childbearing potential must use a reliable contraceptive method to avoid becoming pregnant. If you accidentally became pregnant while taking this medicine, stop taking it and consult your gynaecologist for further evaluation.
It is also not recommended for you to get pregnant for one month after stopping isotretinoin tablets because some medicine may still be left in your body. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About SEBONAC GEL

SEBONAC GEL contains Salicylic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Keratolytic agents. SEBONAC GEL is used manage skin conditions such as acne, blemishes (discolored spot-on skin), skin redness, and other skin diseases.

It is also used to manage dandruff, corn & calluses (thickened layers of skin) in affected individuals.

SEBONAC GEL is not recommended for use in patients allergic to salicylic acid. It is also not recommended for use in patients with active inflammation/dermatitis, infection (at the application site), acute viral infection, skin malignancy, and/or tanned skin.

Before applying SEBONAC GEL, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for surgery, and/or suffering from any kidney problems.

SEBONAC GEL is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women. It is considered to be safe to be used in breastfeeding women. Avoid applying the medicine on skin areas which might come in direct contact with infant’s skin.

SEBONAC GEL should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 1-15 years). It is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before applying the medicine.

The most common side effects of applying SEBONAC GEL are erythema (skin redness), and/or dryness of skin. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How ACUTRET 10MG CAPSULE Works

ACUTRET 10MG CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose—do not double the dose to make up for it.

CONTRAINDICATED
Human and animal studies have shown that isotretinoin is teratogenic in nature. Birth defects such as abnormalities of the face, eyes, ears, skull, central nervous system, cardiovascular system, and thymus and parathyroid glands or IQ less than score of 85 have been reported in female patients who were pregnant or became pregnant while on therapy with isotretinoin. Therefore, ACUTRET 10MG CAPSULE is considered unsafe for use during pregnancy.
Women of childbearing potential must use a reliable contraceptive method to avoid becoming pregnant. If you accidentally became pregnant while taking this medicine, stop taking it and consult your gynaecologist for further evaluation.
It is also not recommended for you to get pregnant for one month after stopping isotretinoin tablets because some medicine may still be left in your body. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About MICROBENZ 0.035 GEL(TOPICAL)

MICROBENZ 0.035 GEL(TOPICAL) contains Benzoyl peroxide which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-bacterial and Anti-inflammatory agents. It is used in the management of acne (pimples) in the face, chest and back. It is also used to unplug the blocked pores (blackheads and whiteheads) and absorb excess oil from the skin.

Before using MICROBENZ 0.035 GEL(TOPICAL), inform your doctor if you are having any allergy to foods, preservatives or dyes or if you are already under any medication for acne.

It is not recommended to use hard cleansers, scrubs, medicated soap or cosmetic products containing alcohol while using this medicine.

MICROBENZ 0.035 GEL(TOPICAL) is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless clearly needed. Consult your doctor before using the medicine.

Avoid repeated exposure to sunlight or other sources of UV light (such as sun bed). In case of accidental contact, rinse thoroughly with warm water and pat dry.

Most common side effects of MICROBENZ 0.035 GEL(TOPICAL) are skin redness and irriation, burning, stinging sensation in the skin. Consult your doctor if any of above symptoms worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How MICROBENZ 0.035 GEL(TOPICAL) Works

MICROBENZ 0.035 GEL(TOPICAL) works against the acne-causing bacteria. This medicine after applying on the affected skin gets absorbed and is converted to benzoic acid. This benzoic acid gets metabolized by skin proteins and releases active free-radical oxygen species that results in the alteration of bacterial proteins. This helps to manage acne or pimples. MICROBENZ 0.035 GEL(TOPICAL) also acts as a keratolytic agent which promotes peeling of the skin and absorb excess oil from the skin further managing acne formation and skin irritation.

Always apply MICROBENZ 0.035 GEL(TOPICAL) as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area as instructed by the doctor.

Avoid contact with eyes, lips, mouth, nose, mucous membranes and sensitive areas of the neck. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending you’re your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About EZANIC 10% CREAM

EZANIC 10% CREAM contains Azelaic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Dicarboxylic acids. It is used to manage common acne (acne vulgaris). It is also used for the management of mild to moderate papulopustular rosacea.

Acne is a skin condition that occurs when the hair follicles become plugged with oil and dead skin cells. It causes whiteheads, blackheads or pimples. Rosacea is a skin condition that causes blushing or redness, pus-filled bumps and small visible blood vessels in the face.

EZANIC 10% CREAM should be applied with caution in patients with lung problems such as asthma. Consult your doctor before applying it.

Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before applying this medicine. Your doctor will decide whether you can use this medicine.

EZANIC 10% CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children under 12 years of age for the management of acne and also not recommended for use in children under 18 years of age for the management of rosacea. Consult your doctor before applying it.

The most common side effects of applying EZANIC 10% CREAM are burning, itching or redness of the skin (erythema) at the application site, scaling, pain, dryness, skin discolouration or irritation at the application site. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How EZANIC 10% CREAM Works

EZANIC 10% CREAM attacks the bacteria called propionibacterium acnes, which plays an essential part in causing acne. It also reduces growth of the harder outermost skin cells (keratin surface cells) that block the pores of the skin to cause blackheads and whiteheads.
usageDetails:
How to use EZANIC 10% CREAM

Apply EZANIC 10% CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water before and after using EZANIC 10% CREAM. Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area and rub it gently into the skin.

Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, mouth and other mucous membranes or open wounds. If it does, wash the eyes, mouth or other mucous membranes immediately with large amounts of cool water.

name: ISOTROIN 10 Capsule 15's
introduction:
Introduction About ISOTROIN 10 CAPSULE

ISOTROIN 10 CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take ISOTROIN 10 CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

ISOTROIN 10 CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.
uses: Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
usesDetails:
Uses Of ISOTROIN 10 CAPSULE
Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of ISOTROIN 10 CAPSULE for Acne:

ISOTROIN 10 CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How ISOTROIN 10 CAPSULE Works

ISOTROIN 10 CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

Follow the prescribed dosage and duration carefully. Do not stop the medication abruptly without consulting your doctor, even if your symptoms improve.
Regular follow-ups and blood tests may be required to monitor your progress and ensure safe usage.
Avoid alcohol, excessive sun exposure, and waxing or laser treatments during the treatment period. Use sunscreen and moisturizers as recommended by your doctor.

Follow the prescribed dosage and duration carefully. Do not stop the medication abruptly without consulting your doctor, even if your symptoms improve.
Regular follow-ups and blood tests may be required to monitor your progress and ensure safe usage.
Avoid alcohol, excessive sun exposure, and waxing or laser treatments during the treatment period. Use sunscreen and moisturizers as recommended by your doctor.
What if I Forget to take ISOTROIN 10 CAPSULE:

If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose—do not double the dose to make up for it.

Overdosage of ISOTROIN 10 CAPSULE –

In case you or anybody else accidently take too much of ISOTROIN 10 CAPSULE, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of ISOTROIN 10 CAPSULE overdose are severe headache, abdominal pain, nausea, dizziness, redness of face, vomiting, somnolence, irritability, and itching.

introduction:
Introduction About AZIDERM 10% CREAM

AZIDERM 10% CREAM contains Azelaic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Dicarboxylic acids. It is used to manage common acne (acne vulgaris). It is also used for the management of mild to moderate papulopustular rosacea.

Acne is a skin condition that occurs when the hair follicles become plugged with oil and dead skin cells. It causes whiteheads, blackheads or pimples. Rosacea is a skin condition that causes blushing or redness, pus-filled bumps and small visible blood vessels in the face.

AZIDERM 10% CREAM should be applied with caution in patients with lung problems such as asthma. Consult your doctor before applying it.

Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before applying this medicine. Your doctor will decide whether you can use this medicine.

AZIDERM 10% CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children under 12 years of age for the management of acne and also not recommended for use in children under 18 years of age for the management of rosacea. Consult your doctor before applying it.

The most common side effects of applying AZIDERM 10% CREAM are burning, itching or redness of the skin (erythema) at the application site, scaling, pain, dryness, skin discolouration or irritation at the application site. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How AZIDERM 10% CREAM Works

AZIDERM 10% CREAM attacks the bacteria called propionibacterium acnes, which plays an essential part in causing acne. It also reduces growth of the harder outermost skin cells (keratin surface cells) that block the pores of the skin to cause blackheads and whiteheads.
usageDetails:
How to use AZIDERM 10% CREAM

Apply AZIDERM 10% CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water before and after using AZIDERM 10% CREAM. Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area and rub it gently into the skin.

Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, mouth and other mucous membranes or open wounds. If it does, wash the eyes, mouth or other mucous membranes immediately with large amounts of cool water.

name: Persol Forte Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About PERSOL FORTE CREAM

Persol Forte Cream is an antibacterial and anti-inflammatory gel, which is used for the management of acne vulgaris. It contains benzoyl peroxide and precipitated sulfur as active ingredients which kills the acne causing bacteria.

Benzoyl Peroxide gets converted into benzoic acid which releases active free-radical oxygen. These free radicals interfere with important bacterial function and survival, hence killing them. It also increases the turnover rate of skin cells. Sulfur draws out oil from clogged pores and together they help in managing acne.

Always apply Persol Forte Cream as advised by your physician. It is external use only. Wash the affected area with a mild cleanser pat your skin dry. Apply a thin layer over the affected area once or twice daily. If you have sensitive skin, apply once at night. Consult your doctor if you experience any allergic reactions while taking it.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of PERSOL FORTE CREAM

Persol Forte Cream may cause dry skin, skin redness, peeling of the skin, burning sensation of the skin, itching, pain, stinging, or skin irritation in some individuals. Consult your doctor if you notice any such side effects while applying Persol Forte Cream.

introduction:
Introduction About HALONEXT S OINTMENT

HALONEXT S OINTMENT is a combination of Halobetasol and Salicylic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids and Keratolytic agents respectively. It is used to manage eczema, psoriasis. This medicine is also used to manage dermatitis, seborrheic dermatitis and inflammatory dermatoses.

Eczema is a skin inflammatory disorder characterized by red and itchy rashes. The utmost common cause of eczema is allergies. Psoriasis is an autoimmune disease of the skin that is characterized by red, itchy, and scaly rashes.

HALONEXT S OINTMENT should not be used on the face, groin, or in axillae. HALONEXT S OINTMENT is not recommended to use in patients who have rosacea or perioral dermatitis.

HALONEXT S OINTMENT should be used with caution among pregnant and breastfeeding women. HALONEXT S OINTMENT is not recommended to use in children and adolescents under 12 years of age and it should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effect of this medicine is thinning of skin, dry skin, and application site reactions (burning, irritation, itching, and redness). Consult your doctor if the above side effects worsen. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including your eyelids.

How HALONEXT S OINTMENT Works

HALONEXT S OINTMENT is a combination of Halobetasol and Salicylic acid. Halobetasol is a steroid which works by blocking the production of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) that make the skin red, swollen, and itchy. Salicylic acid works by breaking down keratin clumps, removing dead skin cells, and softening the skin. It also increases the absorption of halobetasol into the skin.

Managed areas on the face should not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Your doctor will decide the right dose, and duration depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Tretiva 10mg Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TRETIVA 10MG CAPSULE

TRETIVA 10MG CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take TRETIVA 10MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

TRETIVA 10MG CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.

Benefits of TRETIVA 10MG CAPSULE for Acne:

TRETIVA 10MG CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How TRETIVA 10MG CAPSULE Works

TRETIVA 10MG CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.
usageInstructions: Take TRETIVA 10MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor.
Swallow the capsule whole with a glass of water; do not crush or chew it.
It is recommended to take the capsule with food to improve absorption and reduce stomach discomfort.
Take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels of the medication in your body.
Follow the prescribed dosage and duration carefully. Do not stop the medication abruptly without consulting your doctor, even if your symptoms improve.
Regular follow-ups and blood tests may be required to monitor your progress and ensure safe usage.
Avoid alcohol, excessive sun exposure, and waxing or laser treatments during the treatment period. Use sunscreen and moisturizers as recommended by your doctor.

What if I Forget to take TRETIVA 10MG CAPSULE:

If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose—do not double the dose to make up for it.

Overdosage of TRETIVA 10MG CAPSULE –

In case you or anybody else accidently take too much of TRETIVA 10MG CAPSULE, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of TRETIVA 10MG CAPSULE overdose are severe headache, abdominal pain, nausea, dizziness, redness of face, vomiting, somnolence, irritability, and itching.

Warning & Precautions
Pregnancy
CONTRAINDICATED
Human and animal studies have shown that isotretinoin is teratogenic in nature. Birth defects such as abnormalities of the face, eyes, ears, skull, central nervous system, cardiovascular system, and thymus and parathyroid glands or IQ less than score of 85 have been reported in female patients who were pregnant or became pregnant while on therapy with isotretinoin. Therefore, TRETIVA 10MG CAPSULE is considered unsafe for use during pregnancy.
Women of childbearing potential must use a reliable contraceptive method to avoid becoming pregnant. If you accidentally became pregnant while taking this medicine, stop taking it and consult your gynaecologist for further evaluation.
It is also not recommended for you to get pregnant for one month after stopping isotretinoin tablets because some medicine may still be left in your body. Consult your doctor before taking it.

name: Acnesol NC Gel 20gm
introduction:
Introduction About ACNESOL NC GEL

ACNESOL NC GEL is a combination of Clindamycin and Nicotinamide which belongs to a group of medicines called Lincomycin antibiotics and Vitamin B3 complex, respectively. ACNESOL NC GEL is used to manage mild to moderate acne which is a skin condition that occurs when hair follicles become plugged with oil and dead skin cells which may occur due to variety of causes such as genetics, fluctuating hormone levels, stress, high humidity or using oily or greasy personal care products which may affect people of all ages.

It is characterized by symptoms such as open or closed plugged pores, small red & tender bumps, pimples, large, solid or painful lumps under the skin and painful & pus-filled lumps under the skin.

Before using ACNESOL NC GEL inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, lung or heart diseases. Avoid applying ACNESOL NC GEL to a cut, scrapped, sunburnt or eczema affected skin.

ACNESOL NC GEL should be used with caution in pregnant and in breastfeeding women. ACNESOL NC GEL is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 12 years). Consult your doctor before applying.

The most common side effects of using ACNESOL NC GEL are skin inflammation, contact dermatitis (red, itchy rash), inflammation of hair follicles, itchy skin, dry skin and peeling of skin. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage mild to moderate acne
usesDetails:
Uses Of ACNESOL NC GEL
Manage mild to moderate acne
mechanismOfAction:
How ACNESOL NC GEL Works

ACNESOL NC GEL helps to manage acne, where Clindamycin reduces free fatty acid concentrations on the skin and suppresses the growth of Propionibacterium acnes (Corynebacterium acnes), a bacteria found in sebaceous glands and follicles and Nicotinamide exerts anti-inflammatory effect in acne and interrupts sebum production.
usageDetails:
How to use ACNESOL NC GEL

Apply ACNESOL NC GEL as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Before applying the medicine normally wash and dry the affected area and apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area. Managed areas on the face need not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Do not apply this medicine beyond the recommended duration. Avoid applying ACNESOL NC GEL around your eyes, including eyelids. Rinse it off with water if you accidentally get it in these areas.

name: Retik Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About RETIK CREAM

Retik Anti-aging Cream is an antiaging cream used to reduce the appearance of skin aging, age spots, fine lines, wrinkles and roughness of the skin, and to improve skin firmness. It contains vitamin A (retinol), vitamin C, vitamin E, and vitamin K as active ingredients that help to maintain a healthy skin.

Active microencapsulated pure vitamin A helps to increase the turnover of the cells and production of collagen. Vitamin C helps to fight signs of ageing which includes uneven skin tone and discoloration. Vitamin E is a natural antioxidant that nourishes your cells from the inside and protects your skin from damage due to sunburn.

Vitamin K promotes wound healing by increasing wound contraction and re-epithelialization and may have some antioxidant properties. Its role in blood-clotting may also make it useful in minimizing dark under-eye circles.

Always use Retik Anti-aging Cream as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. It is not recommended for use in children below 5 years of age. Ask your doctor before using it during pregnancy and breastfeeding.

introduction:
Introduction About XTRALITE CREAM

XTRALITE CREAM is a combination of Azelaic acid and Tretinoin which belongs to the group of medicines called Dicarboxylic acids and Retinoids respectively. It is used to manage melasma.

Melasma is a skin condition characterized by brown or blue-gray patches or freckle-like spots. It usually occurs on the cheek, forehead, bridge of nose and chin.

Your doctor might advise you to avoid exposure to sunlight or apply sunscreen while going outside. Inform your doctor if you have any skin disease.

Before using XTRALITE CREAM inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of applying XTRALITE CREAM are skin peeling, burning sensation, redness, and stinging sensation. Consult your doctor if your side effects worsen or persists for a long duration.
uses: Used to manage melasma
usesDetails:
Uses Of XTRALITE CREAM
Used to manage melasma
mechanismOfAction:
How XTRALITE CREAM Works

XTRALITE CREAM works by lightening the dark patches by reducing the production of melanin (natural skin pigment). Azelaic acid inhibit the energy production and/or DNA synthesis of hyperactive melanocytes (natural skin pigment) hence making the skin lighter. Tretinoin works by peeling of affected skin areas and unclogging the pores.
usageDetails:
How to use XTRALITE CREAM

Apply XTRALITE CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Clean and dry the affected area, wash your hands before applying it. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: CLINDAC A 1% Gel 20gm
introduction:
Introduction About CLINDAC A 1% GEL

CLINDAC A 1% GEL contains Clindamycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of acne vulgaris. Acne vulgaris is a common skin condition that occurs when hair follicles get blocked with oil and dead skin cells. Symptoms include whiteheads, blackheads, small red, tender bumps, pimples, and pus-filled lumps on the skin.

Before applying CLINDAC A 1% GEL, inform your doctor if you have or ever had diarrhea, bloody diarrhea and pseudomembranous colitis. CLINDAC A 1% GEL is not recommended for use if you have a history of regional enteritis (inflammation of the small intestine), ulcerative colitis (inflammation of the large intestine) or antibiotic-associated colitis.

CLINDAC A 1% GEL should be used with caution during pregnancy or by breastfeeding women only if clearly needed. The safety and effectiveness of CLINDAC A 1% GEL in children under the age of 12 has not been established. The most common side effects of applying CLINDAC A 1% GEL are burning, itching, and redness of the skin. Consult your doctor if symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage acne vulgaris
usesDetails:
Uses Of CLINDAC A 1% GEL
Manage acne vulgaris
mechanismOfAction:
How CLINDAC A 1% GEL Works

CLINDAC A 1% GEL acts against the bacteria by binding to the 50S subunit of the bacterial ribosome (site of protein synthesis), which in turn manages protein synthesis and works against the infection-causing bacteria.
usageDetails:
How to use CLINDAC A 1% GEL

Apply CLINDAC A 1% GEL as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before use. Wash and dry the whole area, apply a thin film once daily to the skin where acne lesions appear and use enough to cover the entire affected area. In case of contact with the eyes, mouth or nostrils, rinse it off immediately and thoroughly with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:

BENZONAK 5% LOTION contains Benzoyl peroxide which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-bacterial and Anti-inflammatory agents. It is used in the management of acne (pimples) in the face, chest and back. It is also used to unplug the blocked pores (blackheads and whiteheads) and absorb excess oil from the skin.

Before using BENZONAK 5% LOTION, inform your doctor if you are having any allergy to foods, preservatives or dyes or if you are already under any medication for acne.

It is not recommended to use hard cleansers, scrubs, medicated soap or cosmetic products containing alcohol while using this medicine.

BENZONAK 5% LOTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless clearly needed. Consult your doctor before using the medicine.

Avoid repeated exposure to sunlight or other sources of UV light (such as sun bed). In case of accidental contact, rinse thoroughly with warm water and pat dry.

Most common side effects of BENZONAK 5% LOTION are skin redness and irriation, burning, stinging sensation in the skin. Consult your doctor if any of above symptoms worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How BENZONAK 5% LOTION Works

BENZONAK 5% LOTION works against the acne-causing bacteria. This medicine after applying on the affected skin gets absorbed and is converted to benzoic acid. This benzoic acid gets metabolized by skin proteins and releases active free-radical oxygen species that results in the alteration of bacterial proteins. This helps to manage acne or pimples. BENZONAK 5% LOTION also acts as a keratolytic agent which promotes peeling of the skin and absorb excess oil from the skin further managing acne formation and skin irritation.

Always apply BENZONAK 5% LOTION as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area as instructed by the doctor.

Avoid contact with eyes, lips, mouth, nose, mucous membranes and sensitive areas of the neck. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending you’re your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TRETIVA 5MG CAPSULE

TRETIVA 5MG CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take TRETIVA 5MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

TRETIVA 5MG CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.

Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of TRETIVA 5MG CAPSULE for Acne:

TRETIVA 5MG CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How TRETIVA 5MG CAPSULE Works

TRETIVA 5MG CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

Human and animal studies have shown that isotretinoin is teratogenic in nature. Birth defects such as abnormalities of the face, eyes, ears, skull, central nervous system, cardiovascular system, and thymus and parathyroid glands or IQ less than score of 85 have been reported in female patients who were pregnant or became pregnant while on therapy with isotretinoin. Therefore, TRETIVA 5MG CAPSULE is considered unsafe for use during pregnancy.
Women of childbearing potential must use a reliable contraceptive method to avoid becoming pregnant. If you accidentally became pregnant while taking this medicine, stop taking it and consult your gynaecologist for further evaluation.

introduction:
Introduction About GLOTRET 10MG TABLET

GLOTRET 10MG TABLET contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take GLOTRET 10MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

GLOTRET 10MG TABLET is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.

Uses Of GLOTRET 10MG TABLET

Benefits of GLOTRET 10MG TABLET for Acne:

GLOTRET 10MG TABLET is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How GLOTRET 10MG TABLET Works

GLOTRET 10MG TABLET work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

Regular follow-ups and blood tests may be required to monitor your progress and ensure safe usage.
Avoid alcohol, excessive sun exposure, and waxing or laser treatments during the treatment period. Use sunscreen and moisturizers as recommended by your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About PERNEX AC 2.5% GEL

Pernex AC 2.5% Gel is used for the topical management of mild to moderate acne vulgaris. It contains Benzoyl Peroxide as active ingredient which acts against acne causing bacteria and unclogging the blocked pores.

Benzoyl Peroxide is a gold standard in the management of acne vulgaris. Pernex AC 2.5% Gel has microsponge technology which reduces skin irritation, facial sebum accumulation and offers controlled drug release thereby increasing patient compliance. Benzoyl peroxide act as an antibacterial agent works against the acne causing bacteria, removing blackheads and whiteheads from the pores.

Use as directed by your doctor. Pernex AC 2.5% Gel is for external use only. Before applying wash, your hands and affected area with mild skin cleanser and dry the affected area. Apply Pernex AC 2.5% Gel once or twice daily to the affected area of the face and or trunk or as recommended by doctor. Wash your hands after applying gel. Avoid contact with eyes, eyelids, lips, and mucous membranes.

Introduction About AZIDERM 20% GEL

AZIDERM 20% GEL contains Azelaic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Dicarboxylic acids. It is used to manage common acne (acne vulgaris). It is also used for the management of mild to moderate papulopustular rosacea.

Acne is a skin condition that occurs when the hair follicles become plugged with oil and dead skin cells. It causes whiteheads, blackheads or pimples. Rosacea is a skin condition that causes blushing or redness, pus-filled bumps and small visible blood vessels in the face.

AZIDERM 20% GEL should be applied with caution in patients with lung problems such as asthma. Consult your doctor before applying it.

Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before applying this medicine. Your doctor will decide whether you can use this medicine.

AZIDERM 20% GEL is generally not recommended for use in children under 12 years of age for the management of acne and also not recommended for use in children under 18 years of age for the management of rosacea. Consult your doctor before applying it.

The most common side effects of applying AZIDERM 20% GEL are burning, itching or redness of the skin (erythema) at the application site, scaling, pain, dryness, skin discolouration or irritation at the application site. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About PERSOL AC 5 GEL

Persol AC 5 Gel is an antibacterial and anti-inflammatory gel, which is used for the management of mild acne on the face, chest or back in adults and adolescents 12 years and over. It contains Benzoyl Peroxide as an active ingredient which kills the acne causing bacteria.

Benzoyl Peroxide gets converted into benzoic acid which releases active free-radical oxygen. These free radicals interfere with important bacterial function and survival, hence killing them. It also increases the turnover rate of skin cells which helps in managing acne.

Always apply Persol AC 5 Gel as advised by your physician. It is external use only. Wash the affected area with a mild cleanser pat your skin dry. Apply a thin layer over the affected area once or twice daily. If you have sensitive skin, apply once at night. Consult your doctor if you experience any allergic reactions while taking it.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of PERSOL AC 5 GEL

Persol AC 5 Gel may cause dry skin, skin redness, peeling of the skin, burning sensation of the skin, itching, pain, stinging, or skin irritation in some individuals. Consult your doctor if you notice any such side effects while applying Persol AC 5 Gel.

Introduction About SOTRET NF 16 CAPSULE

SOTRET NF 16 CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take SOTRET NF 16 CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

SOTRET NF 16 CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.

Benefits of SOTRET NF 16 CAPSULE for Acne:

SOTRET NF 16 CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How SOTRET NF 16 CAPSULE Works

SOTRET NF 16 CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

introduction:
Introduction About ZITBLOW 10MG CAPSULE

ZITBLOW 10MG CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take ZITBLOW 10MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

ZITBLOW 10MG CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.
uses: Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZITBLOW 10MG CAPSULE
Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of ZITBLOW 10MG CAPSULE for Acne:

ZITBLOW 10MG CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How ZITBLOW 10MG CAPSULE Works

ZITBLOW 10MG CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.
usageInstructions: Take ZITBLOW 10MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor.
Swallow the capsule whole with a glass of water; do not crush or chew it.
It is recommended to take the capsule with food to improve absorption and reduce stomach discomfort.
Take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels of the medication in your body.
Follow the prescribed dosage and duration carefully. Do not stop the medication abruptly without consulting your doctor, even if your symptoms improve.
Regular follow-ups and blood tests may be required to monitor your progress and ensure safe usage.
Avoid alcohol, excessive sun exposure, and waxing or laser treatments during the treatment period. Use sunscreen and moisturizers as recommended by your doctor.
