What if I Forget to take ZITBLOW 10MG CAPSULE:

If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose—do not double the dose to make up for it.

Overdosage of ZITBLOW 10MG CAPSULE –

In case you or anybody else accidently take too much of ZITBLOW 10MG CAPSULE, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of ZITBLOW 10MG CAPSULE overdose are severe headache, abdominal pain, nausea, dizziness, redness of face, vomiting, somnolence, irritability, and itching.

warningsRaw:
Warning & Precautions
Pregnancy
CONTRAINDICATED
Human and animal studies have shown that isotretinoin is teratogenic in nature. Birth defects such as abnormalities of the face, eyes, ears, skull, central nervous system, cardiovascular system, and thymus and parathyroid glands or IQ less than score of 85 have been reported in female patients who were pregnant or became pregnant while on therapy with isotretinoin. Therefore, ZITBLOW 10MG CAPSULE is considered unsafe for use during pregnancy.
Women of childbearing potential must use a reliable contraceptive method to avoid becoming pregnant. If you accidentally became pregnant while taking this medicine, stop taking it and consult your gynaecologist for further evaluation.
It is also not recommended for you to get pregnant for one month after stopping isotretinoin tablets because some medicine may still be left in your body. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Breastfeeding
CONTRAINDICATED

It is not known whether this medicine is excreted in human milk. Because of the potential for adverse effects, nursing mothers should not receive ZITBLOW 10MG CAPSULE

introduction:
Introduction About CLINMI SKIN GEL

CLINMI SKIN GEL is a combination of Clindamycin and Nicotinamide which belongs to a group of medicines called Lincomycin antibiotics and Vitamin B3 complex, respectively. CLINMI SKIN GEL is used to manage mild to moderate acne which is a skin condition that occurs when hair follicles become plugged with oil and dead skin cells which may occur due to variety of causes such as genetics, fluctuating hormone levels, stress, high humidity or using oily or greasy personal care products which may affect people of all ages.

It is characterized by symptoms such as open or closed plugged pores, small red & tender bumps, pimples, large, solid or painful lumps under the skin and painful & pus-filled lumps under the skin.

Before using CLINMI SKIN GEL inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, lung or heart diseases. Avoid applying CLINMI SKIN GEL to a cut, scrapped, sunburnt or eczema affected skin.

CLINMI SKIN GEL should be used with caution in pregnant and in breastfeeding women. CLINMI SKIN GEL is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 12 years). Consult your doctor before applying.

The most common side effects of using CLINMI SKIN GEL are skin inflammation, contact dermatitis (red, itchy rash), inflammation of hair follicles, itchy skin, dry skin and peeling of skin. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage mild to moderate acne
usesDetails:
Uses Of CLINMI SKIN GEL
Manage mild to moderate acne
mechanismOfAction:
How CLINMI SKIN GEL Works

CLINMI SKIN GEL helps to manage acne, where Clindamycin reduces free fatty acid concentrations on the skin and suppresses the growth of Propionibacterium acnes (Corynebacterium acnes), a bacteria found in sebaceous glands and follicles and Nicotinamide exerts anti-inflammatory effect in acne and interrupts sebum production.
usageDetails:
How to use CLINMI SKIN GEL

Apply CLINMI SKIN GEL as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Before applying the medicine normally wash and dry the affected area and apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area. Managed areas on the face need not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Do not apply this medicine beyond the recommended duration. Avoid applying CLINMI SKIN GEL around your eyes, including eyelids. Rinse it off with water if you accidentally get it in these areas.

introduction:
Introduction About ACNEDAP GEL

ACNEDAP GEL contains Dapsone which belongs to the group of medicines called Sulfone antibiotics. It is used in the management of acne vulgaris (a skin condition that occurs when the hair follicles are blocked with dead skin cells, bacteria and sebum). The most common symptoms of acne vulgaris are pimples, redness, blackhead and white heads.

Before using ACNEDAP GEL, inform your doctor if you have glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency, methemoglobinemia (a type of blood disorder) and if you are using other products including cosmetics or medicines applied to the skin.

ACNEDAP GEL should be used during pregnancy and breast-feeding only if clearly advised by the doctor. Consult your doctor before using the medicine.

This medicine is not recommended for use in children (younger than 12 years of age). ACNEDAP GEL should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before using the medicine.

The most common side effects associated with the use of ACNEDAP GEL are oiliness/ peeling, redness and dryness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
uses: Manage acne vulgaris
usesDetails:
Uses Of ACNEDAP GEL
Manage acne vulgaris
mechanismOfAction:
How ACNEDAP GEL Works

ACNEDAP GEL works as both anti-bacterial and anti-inflammatory agent in the management of acne vulgaris. As an antibacterial agent, it works by inhibiting the synthesis of folic acid which is necessary for the growth of bacteria. Thus, stops the multiplication of bacteria. As an anti-inflammatory agent, it decreases inflammation and heals the breakout.
usageDetails:
How to use ACNEDAP GEL

Always apply ACNEDAP GEL as directed by your doctor. It is for topical use only. Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the areas of your skin that have acne. Avoid contact with eyes, mouth and mucous membranes. Rub the medicine gently and completely. Wash your hands after applying ACNEDAP GEL. Your doctor will decide the duration and frequency of this medicine depending upon severity of the condition.

Introduction About DERSOL 12% OINTMENT

DERSOL 12% OINTMENT contains Salicylic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Keratolytic agents. DERSOL 12% OINTMENT is used manage skin conditions such as psoriasis, dry, scaly skin conditions and acne. It is also used to manage dandruff, corn and calluses (thickened layers of skin) in affected individuals.

DERSOL 12% OINTMENT is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Salicylic acid. It is also not recommended for use in patients with active inflammation/dermatitis, infection (at the application site), acute viral infection, skin malignancy, and/or tanned skin. Before applying DERSOL 12% OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for surgery, and/or suffering from any kidney problems. DERSOL 12% OINTMENT is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women. If you are a breastfeeding women, consult your doctor before using the medicine. Avoid applying the medicine on skin areas which might come in direct contact with infant’s skin.

DERSOL 12% OINTMENT should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 1-15 years). It is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before applying the medicine. The most common side effects of applying DERSOL 12% OINTMENT are erythema (skin redness) or skin dryness. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About ACNETOIN I 10 SOFTGEL CAPSULE

ACNETOIN I 10 SOFTGEL CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take ACNETOIN I 10 SOFTGEL CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

ACNETOIN I 10 SOFTGEL CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.

Benefits of ACNETOIN I 10 SOFTGEL CAPSULE for Acne:

ACNETOIN I 10 SOFTGEL CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How ACNETOIN I 10 SOFTGEL CAPSULE Works

ACNETOIN I 10 SOFTGEL CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

CONTRAINDICATED
Human and animal studies have shown that isotretinoin is teratogenic in nature. Birth defects such as abnormalities of the face, eyes, ears, skull, central nervous system, cardiovascular system, and thymus and parathyroid glands or IQ less than score of 85 have been reported in female patients who were pregnant or became pregnant while on therapy with isotretinoin. Therefore, ACNETOIN I 10 SOFTGEL CAPSULE is considered unsafe for use during pregnancy.
Women of childbearing potential must use a reliable contraceptive method to avoid becoming pregnant. If you accidentally became pregnant while taking this medicine, stop taking it and consult your gynaecologist for further evaluation.
It is also not recommended for you to get pregnant for one month after stopping isotretinoin tablets because some medicine may still be left in your body. Consult your doctor before taking it.

How ACUTRET 20MG CAPSULE Works

Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

introduction:
Introduction About SKINLITE CREAM

SKINLITE CREAM is a combination of Hydroquinone, Tretinoin, Mometasone furoate which belongs to the group of medicines called Depigmenting agents, Retinoids and Corticosteroids respectively. It is used in adults for the management of moderate to severe melasma (dark spots on the skin) in association with sun-avoidance measures, like using sunscreens and wearing protective clothing. Melasma is one of the most frequently acquired hyperpigmentation (excess melanin production) disorders with symptoms such as symmetrical brown patches on sun exposed areas mainly on face.

It is advised to avoid exposure to sun during management with SKINLITE CREAM for better results. While going out apply sunscreens and wear full covering protective clothes. Before using SKINLITE CREAM inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung or heart diseases.

Safety and efficacy of SKINLITE CREAM is not established in pregnant women and in children below 12 years of age. Ask for your doctor’s advice before using. SKINLITE CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of using SKINLITE CREAM are mild burning, stinging, redness and dryness. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.

How SKINLITE CREAM Works

SKINLITE CREAM helps in managing melasma where Hydroquinone is a skin bleaching agent that blocks enzyme tyrosinase which is responsible for the production of melanin that cause pigmentation. Thus, it helps for fading of dark spots in skin. Tretinoin helps to recover the damage to the skin caused by sun exposure (photodamage) by thickening skin layer and loss of keratinized cells.it helps to rejuvenate the skin. Mometasone furoate blocks prostaglandin synthesis and reduces redness, swelling and itching caused by tretinoin and other skin infections.

Apply SKINLITE CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before and after applying SKINLITE CREAM. Wash your face with a mild soap and dry properly. Apply SKINLITE CREAM at night and gently massage it in until it is absorbed. Avoid contact with your eyes, nose, mouth, mucous membrane. Avoid exposure to sunlight while using this medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About ETHITRET 20MG CAPSULE

ETHITRET 20MG CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take ETHITRET 20MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. Take ISOTROIN 30MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. name: Exazel 20% Cream 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About EXAZEL 20% CREAM

EXAZEL 20% CREAM contains Azelaic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Dicarboxylic acids. It is used to manage common acne (acne vulgaris). It is also used for the management of mild to moderate papulopustular rosacea.

Acne is a skin condition that occurs when the hair follicles become plugged with oil and dead skin cells. It causes whiteheads, blackheads or pimples. Rosacea is a skin condition that causes blushing or redness, pus-filled bumps and small visible blood vessels in the face.

EXAZEL 20% CREAM should be applied with caution in patients with lung problems such as asthma. Consult your doctor before applying it.

Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before applying this medicine. Your doctor will decide whether you can use this medicine.

EXAZEL 20% CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children under 12 years of age for the management of acne and also not recommended for use in children under 18 years of age for the management of rosacea. Consult your doctor before applying it.

The most common side effects of applying EXAZEL 20% CREAM are burning, itching or redness of the skin (erythema) at the application site, scaling, pain, dryness, skin discolouration or irritation at the application site. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How EXAZEL 20% CREAM Works

EXAZEL 20% CREAM attacks the bacteria called propionibacterium acnes, which plays an essential part in causing acne. It also reduces growth of the harder outermost skin cells (keratin surface cells) that block the pores of the skin to cause blackheads and whiteheads.
usageDetails:
How to use EXAZEL 20% CREAM

Apply EXAZEL 20% CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water before and after using EXAZEL 20% CREAM. Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area and rub it gently into the skin.

Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, mouth and other mucous membranes or open wounds. If it does, wash the eyes, mouth or other mucous membranes immediately with large amounts of cool water.

introduction:
Introduction About EXAZEL N CREAM

Exazel N Cream is an Anti-acne cream used for the management of acne vulgaris. It contains Allantoin, Azelaic Acid, Glycerin and Niacinamide as an active ingredient.

Allantoin and Glycerin produces moisturizing and keratolytic effects, which helps the dead skin cells fall off, helps the skin keep in more water, and leaves the skin feeling smoother and softer. Azelaic Acid inhibits the Propionibacterium acnes, which cause acne development. It also reduces the formation of the thicker outermost skin cells that clog pores and form blackheads and whiteheads. Niacinamide acts as an anti-inflammatory, which works by reducing acne-related swelling and redness. It also helps in regulating the amount of oil, which in turn helps to manage acne.

Always apply Exazel N Cream as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash and pat your skin dry. Take necessary amount and apply a thin layer of Exazel N Cream and massage gently over the affected area twice daily. Wash your hands after applying. Close the cap tightly after use. Avoid contact with your eyes and mucous surfaces.

name: Epiduo Gel 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About EPIDUO GEL

EPIDUO GEL is a combination of Adapalene and Benzoyl peroxide which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiacne agents. It is used in the management of acne.

Acne vulgaris (commonly known as acne) is an inflammatory skin condition that occurs when the hair follicles present in the skin are clogged with excess oil and/or dead skin cells. It can also be aggravated by few bacteria (such as Propionibacterium acnes) and is highly common among on the teenagers and the young adults.

It primarily affects the face, upper arms, trunk or back and is often characterized by pus-filled pimples, red bumps with inflammatory and non-inflammatory lesions. EPIDUO GEL is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 9 years or older).

Apply a thin layer of EPIDUO GEL on the affected skin areas. Avoid contact of this medicine with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose or with open wounds. You must also protect your skin against sun light and against other light sources (such as UV lamps).

Do not use EPIDUO GEL if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. EPIDUO GEL can be used in breastfeeding women if required. The most common side effects of using EPIDUO GEL are dry skin, mild burning sensation and skin irritation, redness or scaling. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Manage acne
usesDetails:
Uses Of EPIDUO GEL

It is used in adults, children and in adolescents (aged 9 years or older) to:

Manage acne
mechanismOfAction:
How EPIDUO GEL Works

EPIDUO GEL is a combination of two medicines namely, adapalene and benzoyl peroxide.

Adapalene is a topical retinoid (a type of vitamin A). It modulates the skin cell cycle and manages the accumulation of excess sebum (natural oil produced by the skin) and dead skin cells on the hair follicles of the skin. It also reduces inflammation on the skin.

Benzoyl peroxide is a keratolytic agent with antimicrobial properties. It improves skin’s tendency to exfoliate the dead skin cells naturally. It also reduces the number of acne-causing bacteria on the skin which can reduce the further spread of acne.

Collectively, they unclog the hair follicles of the skin and exfoliates dead skin cells which reduces acne breakouts.
usageDetails:
How to use EPIDUO GEL

Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected skin areas or as directed by the physician. It is for topical use only. Wash your hands before and after application.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Avoid contact of EPIDUO GEL with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose, hair or with open wounds (cuts, scrapes or sunburn).

name: GLOCIN Gel 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About GLOCIN GEL

GLOCIN GEL is a combination of Clindamycin and Nicotinamide which belongs to a group of medicines called Lincomycin antibiotics and Vitamin B3 complex, respectively. GLOCIN GEL is used to manage mild to moderate acne which is a skin condition that occurs when hair follicles become plugged with oil and dead skin cells which may occur due to variety of causes such as genetics, fluctuating hormone levels, stress, high humidity or using oily or greasy personal care products which may affect people of all ages.

It is characterized by symptoms such as open or closed plugged pores, small red & tender bumps, pimples, large, solid or painful lumps under the skin and painful & pus-filled lumps under the skin.

Before using GLOCIN GEL inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, lung or heart diseases. Avoid applying GLOCIN GEL to a cut, scrapped, sunburnt or eczema affected skin.

GLOCIN GEL should be used with caution in pregnant and in breastfeeding women. GLOCIN GEL is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 12 years). Consult your doctor before applying.

The most common side effects of using GLOCIN GEL are skin inflammation, contact dermatitis (red, itchy rash), inflammation of hair follicles, itchy skin, dry skin and peeling of skin. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage mild to moderate acne
usesDetails:
Uses Of GLOCIN GEL
Manage mild to moderate acne
mechanismOfAction:
How GLOCIN GEL Works

GLOCIN GEL helps to manage acne, where Clindamycin reduces free fatty acid concentrations on the skin and suppresses the growth of Propionibacterium acnes (Corynebacterium acnes), a bacteria found in sebaceous glands and follicles and Nicotinamide exerts anti-inflammatory effect in acne and interrupts sebum production.
usageDetails:
How to use GLOCIN GEL

Apply GLOCIN GEL as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Before applying the medicine normally wash and dry the affected area and apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area. Managed areas on the face need not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Do not apply this medicine beyond the recommended duration. Avoid applying GLOCIN GEL around your eyes, including eyelids. Rinse it off with water if you accidentally get it in these areas.

name: MARKSRUB ULTRA Cream 25gm
introduction:
Introduction About MARKSRUB ULTRA CREAM

MARKSRUB ULTRA CREAM is a combination of Hydroquinone, Tretinoin, Mometasone furoate which belongs to the group of medicines called Depigmenting agents, Retinoids and Corticosteroids respectively. It is used in adults for the management of moderate to severe melasma (dark spots on the skin) in association with sun-avoidance measures, like using sunscreens and wearing protective clothing. Melasma is one of the most frequently acquired hyperpigmentation (excess melanin production) disorders with symptoms such as symmetrical brown patches on sun exposed areas mainly on face.

It is advised to avoid exposure to sun during management with MARKSRUB ULTRA CREAM for better results. While going out apply sunscreens and wear full covering protective clothes. Before using MARKSRUB ULTRA CREAM inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung or heart diseases.

Safety and efficacy of MARKSRUB ULTRA CREAM is not established in pregnant women and in children below 12 years of age. Ask for your doctor’s advice before using. MARKSRUB ULTRA CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of using MARKSRUB ULTRA CREAM are mild burning, stinging, redness and dryness. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.
uses: Manages moderate to severe melasma (dark spots on the skin)

mechanismOfAction:
How MARKSRUB ULTRA CREAM Works

MARKSRUB ULTRA CREAM helps in managing melasma where Hydroquinone is a skin bleaching agent that blocks enzyme tyrosinase which is responsible for the production of melanin that cause pigmentation. Thus, it helps for fading of dark spots in skin. Tretinoin helps to recover the damage to the skin caused by sun exposure (photodamage) by thickening skin layer and loss of keratinized cells.it helps to rejuvenate the skin. Mometasone furoate blocks prostaglandin synthesis and reduces redness, swelling and itching caused by tretinoin and other skin infections.
usageDetails:
How to use MARKSRUB ULTRA CREAM

Apply MARKSRUB ULTRA CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before and after applying MARKSRUB ULTRA CREAM. Wash your face with a mild soap and dry properly. Apply MARKSRUB ULTRA CREAM at night and gently massage it in until it is absorbed. Avoid contact with your eyes, nose, mouth, mucous membrane. Avoid exposure to sunlight while using this medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Glyaha Lotion 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About GLYAHA LOTION

Glyaha Lotion is a skin-lightening lotion that is used to improve skin complexion, giving you a younger and brighter looking skin. It contains glycolic acid, vitamin E, liquid paraffin, kokum butter and glycerine as active ingredients that helps to improve the skin tone.

Glycolic acid helps to remove the rough and dry upper layer and reveals a newer and fresher skin. The moisturizers and emollients help to reduce the visible signs of ageing. Vitamin E is rich in antioxidants that protects the skin from various deleterious effects due to solar radiation.

Kokum butter helps to hydrate and soothe the skin and helps to reduce acne and the symptoms of ageing. Light liquid paraffin acts as a barrier by providing a layer of oil on the surface of the skin to manage water evaporation from the skin surface. Glycerine hydrates the outer layer of the skin that helps to relieve dry skin and skin irritations.

Use Glyaha Lotion twice daily or as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. It should be preferably applied at night. Avoid contact with your eyes and mucous membrane. Avoid direct sunlight exposure after applying Glyaha Lotion. Stop using and contact a doctor if you notice any skin irritation while using it.

introduction:
Introduction About OBRIL CREAM

Obril Cream is a spotless brilliance skin care cream blend with natural ingredients used to get rid of spots and hyperpigmentation on the face. It contains 4-n-Butyl Resorcinol, Bellis Perennis, p-Terowhite and Niacinamide as active ingredients that helps to lighten the dark spots.

4-n-Butyl Resorcinol is a tyrosinase inhibitor that blocks the action of tyrosinase enzyme, which is essential to produce melanin (pigmentation causing substance). Thus, helping to manage pigmentation on the skin. p-Terowhite is rich with antioxidants and has anti-inflammatory properties that helps to protect skin from free radical damage.

Bellis Perennis has photoprotective and immunomodulatory effects on skin keratinocytes that helps to manage skin damages caused by exposure to the UV light. Niacinamide helps to manage hyperpigmentation by lightening the dark spots, regulates excess oil in skin as well as minimises fine lines and wrinkles, thus making the skin look younger.

Apply Obril Cream twice daily until desired results are achieved or as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. Clean and dry your face. Take the required amount of Obril Cream, apply on affected areas and gently massage. Avoid contact with your eyes, eyelids, and mouth.

name: Clindac A 1% solution 25ml
introduction:
Introduction About CLINDAC A SOLUTION

CLINDAC A SOLUTION contains Clindamycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of acne vulgaris. Acne vulgaris is a common skin condition that occurs when hair follicles get blocked with oil and dead skin cells. Symptoms include whiteheads, blackheads, small red, tender bumps, pimples, and pus-filled lumps on the skin.

Before applying CLINDAC A SOLUTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had diarrhea, bloody diarrhea and pseudomembranous colitis. CLINDAC A SOLUTION is not recommended for use if you have a history of regional enteritis (inflammation of the small intestine), ulcerative colitis (inflammation of the large intestine) or antibiotic-associated colitis.

CLINDAC A SOLUTION should be used with caution during pregnancy or by breastfeeding women only if clearly needed. The safety and effectiveness of CLINDAC A SOLUTION in children under the age of 12 has not been established. The most common side effects of applying CLINDAC A SOLUTION are burning, itching, and redness of the skin. Consult your doctor if symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage acne vulgaris
usesDetails:

Manage acne vulgaris
mechanismOfAction:
How CLINDAC A SOLUTION Works

CLINDAC A SOLUTION acts against the bacteria by binding to the 50S subunit of the bacterial ribosome (site of protein synthesis), which in turn manages protein synthesis and kills the infection-causing bacteria.

How to use CLINDAC A SOLUTION

Apply CLINDAC A SOLUTION as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before use. Wash and dry the whole area, apply a thin film once daily to the skin where acne lesions appear and use enough to cover the entire affected area. In case of contact with the eyes, mouth or nostrils, rinse it off immediately and thoroughly with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About D ACNE PLUS GEL

D ACNE PLUS GEL contains Allantoin, Nicotinamide and Clindamycin which belongs to the group of medicines called Dermatologic agent, Vitamin B complex and Antibiotics. It is used to manage acne, skin infections caused due to bacteria and oily skin.

Before using D ACNE PLUS GEL, inform your doctor if you have any kidney, liver, heart, or lung diseases. In pregnant and breast-feeding women, D ACNE PLUS GEL should be used with caution.D ACNE PLUS GEL should not be used by children under the age of 12.

mechanismOfAction:
How D ACNE PLUS GEL Works

D ACNE PLUS GEL helps in the management of various skin conditions. Allantoin is a dermatological agent that stimulates wound healing and tissue repair by forming new cells. It also repairs dry, rough, scaly, and itchy skin by increasing the blood flow, forming new blood vessels, and increasing collagen production at the site of application.

Nicotinamide is a vitamin B complex that has an anti-inflammatory effect by blocking various substances that cause redness and swelling, as well as aiding in the reduction of sebum production. 

Clindamycin is an Antibacterial agent which acts on the bacterial cell wall and interferes with its important life functions leading to its destruction. Together, they help in the management of various skin problems.

Introduction About PINOIN 0.025% CREAM

PINOIN 0.025% CREAM contains Tretinoin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Retinoids. It is used to manage acne. It can also be used to manage wrinkles, skin spots and rough skin. Acne is defined as a skin disease involving inflammation of the sebaceous follicles of the face and upper body, characterized by lesions on the face, back, upper chest and shoulders.

Before using PINOIN 0.025% CREAM, inform your doctor if you have any sunburn, sun sensitivity or any other skin problems. PINOIN 0.025% CREAM should be used in pregnancy only if specifically directed by your doctor. PINOIN 0.025% CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women.

The safety and effectiveness of PINOIN 0.025% CREAM in children (aged less than 12 years) have not been established, so consult your doctor before using it. The most common side effect of using PINOIN 0.025% CREAM is skin irritation like redness, burning, stinging, dryness and peeling. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How PINOIN 0.025% CREAM Works

PINOIN 0.025% CREAM works by modifying the abnormal cavity formation that comes from the excessive conversion of cytoplasm to keratin (a strong protein that is the main substance that forms hair, skin, etc.) of epithelial cells, promoting detachment of tough cells and enhancing shedding.

name: Zyclin Nano Gel 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About ZYCLIN NANO GEL

ZYCLIN NANO GEL contains Clindamycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of acne vulgaris. Acne vulgaris is a common skin condition that occurs when hair follicles get blocked with oil and dead skin cells. Symptoms include whiteheads, blackheads, small red, tender bumps, pimples, and pus-filled lumps on the skin.

Before applying ZYCLIN NANO GEL, inform your doctor if you have or ever had diarrhea, bloody diarrhea and pseudomembranous colitis. ZYCLIN NANO GEL is not recommended for use if you have a history of regional enteritis (inflammation of the small intestine), ulcerative colitis (inflammation of the large intestine) or antibiotic-associated colitis.

ZYCLIN NANO GEL should be used with caution during pregnancy or by breastfeeding women only if clearly needed. The safety and effectiveness of ZYCLIN NANO GEL in children under the age of 12 has not been established. The most common side effects of applying ZYCLIN NANO GEL are burning, itching, and redness of the skin. Consult your doctor if symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage acne vulgaris
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZYCLIN NANO GEL
Manage acne vulgaris
mechanismOfAction:
How ZYCLIN NANO GEL Works

ZYCLIN NANO GEL acts against the bacteria by binding to the 50S subunit of the bacterial ribosome (site of protein synthesis), which in turn manages protein synthesis and works against the infection-causing bacteria.
usageDetails:
How to use ZYCLIN NANO GEL

Apply ZYCLIN NANO GEL as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before use. Wash and dry the whole area, apply a thin film once daily to the skin where acne lesions appear and use enough to cover the entire affected area. In case of contact with the eyes, mouth or nostrils, rinse it off immediately and thoroughly with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About PERODUO GEL

PERODUO GEL is a combination of Adapalene and Benzoyl peroxide which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiacne agents. It is used in the management of acne.

Acne vulgaris (commonly known as acne) is an inflammatory skin condition that occurs when the hair follicles present in the skin are clogged with excess oil and/or dead skin cells. It can also be aggravated by few bacteria (such as Propionibacterium acnes) and is highly common among on the teenagers and the young adults.

It primarily affects the face, upper arms, trunk or back and is often characterized by pus-filled pimples, red bumps with inflammatory and non-inflammatory lesions. PERODUO GEL is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 9 years or older).

Apply a thin layer of PERODUO GEL on the affected skin areas. Avoid contact of this medicine with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose or with open wounds. You must also protect your skin against sun light and against other light sources (such as UV lamps).

Do not use PERODUO GEL if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. PERODUO GEL can be used in breastfeeding women if required. The most common side effects of using PERODUO GEL are dry skin, mild burning sensation and skin irritation, redness or scaling. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Manage acne
usesDetails:
Uses Of PERODUO GEL

It is used in adults, children and in adolescents (aged 9 years or older) to:

Manage acne
mechanismOfAction:
How PERODUO GEL Works

PERODUO GEL is a combination of two medicines namely, adapalene and benzoyl peroxide.

Adapalene is a topical retinoid (a type of vitamin A). It modulates the skin cell cycle and manages the accumulation of excess sebum (natural oil produced by the skin) and dead skin cells on the hair follicles of the skin. It also reduces inflammation on the skin.

Benzoyl peroxide is a keratolytic agent with antimicrobial properties. It improves skin’s tendency to exfoliate the dead skin cells naturally. It also reduces the number of acne-causing bacteria on the skin which can reduce the further spread of acne.

Collectively, they unclog the hair follicles of the skin and exfoliates dead skin cells which reduces acne breakouts.
usageDetails:
How to use PERODUO GEL

Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected skin areas or as directed by the physician. It is for topical use only. Wash your hands before and after application.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Avoid contact of PERODUO GEL with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose, hair or with open wounds (cuts, scrapes or sunburn).

name: Ezanic 20% Cream 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About EZANIC 20% CREAM

EZANIC 20% CREAM contains Azelaic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Dicarboxylic acids. It is used to manage common acne (acne vulgaris). It is also used for the management of mild to moderate papulopustular rosacea.

Acne is a skin condition that occurs when the hair follicles become plugged with oil and dead skin cells. It causes whiteheads, blackheads or pimples. Rosacea is a skin condition that causes blushing or redness, pus-filled bumps and small visible blood vessels in the face.

EZANIC 20% CREAM should be applied with caution in patients with lung problems such as asthma. Consult your doctor before applying it.

Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before applying this medicine. Your doctor will decide whether you can use this medicine.

EZANIC 20% CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children under 12 years of age for the management of acne and also not recommended for use in children under 18 years of age for the management of rosacea. Consult your doctor before applying it.

The most common side effects of applying EZANIC 20% CREAM are burning, itching or redness of the skin (erythema) at the application site, scaling, pain, dryness, skin discolouration or irritation at the application site. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Common acne (acne vulgaris)
Mild to moderate papulopustular rosacea
usesDetails:
Uses Of EZANIC 20% CREAM
Common acne (acne vulgaris)
Mild to moderate papulopustular rosacea
mechanismOfAction:
How EZANIC 20% CREAM Works

EZANIC 20% CREAM attacks the bacteria called propionibacterium acnes, which plays an essential part in causing acne. It also reduces growth of the harder outermost skin cells (keratin surface cells) that block the pores of the skin to cause blackheads and whiteheads.
usageDetails:
How to use EZANIC 20% CREAM

Apply EZANIC 20% CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water before and after using EZANIC 20% CREAM. Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area and rub it gently into the skin.

Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, mouth and other mucous membranes or open wounds. If it does, wash the eyes, mouth or other mucous membranes immediately with large amounts of cool water.

introduction:
Introduction About ACUTRET 5MG CAPSULE

ACUTRET 5MG CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take ACUTRET 5MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

ACUTRET 5MG CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.
uses: Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
usesDetails:
Uses Of ACUTRET 5MG CAPSULE
Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of ACUTRET 5MG CAPSULE for Acne:

ACUTRET 5MG CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How ACUTRET 5MG CAPSULE Works

ACUTRET 5MG CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

What if I Forget to take ACUTRET 5MG CAPSULE:

If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose—do not double the dose to make up for it.

Overdosage of ACUTRET 5MG CAPSULE –

In case you or anybody else accidently take too much of ACUTRET 5MG CAPSULE, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of ACUTRET 5MG CAPSULE overdose are severe headache, abdominal pain, nausea, dizziness, redness of face, vomiting, somnolence, irritability, and itching.

Warning & Precautions
Pregnancy
CONTRAINDICATED
Human and animal studies have shown that isotretinoin is teratogenic in nature. Birth defects such as abnormalities of the face, eyes, ears, skull, central nervous system, cardiovascular system, and thymus and parathyroid glands or IQ less than score of 85 have been reported in female patients who were pregnant or became pregnant while on therapy with isotretinoin. Therefore, ACUTRET 5MG CAPSULE is considered unsafe for use during pregnancy.
Women of childbearing potential must use a reliable contraceptive method to avoid becoming pregnant. If you accidentally became pregnant while taking this medicine, stop taking it and consult your gynaecologist for further evaluation.
It is also not recommended for you to get pregnant for one month after stopping isotretinoin tablets because some medicine may still be left in your body. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Introduction About SALID 12 OINTMENT

SALID 12 OINTMENT contains Salicylic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Keratolytic agents. SALID 12 OINTMENT is used manage skin conditions such as psoriasis, dry, scaly skin conditions and acne. It is also used to manage dandruff, corn and calluses (thickened layers of skin) in affected individuals.

SALID 12 OINTMENT is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Salicylic acid. It is also not recommended for use in patients with active inflammation/dermatitis, infection (at the application site), acute viral infection, skin malignancy, and/or tanned skin. Before applying SALID 12 OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for surgery, and/or suffering from any kidney problems. SALID 12 OINTMENT is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women. If you are a breastfeeding women, consult your doctor before using the medicine. Avoid applying the medicine on skin areas which might come in direct contact with infant’s skin.

SALID 12 OINTMENT should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 1-15 years). It is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before applying the medicine. The most common side effects of applying SALID 12 OINTMENT are erythema (skin redness) or skin dryness. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

Introduction About PAPULEX CREAM

Papulex Cream is an oil-free cream that provides an effective and complete skincare regimen for managing acne. It mainly contains nicotinamide and zinc that effectively helps to control inflammation, reduce oil secretion, fight against acne-causing bacteria, lessen the risk of scarring and moisturize the skin.  

Nicotinamide is an anti-inflammatory agent that reduces acne by reducing sebum. It improves skin barrier function by reducing water loss through the epidermis (the outer skin layer) thus enhancing skin hydration. It also improves complexion by improving the pigmentation, blotchiness and redness of aging skin. Zinc suppresses sebum production through its antiandrogenic activity and helps the skin to shine.  

Always use Papulex Cream as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply required quantity of the cream on face and affected areas after cleansing, use twice a day. Massage delicately to facilitate absorption. Do not use it if you are allergic to any of its components.

introduction:
Introduction About SAFERET 20 TABLET

SAFERET 20 TABLET contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take SAFERET 20 TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

SAFERET 20 TABLET is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.
uses: Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
usesDetails:
Uses Of SAFERET 20 TABLET
Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of SAFERET 20 TABLET for Acne:

SAFERET 20 TABLET is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How SAFERET 20 TABLET Works

SAFERET 20 TABLET work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

Birth defects such as abnormalities of the face, eyes, ears, skull, central nervous system, cardiovascular system, and thymus and parathyroid glands or IQ less than score of 85 have been reported in female patients who were pregnant or became pregnant while on therapy with isotretinoin. name: Nilac Gel 20gm
introduction:
Introduction About NILAC GEL

NILAC GEL is a combination of Clindamycin and Nicotinamide which belongs to a group of medicines called Lincomycin antibiotics and Vitamin B3 complex, respectively. NILAC GEL is used to manage mild to moderate acne which is a skin condition that occurs when hair follicles become plugged with oil and dead skin cells which may occur due to variety of causes such as genetics, fluctuating hormone levels, stress, high humidity or using oily or greasy personal care products which may affect people of all ages.

It is characterized by symptoms such as open or closed plugged pores, small red & tender bumps, pimples, large, solid or painful lumps under the skin and painful & pus-filled lumps under the skin.

Before using NILAC GEL inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, lung or heart diseases. Avoid applying NILAC GEL to a cut, scrapped, sunburnt or eczema affected skin.

NILAC GEL should be used with caution in pregnant and in breastfeeding women. NILAC GEL is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 12 years). Consult your doctor before applying.

The most common side effects of using NILAC GEL are skin inflammation, contact dermatitis (red, itchy rash), inflammation of hair follicles, itchy skin, dry skin and peeling of skin. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage mild to moderate acne
usesDetails:
Uses Of NILAC GEL
Manage mild to moderate acne
mechanismOfAction:
How NILAC GEL Works

NILAC GEL helps to manage acne, where Clindamycin reduces free fatty acid concentrations on the skin and suppresses the growth of Propionibacterium acnes (Corynebacterium acnes), a bacteria found in sebaceous glands and follicles and Nicotinamide exerts anti-inflammatory effect in acne and interrupts sebum production.
usageDetails:
How to use NILAC GEL

Apply NILAC GEL as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Before applying the medicine normally wash and dry the affected area and apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area. Managed areas on the face need not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Do not apply this medicine beyond the recommended duration. Avoid applying NILAC GEL around your eyes, including eyelids. Rinse it off with water if you accidentally get it in these areas.

Before using BENCLEAR 2.5% GEL, inform your doctor if you are having any allergy to foods, preservatives or dyes or if you are already under any medication for acne.

It is not recommended to use hard cleansers, scrubs, medicated soap or cosmetic products containing alcohol while using this medicine.

BENCLEAR 2.5% GEL is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless clearly needed. Consult your doctor before using the medicine.

Avoid repeated exposure to sunlight or other sources of UV light (such as sun bed). In case of accidental contact, rinse thoroughly with warm water and pat dry.

Most common side effects of BENCLEAR 2.5% GEL are skin redness and irriation, burning, stinging sensation in the skin. Consult your doctor if any of above symptoms worsens.

How BENCLEAR 2.5% GEL Works

BENCLEAR 2.5% GEL works against the acne-causing bacteria. This medicine after applying on the affected skin gets absorbed and is converted to benzoic acid. This benzoic acid gets metabolized by skin proteins and releases active free-radical oxygen species that results in the alteration of bacterial proteins. This helps to manage acne or pimples. BENCLEAR 2.5% GEL also acts as a keratolytic agent which promotes peeling of the skin and absorb excess oil from the skin further managing acne formation and skin irritation.

Avoid contact with eyes, lips, mouth, nose, mucous membranes and sensitive areas of the neck. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: CLITINA Gel 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About CLITINA GEL

CLITINA GEL is a combination of Clindamycin and Nicotinamide which belongs to a group of medicines called Lincomycin antibiotics and Vitamin B3 complex, respectively. CLITINA GEL is used to manage mild to moderate acne which is a skin condition that occurs when hair follicles become plugged with oil and dead skin cells which may occur due to variety of causes such as genetics, fluctuating hormone levels, stress, high humidity or using oily or greasy personal care products which may affect people of all ages.

It is characterized by symptoms such as open or closed plugged pores, small red & tender bumps, pimples, large, solid or painful lumps under the skin and painful & pus-filled lumps under the skin.

Before using CLITINA GEL inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, lung or heart diseases. Avoid applying CLITINA GEL to a cut, scrapped, sunburnt or eczema affected skin.

CLITINA GEL should be used with caution in pregnant and in breastfeeding women. CLITINA GEL is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 12 years). Consult your doctor before applying.

The most common side effects of using CLITINA GEL are skin inflammation, contact dermatitis (red, itchy rash), inflammation of hair follicles, itchy skin, dry skin and peeling of skin. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

CLITINA GEL helps to manage acne, where Clindamycin reduces free fatty acid concentrations on the skin and suppresses the growth of Propionibacterium acnes (Corynebacterium acnes), a bacteria found in sebaceous glands and follicles and Nicotinamide exerts anti-inflammatory effect in acne and interrupts sebum production.

Apply CLITINA GEL as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Before applying the medicine normally wash and dry the affected area and apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area. Managed areas on the face need not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Do not apply this medicine beyond the recommended duration. Avoid applying CLITINA GEL around your eyes, including eyelids. Rinse it off with water if you accidentally get it in these areas.

name: ELOSONE HT Cream 25gm
introduction:
Introduction About ELOSONE HT CREAM

ELOSONE HT CREAM is a combination of Hydroquinone, Tretinoin, Mometasone furoate which belongs to the group of medicines called Depigmenting agents, Retinoids and Corticosteroids respectively. It is used in adults for the management of moderate to severe melasma (dark spots on the skin) in association with sun-avoidance measures, like using sunscreens and wearing protective clothing. Melasma is one of the most frequently acquired hyperpigmentation (excess melanin production) disorders with symptoms such as symmetrical brown patches on sun exposed areas mainly on face.

It is advised to avoid exposure to sun during management with ELOSONE HT CREAM for better results. While going out apply sunscreens and wear full covering protective clothes. Before using ELOSONE HT CREAM inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung or heart diseases.

Safety and efficacy of ELOSONE HT CREAM is not established in pregnant women and in children below 12 years of age. Ask for your doctor’s advice before using. ELOSONE HT CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of using ELOSONE HT CREAM are mild burning, stinging, redness and dryness. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.
uses: Manages moderate to severe melasma (dark spots on the skin)
usesDetails:
Uses Of ELOSONE HT CREAM

It is used in adults to

Manages moderate to severe melasma (dark spots on the skin)
mechanismOfAction:
How ELOSONE HT CREAM Works

ELOSONE HT CREAM helps in managing melasma where Hydroquinone is a skin bleaching agent that blocks enzyme tyrosinase which is responsible for the production of melanin that cause pigmentation. Thus, it helps for fading of dark spots in skin. Tretinoin helps to recover the damage to the skin caused by sun exposure (photodamage) by thickening skin layer and loss of keratinized cells.it helps to rejuvenate the skin. Mometasone furoate blocks prostaglandin synthesis and reduces redness, swelling and itching caused by tretinoin and other skin infections.
usageDetails:
How to use ELOSONE HT CREAM

Apply ELOSONE HT CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before and after applying ELOSONE HT CREAM. Wash your face with a mild soap and dry properly. Apply ELOSONE HT CREAM at night and gently massage it in until it is absorbed. Avoid contact with your eyes, nose, mouth, mucous membrane. Avoid exposure to sunlight while using this medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

faqs.answer: A: ELOSONE HT CREAM is used in adults for the management of moderate to severe melasma (dark spots on the skin) in association with sun-avoidance measures, like using sunscreens and wearing protective clothing. Consult doctor before using.

faqs.question: Q: Can I use ELOSONE HT CREAM to manage wounds?

Always use Acnejoy Face Wash as advised by the doctor. It is for external use only. Wet the face and take an adequate amount of face wash on to your palm and gently apply it on face and massage for 2 minutes. Rinse thoroughly with water and dab your face dry with a clean towel.

name: Exazel 15% Cream 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About EXAZEL 15% CREAM

EXAZEL 15% CREAM contains Azelaic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Dicarboxylic acids. It is used to manage common acne (acne vulgaris). It is also used for the management of mild to moderate papulopustular rosacea.

Acne is a skin condition that occurs when the hair follicles become plugged with oil and dead skin cells. It causes whiteheads, blackheads or pimples. Rosacea is a skin condition that causes blushing or redness, pus-filled bumps and small visible blood vessels in the face.

EXAZEL 15% CREAM should be applied with caution in patients with lung problems such as asthma. Consult your doctor before applying it.

Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before applying this medicine. Your doctor will decide whether you can use this medicine.

EXAZEL 15% CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children under 12 years of age for the management of acne and also not recommended for use in children under 18 years of age for the management of rosacea. Consult your doctor before applying it.

The most common side effects of applying EXAZEL 15% CREAM are burning, itching or redness of the skin (erythema) at the application site, scaling, pain, dryness, skin discolouration or irritation at the application site. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

EXAZEL 15% CREAM attacks the bacteria called propionibacterium acnes, which plays an essential part in causing acne. It also reduces growth of the harder outermost skin cells (keratin surface cells) that block the pores of the skin to cause blackheads and whiteheads.
usageDetails:
How to use EXAZEL 15% CREAM

Apply EXAZEL 15% CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water before and after using EXAZEL 15% CREAM. Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area and rub it gently into the skin.

Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, mouth and other mucous membranes or open wounds. If it does, wash the eyes, mouth or other mucous membranes immediately with large amounts of cool water.

introduction:
Introduction About PINOIN

PINOIN contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take PINOIN exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

PINOIN is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.
uses: Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
usesDetails:
Uses Of PINOIN
Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of PINOIN for Acne:

PINOIN is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How PINOIN Works

PINOIN work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

What if I Forget to take PINOIN:

If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose—do not double the dose to make up for it.

Overdosage of PINOIN –

In case you or anybody else accidently take too much of PINOIN, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of PINOIN overdose are severe headache, abdominal pain, nausea, dizziness, redness of face, vomiting, somnolence, irritability, and itching.

Warning & Precautions
Pregnancy
CONTRAINDICATED
Human and animal studies have shown that isotretinoin is teratogenic in nature. Birth defects such as abnormalities of the face, eyes, ears, skull, central nervous system, cardiovascular system, and thymus and parathyroid glands or IQ less than score of 85 have been reported in female patients who were pregnant or became pregnant while on therapy with isotretinoin. Therefore, PINOIN is considered unsafe for use during pregnancy.
Women of childbearing potential must use a reliable contraceptive method to avoid becoming pregnant. If you accidentally became pregnant while taking this medicine, stop taking it and consult your gynaecologist for further evaluation.
It is also not recommended for you to get pregnant for one month after stopping isotretinoin tablets because some medicine may still be left in your body. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About CLIGEL N GEL

CLIGEL N GEL is a combination of Clindamycin and Nicotinamide which belongs to a group of medicines called Lincomycin antibiotics and Vitamin B3 complex, respectively. CLIGEL N GEL is used to manage mild to moderate acne which is a skin condition that occurs when hair follicles become plugged with oil and dead skin cells which may occur due to variety of causes such as genetics, fluctuating hormone levels, stress, high humidity or using oily or greasy personal care products which may affect people of all ages.

It is characterized by symptoms such as open or closed plugged pores, small red & tender bumps, pimples, large, solid or painful lumps under the skin and painful & pus-filled lumps under the skin.

Before using CLIGEL N GEL inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, lung or heart diseases. Avoid applying CLIGEL N GEL to a cut, scrapped, sunburnt or eczema affected skin.

CLIGEL N GEL should be used with caution in pregnant and in breastfeeding women. CLIGEL N GEL is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 12 years). Consult your doctor before applying.

The most common side effects of using CLIGEL N GEL are skin inflammation, contact dermatitis (red, itchy rash), inflammation of hair follicles, itchy skin, dry skin and peeling of skin. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

Manage mild to moderate acne
mechanismOfAction:

CLIGEL N GEL helps to manage acne, where Clindamycin reduces free fatty acid concentrations on the skin and suppresses the growth of Propionibacterium acnes (Corynebacterium acnes), a bacteria found in sebaceous glands and follicles and Nicotinamide exerts anti-inflammatory effect in acne and interrupts sebum production.

Apply CLIGEL N GEL as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Before applying the medicine normally wash and dry the affected area and apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area. Managed areas on the face need not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Do not apply this medicine beyond the recommended duration. Avoid applying CLIGEL N GEL around your eyes, including eyelids. Rinse it off with water if you accidentally get it in these areas.

introduction:
Introduction About DERSOL 24% OINTMENT

DERSOL 24% OINTMENT contains Salicylic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Keratolytic agents. DERSOL 24% OINTMENT is used manage skin conditions such as acne, blemishes (discolored spot-on skin), skin redness, and other skin diseases.

It is also used to manage dandruff, corn & calluses (thickened layers of skin) in affected individuals.

DERSOL 24% OINTMENT is not recommended for use in patients allergic to salicylic acid. It is also not recommended for use in patients with active inflammation/dermatitis, infection (at the application site), acute viral infection, skin malignancy, and/or tanned skin.

Before applying DERSOL 24% OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for surgery, and/or suffering from any kidney problems.

DERSOL 24% OINTMENT is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women. It is considered to be safe to be used in breastfeeding women. Avoid applying the medicine on skin areas which might come in direct contact with infant’s skin.

DERSOL 24% OINTMENT should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 1-15 years). It is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before applying the medicine.

The most common side effects of applying DERSOL 24% OINTMENT are erythema (skin redness), and/or dryness of skin. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About TAZRET 0.05/ GEL(TOPICAL)

TAZRET 0.05/ GEL(TOPICAL) contains Tazarotene which belongs to the group of medicines called Retinoids. It is used to topically manage plaque psoriasis and acne vulgaris. Plaque psoriasis is a skin disease that causes dry, itchy, raised skin patches (plaques) covered with scales. Acne vulgaris is a common, usually self-limiting disease that causes inflammation of the sebaceous follicles of the face and upper body.

Before using TAZRET 0.05/ GEL(TOPICAL), inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, or heart problems, eczema, or other skin problems. TAZRET 0.05/ GEL(TOPICAL) is not recommended for use among pregnant women. TAZRET 0.05/ GEL(TOPICAL) should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using it.

It is not known if TAZRET 0.05/ GEL(TOPICAL) is safe and effective for use in children and adolescents under 12 years of age. TAZRET 0.05/ GEL(TOPICAL) for the management of acne has not been clinically evaluated in elderly patients (over 65 years).

The most common side effects of using TAZRET 0.05/ GEL(TOPICAL) are itching, burning, redness, worsening of psoriasis, irritation, skin pain, peeling, and dry skin. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

How TAZRET 0.05/ GEL(TOPICAL) Works

TAZRET 0.05/ GEL(TOPICAL) is converted to its active form, tazarotenic acid, that binds to all three members of the retinoic acid receptor (RAR) family (RARa, RARβ, and RARγ) and may modify gene expression.

name: PICSPOT Gel 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About PICSPOT GEL

PICSPOT GEL contains Azelaic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Dicarboxylic acids. It is used to manage common acne (acne vulgaris). It is also used for the management of mild to moderate papulopustular rosacea.

Acne is a skin condition that occurs when the hair follicles become plugged with oil and dead skin cells. It causes whiteheads, blackheads or pimples. Rosacea is a skin condition that causes blushing or redness, pus-filled bumps and small visible blood vessels in the face.

PICSPOT GEL should be applied with caution in patients with lung problems such as asthma. Consult your doctor before applying it.

Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before applying this medicine. Your doctor will decide whether you can use this medicine.

PICSPOT GEL is generally not recommended for use in children under 12 years of age for the management of acne and also not recommended for use in children under 18 years of age for the management of rosacea. Consult your doctor before applying it.

The most common side effects of applying PICSPOT GEL are burning, itching or redness of the skin (erythema) at the application site, scaling, pain, dryness, skin discolouration or irritation at the application site. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Common acne (acne vulgaris)
Mild to moderate papulopustular rosacea
usesDetails:
Uses Of PICSPOT GEL
Common acne (acne vulgaris)
Mild to moderate papulopustular rosacea
mechanismOfAction:
How PICSPOT GEL Works

PICSPOT GEL attacks the bacteria called propionibacterium acnes, which plays an essential part in causing acne. It also reduces growth of the harder outermost skin cells (keratin surface cells) that block the pores of the skin to cause blackheads and whiteheads.
usageDetails:
How to use PICSPOT GEL

Apply PICSPOT GEL as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water before and after using PICSPOT GEL. Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area and rub it gently into the skin.

Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, mouth and other mucous membranes or open wounds. If it does, wash the eyes, mouth or other mucous membranes immediately with large amounts of cool water.

Introduction About TRONIN MS GEL

TRONIN MS GEL contains Tretinoin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Retinoids. It is used to manage acne. It can also be used to manage wrinkles, skin spots and rough skin. Acne is defined as a skin disease involving inflammation of the sebaceous follicles of the face and upper body, characterized by lesions on the face, back, upper chest and shoulders.

Before using TRONIN MS GEL, inform your doctor if you have any sunburn, sun sensitivity or any other skin problems. TRONIN MS GEL should be used in pregnancy only if specifically directed by your doctor. TRONIN MS GEL should be used with caution in breastfeeding women.

The safety and effectiveness of TRONIN MS GEL in children (aged less than 12 years) have not been established, so consult your doctor before using it. The most common side effect of using TRONIN MS GEL is skin irritation like redness, burning, stinging, dryness and peeling. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Aknaybar Bathing Bar helps to manage acne or pimples. It contains Syndet base, Benzoyl peroxide, Zinc PCA and Azelaic acid as active ingredients.

introduction:
Introduction About CLINDAMYCIN PHOSPHATE (NANZ) GEL

CLINDAMYCIN PHOSPHATE (NANZ) GEL contains Clindamycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of acne vulgaris. Acne vulgaris is a common skin condition that occurs when hair follicles get blocked with oil and dead skin cells. Symptoms include whiteheads, blackheads, small red, tender bumps, pimples, and pus-filled lumps on the skin.

Before applying CLINDAMYCIN PHOSPHATE (NANZ) GEL, inform your doctor if you have or ever had diarrhea, bloody diarrhea and pseudomembranous colitis. CLINDAMYCIN PHOSPHATE (NANZ) GEL is not recommended for use if you have a history of regional enteritis (inflammation of the small intestine), ulcerative colitis (inflammation of the large intestine) or antibiotic-associated colitis.

CLINDAMYCIN PHOSPHATE (NANZ) GEL should be used with caution during pregnancy or by breastfeeding women only if clearly needed. The safety and effectiveness of CLINDAMYCIN PHOSPHATE (NANZ) GEL in children under the age of 12 has not been established. The most common side effects of applying CLINDAMYCIN PHOSPHATE (NANZ) GEL are burning, itching, and redness of the skin. Consult your doctor if symptoms worsen.

How CLINDAMYCIN PHOSPHATE (NANZ) GEL Works

CLINDAMYCIN PHOSPHATE (NANZ) GEL acts against the bacteria by binding to the 50S subunit of the bacterial ribosome (site of protein synthesis), which in turn manages protein synthesis and works against the infection-causing bacteria.

Wash and dry the whole area, apply a thin film once daily to the skin where acne lesions appear and use enough to cover the entire affected area. In case of contact with the eyes, mouth or nostrils, rinse it off immediately and thoroughly with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DREMZ CREAM

DREMZ CREAM is a combination of Hydroquinone, Tretinoin, Mometasone furoate which belongs to the group of medicines called Depigmenting agents, Retinoids and Corticosteroids respectively. It is used in adults for the management of moderate to severe melasma (dark spots on the skin) in association with sun-avoidance measures, like using sunscreens and wearing protective clothing. Melasma is one of the most frequently acquired hyperpigmentation (excess melanin production) disorders with symptoms such as symmetrical brown patches on sun exposed areas mainly on face.

It is advised to avoid exposure to sun during management with DREMZ CREAM for better results. While going out apply sunscreens and wear full covering protective clothes. Before using DREMZ CREAM inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung or heart diseases.

Safety and efficacy of DREMZ CREAM is not established in pregnant women and in children below 12 years of age. Ask for your doctor’s advice before using. DREMZ CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of using DREMZ CREAM are mild burning, stinging, redness and dryness. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.
uses: Manages moderate to severe melasma (dark spots on the skin)
