Uses Of DREMZ CREAM

It is used in adults to

Manages moderate to severe melasma (dark spots on the skin)
mechanismOfAction:
How DREMZ CREAM Works

DREMZ CREAM helps in managing melasma where Hydroquinone is a skin bleaching agent that blocks enzyme tyrosinase which is responsible for the production of melanin that cause pigmentation. Thus, it helps for fading of dark spots in skin. Tretinoin helps to recover the damage to the skin caused by sun exposure (photodamage) by thickening skin layer and loss of keratinized cells.it helps to rejuvenate the skin. Mometasone furoate blocks prostaglandin synthesis and reduces redness, swelling and itching caused by tretinoin and other skin infections.
usageDetails:
How to use DREMZ CREAM

Apply DREMZ CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before and after applying DREMZ CREAM. Wash your face with a mild soap and dry properly. Apply DREMZ CREAM at night and gently massage it in until it is absorbed. Avoid contact with your eyes, nose, mouth, mucous membrane. Avoid exposure to sunlight while using this medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About SOTRET NF 8 CAPSULE

SOTRET NF 8 CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take SOTRET NF 8 CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

SOTRET NF 8 CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.
uses: Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
usesDetails:
Uses Of SOTRET NF 8 CAPSULE
Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of SOTRET NF 8 CAPSULE for Acne:

SOTRET NF 8 CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How SOTRET NF 8 CAPSULE Works

SOTRET NF 8 CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

Swallow the capsule whole with a glass of water; do not crush or chew it.

What if I Forget to take SOTRET NF 8 CAPSULE:

If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose—do not double the dose to make up for it.

Overdosage of SOTRET NF 8 CAPSULE –

In case you or anybody else accidently take too much of SOTRET NF 8 CAPSULE, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of SOTRET NF 8 CAPSULE overdose are severe headache, abdominal pain, nausea, dizziness, redness of face, vomiting, somnolence, irritability, and itching.

warningsRaw:
Warning & Precautions
Pregnancy
CONTRAINDICATED
Human and animal studies have shown that isotretinoin is teratogenic in nature. Birth defects such as abnormalities of the face, eyes, ears, skull, central nervous system, cardiovascular system, and thymus and parathyroid glands or IQ less than score of 85 have been reported in female patients who were pregnant or became pregnant while on therapy with isotretinoin. Therefore, SOTRET NF 8 CAPSULE is considered unsafe for use during pregnancy.
Women of childbearing potential must use a reliable contraceptive method to avoid becoming pregnant. If you accidentally became pregnant while taking this medicine, stop taking it and consult your gynaecologist for further evaluation.
It is also not recommended for you to get pregnant for one month after stopping isotretinoin tablets because some medicine may still be left in your body. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About PEROBAR 5% BAR

Perobar Soap is a cleansing soap used to manage acne. It is also used to soothe, cleanse, or nourish the skin. It contains Benzoyl Peroxide as active ingredient that kills the infection causing bacteria, removes dirt, excess oil and unclog pores.

Benzoyl Peroxide gets converted into benzoic acid which releases active free-radical oxygen. These free radicals interfere with important bacterial function and survival, hence killing them. It also increases the turnover rate of skin cells which helps in managing acne.

Use Perobar Soap as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wet the skin and apply it on the affected areas. Work up a good lather with it and leave for few minutes, then rinse with water and pat dry the application area. Use it 2-3 times daily. Do not exceed the daily recommended dosages. Consult your doctor if you experience any allergic reactions while using it.
sideEffectsDetails:

Introduction About TAZRET FORTE 0.1/ CREAM

TAZRET FORTE 0.1/ CREAM contains Tazarotene which belongs to the group of medicines called Retinoids. It is used to topically manage plaque psoriasis and acne vulgaris. Plaque psoriasis is a skin disease that causes dry, itchy, raised skin patches (plaques) covered with scales. Acne vulgaris is a common, usually self-limiting disease that causes inflammation of the sebaceous follicles of the face and upper body.

Before using TAZRET FORTE 0.1/ CREAM, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, or heart problems, eczema, or other skin problems. TAZRET FORTE 0.1/ CREAM is not recommended for use among pregnant women. TAZRET FORTE 0.1/ CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using it.

It is not known if TAZRET FORTE 0.1/ CREAM is safe and effective for use in children and adolescents under 12 years of age. TAZRET FORTE 0.1/ CREAM for the management of acne has not been clinically evaluated in elderly patients (over 65 years).

The most common side effects of using TAZRET FORTE 0.1/ CREAM are itching, burning, redness, worsening of psoriasis, irritation, skin pain, peeling, and dry skin. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About SAFERET 10 TABLET

SAFERET 10 TABLET contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take SAFERET 10 TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

SAFERET 10 TABLET is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.

usesDetails:
Uses Of SAFERET 10 TABLET
Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of SAFERET 10 TABLET for Acne:

SAFERET 10 TABLET is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How SAFERET 10 TABLET Works

SAFERET 10 TABLET work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

introduction:
Introduction About ACNETOIN GEL

ACNETOIN GEL is a combination of Clindamycin and Nicotinamide which belongs to a group of medicines called Lincomycin antibiotics and Vitamin B3 complex, respectively. ACNETOIN GEL is used to manage mild to moderate acne which is a skin condition that occurs when hair follicles become plugged with oil and dead skin cells which may occur due to variety of causes such as genetics, fluctuating hormone levels, stress, high humidity or using oily or greasy personal care products which may affect people of all ages.

It is characterized by symptoms such as open or closed plugged pores, small red & tender bumps, pimples, large, solid or painful lumps under the skin and painful & pus-filled lumps under the skin.

Before using ACNETOIN GEL inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, lung or heart diseases. Avoid applying ACNETOIN GEL to a cut, scrapped, sunburnt or eczema affected skin.

ACNETOIN GEL should be used with caution in pregnant and in breastfeeding women. ACNETOIN GEL is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 12 years). Consult your doctor before applying.

The most common side effects of using ACNETOIN GEL are skin inflammation, contact dermatitis (red, itchy rash), inflammation of hair follicles, itchy skin, dry skin and peeling of skin. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

Manage mild to moderate acne

Managed areas on the face need not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Do not apply this medicine beyond the recommended duration. Avoid applying ACNETOIN GEL around your eyes, including eyelids. Rinse it off with water if you accidentally get it in these areas.

introduction:
Introduction About METASONE PLUS CREAM

METASONE PLUS CREAM is a combination of Hydroquinone, Tretinoin, Mometasone furoate which belongs to the group of medicines called Depigmenting agents, Retinoids and Corticosteroids respectively. It is used in adults for the management of moderate to severe melasma (dark spots on the skin) in association with sun-avoidance measures, like using sunscreens and wearing protective clothing. Melasma is one of the most frequently acquired hyperpigmentation (excess melanin production) disorders with symptoms such as symmetrical brown patches on sun exposed areas mainly on face.

It is advised to avoid exposure to sun during management with METASONE PLUS CREAM for better results. While going out apply sunscreens and wear full covering protective clothes. Before using METASONE PLUS CREAM inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung or heart diseases.

Safety and efficacy of METASONE PLUS CREAM is not established in pregnant women and in children below 12 years of age. Ask for your doctor’s advice before using. METASONE PLUS CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of using METASONE PLUS CREAM are mild burning, stinging, redness and dryness. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.
uses: Manages moderate to severe melasma (dark spots on the skin)
usesDetails:

It is used in adults to

Manages moderate to severe melasma (dark spots on the skin)
mechanismOfAction:
How METASONE PLUS CREAM Works

METASONE PLUS CREAM helps in managing melasma where Hydroquinone is a skin bleaching agent that blocks enzyme tyrosinase which is responsible for the production of melanin that cause pigmentation. Thus, it helps for fading of dark spots in skin. Tretinoin helps to recover the damage to the skin caused by sun exposure (photodamage) by thickening skin layer and loss of keratinized cells.it helps to rejuvenate the skin. Mometasone furoate blocks prostaglandin synthesis and reduces redness, swelling and itching caused by tretinoin and other skin infections.
usageDetails:

Apply METASONE PLUS CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before and after applying METASONE PLUS CREAM. Wash your face with a mild soap and dry properly. Apply METASONE PLUS CREAM at night and gently massage it in until it is absorbed. Avoid contact with your eyes, nose, mouth, mucous membrane. Avoid exposure to sunlight while using this medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About SAFERET 5 TABLET

SAFERET 5 TABLET contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take SAFERET 5 TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

SAFERET 5 TABLET is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.

Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of SAFERET 5 TABLET for Acne:

SAFERET 5 TABLET is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How SAFERET 5 TABLET Works

SAFERET 5 TABLET work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

Introduction About CLEARGEL GEL

CLEARGEL GEL contains Clindamycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of acne vulgaris. Acne vulgaris is a common skin condition that occurs when hair follicles get blocked with oil and dead skin cells. Symptoms include whiteheads, blackheads, small red, tender bumps, pimples, and pus-filled lumps on the skin.

Before applying CLEARGEL GEL, inform your doctor if you have or ever had diarrhea, bloody diarrhea and pseudomembranous colitis. CLEARGEL GEL is not recommended for use if you have a history of regional enteritis (inflammation of the small intestine), ulcerative colitis (inflammation of the large intestine) or antibiotic-associated colitis.

CLEARGEL GEL should be used with caution during pregnancy or by breastfeeding women only if clearly needed. The safety and effectiveness of CLEARGEL GEL in children under the age of 12 has not been established. The most common side effects of applying CLEARGEL GEL are burning, itching, and redness of the skin. Consult your doctor if symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About ISO ARET 20MG SOFTGEL

ISO ARET 20MG SOFTGEL contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take ISO ARET 20MG SOFTGEL exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

ISO ARET 20MG SOFTGEL is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.
uses: Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
usesDetails:
Uses Of ISO ARET 20MG SOFTGEL
Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of ISO ARET 20MG SOFTGEL for Acne:

ISO ARET 20MG SOFTGEL is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How ISO ARET 20MG SOFTGEL Works

ISO ARET 20MG SOFTGEL work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

Swallow the capsule whole with a glass of water; do not crush or chew it.

Regular follow-ups and blood tests may be required to monitor your progress and ensure safe usage.
Avoid alcohol, excessive sun exposure, and waxing or laser treatments during the treatment period. Use sunscreen and moisturizers as recommended by your doctor.

What if I Forget to take ISO ARET 20MG SOFTGEL:

If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose—do not double the dose to make up for it.

Overdosage of ISO ARET 20MG SOFTGEL –

In case you or anybody else accidently take too much of ISO ARET 20MG SOFTGEL, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of ISO ARET 20MG SOFTGEL overdose are severe headache, abdominal pain, nausea, dizziness, redness of face, vomiting, somnolence, irritability, and itching.

warningsRaw:
Warning & Precautions
Pregnancy
CONTRAINDICATED
Human and animal studies have shown that isotretinoin is teratogenic in nature. Birth defects such as abnormalities of the face, eyes, ears, skull, central nervous system, cardiovascular system, and thymus and parathyroid glands or IQ less than score of 85 have been reported in female patients who were pregnant or became pregnant while on therapy with isotretinoin. Therefore, ISO ARET 20MG SOFTGEL is considered unsafe for use during pregnancy.
Women of childbearing potential must use a reliable contraceptive method to avoid becoming pregnant. If you accidentally became pregnant while taking this medicine, stop taking it and consult your gynaecologist for further evaluation.
It is also not recommended for you to get pregnant for one month after stopping isotretinoin tablets because some medicine may still be left in your body. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Breastfeeding
CONTRAINDICATED

It is not known whether this medicine is excreted in human milk. Because of the potential for adverse effects, nursing mothers should not receive ISO ARET 20MG SOFTGEL

Introduction About MEGANOIN 20MG SOFTGEL

MEGANOIN 20MG SOFTGEL contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take MEGANOIN 20MG SOFTGEL exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

MEGANOIN 20MG SOFTGEL is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.

Benefits of MEGANOIN 20MG SOFTGEL for Acne:

MEGANOIN 20MG SOFTGEL is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How MEGANOIN 20MG SOFTGEL Works

MEGANOIN 20MG SOFTGEL work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

introduction:
Introduction About DERIVA BPO GEL

DERIVA BPO GEL is used in the management of acne. It is a combination of Adapalene and Benzoyl peroxide, which belong to the group of medicines called Antiacne agents. It modulates the skin cell cycle and manages the accumulation of excess sebum (natural oil produced by the skin) and dead skin cells on the hair follicles of the skin. It also reduces inflammation on the skin. It improves the skin's tendency to naturally exfoliate dead skin cells. It also reduces the number of acne-causing bacteria on the skin, which can reduce the further spread of acne. Collectively, they unclog the hair follicles of the skin and exfoliate dead skin cells, which reduces acne breakouts.

DERIVA BPO GEL is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 9 years or older). Apply a thin layer of DERIVA BPO GEL on the affected skin areas. Avoid contact with this medicine with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose, or open wounds. You must also protect your skin against sun light and other light sources (such as UV lamps).

Do not use DERIVA BPO GEL if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or plan to have a baby. DERIVA BPO GEL can be used for breastfeeding women if required. The most common side effects of using DERIVA BPO GEL are dry skin, a mild burning sensation, skin irritation, redness, or scaling. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

Collectively, they unclog the hair follicles of the skin and exfoliate dead skin cells, which reduces acne breakouts.

introduction:
Introduction About TRETIVA 25MG CAPSULE

TRETIVA 25MG CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take TRETIVA 25MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

TRETIVA 25MG CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.
uses: Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRETIVA 25MG CAPSULE
Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of TRETIVA 25MG CAPSULE for Acne:

TRETIVA 25MG CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How TRETIVA 25MG CAPSULE Works

TRETIVA 25MG CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

Pregnancy
CONTRAINDICATED
Human and animal studies have shown that isotretinoin is teratogenic in nature. Birth defects such as abnormalities of the face, eyes, ears, skull, central nervous system, cardiovascular system, and thymus and parathyroid glands or IQ less than score of 85 have been reported in female patients who were pregnant or became pregnant while on therapy with isotretinoin. Therefore, TRETIVA 25MG CAPSULE is considered unsafe for use during pregnancy.
Women of childbearing potential must use a reliable contraceptive method to avoid becoming pregnant. If you accidentally became pregnant while taking this medicine, stop taking it and consult your gynaecologist for further evaluation.
It is also not recommended for you to get pregnant for one month after stopping isotretinoin tablets because some medicine may still be left in your body. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About AKNEGATE CN GEL

AKNEGATE CN GEL is a combination of Clindamycin and Nicotinamide which belongs to a group of medicines called Lincomycin antibiotics and Vitamin B3 complex, respectively. AKNEGATE CN GEL is used to manage mild to moderate acne which is a skin condition that occurs when hair follicles become plugged with oil and dead skin cells which may occur due to variety of causes such as genetics, fluctuating hormone levels, stress, high humidity or using oily or greasy personal care products which may affect people of all ages.

It is characterized by symptoms such as open or closed plugged pores, small red & tender bumps, pimples, large, solid or painful lumps under the skin and painful & pus-filled lumps under the skin.

Before using AKNEGATE CN GEL inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, lung or heart diseases. Avoid applying AKNEGATE CN GEL to a cut, scrapped, sunburnt or eczema affected skin.

AKNEGATE CN GEL should be used with caution in pregnant and in breastfeeding women. AKNEGATE CN GEL is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 12 years). Consult your doctor before applying.

The most common side effects of using AKNEGATE CN GEL are skin inflammation, contact dermatitis (red, itchy rash), inflammation of hair follicles, itchy skin, dry skin and peeling of skin. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

usesDetails:

Manage mild to moderate acne
mechanismOfAction:
How AKNEGATE CN GEL Works

AKNEGATE CN GEL helps to manage acne, where Clindamycin reduces free fatty acid concentrations on the skin and suppresses the growth of Propionibacterium acnes (Corynebacterium acnes), a bacteria found in sebaceous glands and follicles and Nicotinamide exerts anti-inflammatory effect in acne and interrupts sebum production.

How to use AKNEGATE CN GEL

Apply AKNEGATE CN GEL as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Before applying the medicine normally wash and dry the affected area and apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area. Managed areas on the face need not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Do not apply this medicine beyond the recommended duration. Avoid applying AKNEGATE CN GEL around your eyes, including eyelids. Rinse it off with water if you accidentally get it in these areas.

introduction:
Introduction About DERSOL 30% OINTMENT

DERSOL 30% OINTMENT contains Salicylic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Keratolytic agents. DERSOL 30% OINTMENT is used manage skin conditions such as acne, blemishes (discolored spot-on skin), skin redness, and other skin diseases.

It is also used to manage dandruff, corn & calluses (thickened layers of skin) in affected individuals.

DERSOL 30% OINTMENT is not recommended for use in patients allergic to salicylic acid. It is also not recommended for use in patients with active inflammation/dermatitis, infection (at the application site), acute viral infection, skin malignancy, and/or tanned skin.

Before applying DERSOL 30% OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for surgery, and/or suffering from any kidney problems.

DERSOL 30% OINTMENT is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women. It is considered to be safe to be used in breastfeeding women. Avoid applying the medicine on skin areas which might come in direct contact with infant’s skin.

DERSOL 30% OINTMENT should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 1-15 years). It is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before applying the medicine.

The most common side effects of applying DERSOL 30% OINTMENT are erythema (skin redness), and/or dryness of skin. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

name: BENCLEAR A Gel 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About BENCLEAR A GEL

BENCLEAR A GEL is a combination of Adapalene and Benzoyl peroxide which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiacne agents. It is used in the management of acne.

Acne vulgaris (commonly known as acne) is an inflammatory skin condition that occurs when the hair follicles present in the skin are clogged with excess oil and/or dead skin cells. It can also be aggravated by few bacteria (such as Propionibacterium acnes) and is highly common among on the teenagers and the young adults.

It primarily affects the face, upper arms, trunk or back and is often characterized by pus-filled pimples, red bumps with inflammatory and non-inflammatory lesions. BENCLEAR A GEL is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 9 years or older).

Apply a thin layer of BENCLEAR A GEL on the affected skin areas. Avoid contact of this medicine with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose or with open wounds. You must also protect your skin against sun light and against other light sources (such as UV lamps).

Do not use BENCLEAR A GEL if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. BENCLEAR A GEL can be used in breastfeeding women if required. The most common side effects of using BENCLEAR A GEL are dry skin, mild burning sensation and skin irritation, redness or scaling. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Manage acne
usesDetails:
Uses Of BENCLEAR A GEL

It is used in adults, children and in adolescents (aged 9 years or older) to:

Manage acne
mechanismOfAction:
How BENCLEAR A GEL Works

BENCLEAR A GEL is a combination of two medicines namely, adapalene and benzoyl peroxide.

Adapalene is a topical retinoid (a type of vitamin A). It modulates the skin cell cycle and manages the accumulation of excess sebum (natural oil produced by the skin) and dead skin cells on the hair follicles of the skin. It also reduces inflammation on the skin.

Benzoyl peroxide is a keratolytic agent with antimicrobial properties. It improves skin’s tendency to exfoliate the dead skin cells naturally. It also reduces the number of acne-causing bacteria on the skin which can reduce the further spread of acne.

Collectively, they unclog the hair follicles of the skin and exfoliates dead skin cells which reduces acne breakouts.
usageDetails:

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Avoid contact of BENCLEAR A GEL with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose, hair or with open wounds (cuts, scrapes or sunburn).

Introduction About CLINRED GEL

CLINRED GEL contains Clindamycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of acne vulgaris. Acne vulgaris is a common skin condition that occurs when hair follicles get blocked with oil and dead skin cells. Symptoms include whiteheads, blackheads, small red, tender bumps, pimples, and pus-filled lumps on the skin.

Before applying CLINRED GEL, inform your doctor if you have or ever had diarrhea, bloody diarrhea and pseudomembranous colitis. CLINRED GEL is not recommended for use if you have a history of regional enteritis (inflammation of the small intestine), ulcerative colitis (inflammation of the large intestine) or antibiotic-associated colitis.

CLINRED GEL should be used with caution during pregnancy or by breastfeeding women only if clearly needed. The safety and effectiveness of CLINRED GEL in children under the age of 12 has not been established. The most common side effects of applying CLINRED GEL are burning, itching, and redness of the skin. Consult your doctor if symptoms worsen.

name: Tretiva 30mg Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TRETIVA 30MG CAPSULE

TRETIVA 30MG CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take TRETIVA 30MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

TRETIVA 30MG CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.
uses: Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRETIVA 30MG CAPSULE
Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of TRETIVA 30MG CAPSULE for Acne:

TRETIVA 30MG CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. introduction:
Introduction About ERYTOP GEL

ERYTOP GEL contains Clindamycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of acne vulgaris. Acne vulgaris is a common skin condition that occurs when hair follicles get blocked with oil and dead skin cells. Symptoms include whiteheads, blackheads, small red, tender bumps, pimples, and pus-filled lumps on the skin.

Before applying ERYTOP GEL, inform your doctor if you have or ever had diarrhea, bloody diarrhea and pseudomembranous colitis. ERYTOP GEL is not recommended for use if you have a history of regional enteritis (inflammation of the small intestine), ulcerative colitis (inflammation of the large intestine) or antibiotic-associated colitis.

ERYTOP GEL should be used with caution during pregnancy or by breastfeeding women only if clearly needed. The safety and effectiveness of ERYTOP GEL in children under the age of 12 has not been established. The most common side effects of applying ERYTOP GEL are burning, itching, and redness of the skin. Consult your doctor if symptoms worsen.

usesDetails:

Manage acne vulgaris
mechanismOfAction:
How ERYTOP GEL Works

ERYTOP GEL acts against the bacteria by binding to the 50S subunit of the bacterial ribosome (site of protein synthesis), which in turn manages protein synthesis and kills the infection-causing bacteria.
usageDetails:
How to use ERYTOP GEL

Apply ERYTOP GEL as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before use. Wash and dry the whole area, apply a thin film once daily to the skin where acne lesions appear and use enough to cover the entire affected area. In case of contact with the eyes, mouth or nostrils, rinse it off immediately and thoroughly with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

ACUTRET 30MG CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take ACUTRET 30MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

ACUTRET 30MG CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.

Introduction About ETHITRET 10MG CAPSULE

ETHITRET 10MG CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take ETHITRET 10MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

ETHITRET 10MG CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.

Benefits of ETHITRET 10MG CAPSULE for Acne:

It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. How ETHITRET 10MG CAPSULE Works

Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

name: Acnovate Trio Gel 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About ACNOVATE TRIO GEL

ACNOVATE TRIO GEL is a combination of Adapalene and Benzoyl peroxide which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiacne agents. It is used in the management of acne.

Acne vulgaris (commonly known as acne) is an inflammatory skin condition that occurs when the hair follicles present in the skin are clogged with excess oil and/or dead skin cells. It can also be aggravated by few bacteria (such as Propionibacterium acnes) and is highly common among on the teenagers and the young adults.

It primarily affects the face, upper arms, trunk or back and is often characterized by pus-filled pimples, red bumps with inflammatory and non-inflammatory lesions. ACNOVATE TRIO GEL is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 9 years or older).

Apply a thin layer of ACNOVATE TRIO GEL on the affected skin areas. Avoid contact of this medicine with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose or with open wounds. You must also protect your skin against sun light and against other light sources (such as UV lamps).

Do not use ACNOVATE TRIO GEL if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. ACNOVATE TRIO GEL can be used in breastfeeding women if required. The most common side effects of using ACNOVATE TRIO GEL are dry skin, mild burning sensation and skin irritation, redness or scaling. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Manage acne
usesDetails:
Uses Of ACNOVATE TRIO GEL

It is used in adults, children and in adolescents (aged 9 years or older) to:

Manage acne
mechanismOfAction:
How ACNOVATE TRIO GEL Works

ACNOVATE TRIO GEL is a combination of two medicines namely, adapalene and benzoyl peroxide.

Adapalene is a topical retinoid (a type of vitamin A). It modulates the skin cell cycle and manages the accumulation of excess sebum (natural oil produced by the skin) and dead skin cells on the hair follicles of the skin. It also reduces inflammation on the skin.

Benzoyl peroxide is a keratolytic agent with antimicrobial properties. It improves skin’s tendency to exfoliate the dead skin cells naturally. It also reduces the number of acne-causing bacteria on the skin which can reduce the further spread of acne.

Collectively, they unclog the hair follicles of the skin and exfoliates dead skin cells which reduces acne breakouts.

Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected skin areas or as directed by the physician. It is for topical use only. Wash your hands before and after application.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Avoid contact of ACNOVATE TRIO GEL with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose, hair or with open wounds (cuts, scrapes or sunburn).

introduction:
Introduction About ISOLOX 10 TABLET

ISOLOX 10 TABLET contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take ISOLOX 10 TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

ISOLOX 10 TABLET is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.

Benefits of ISOLOX 10 TABLET for Acne:

It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How ISOLOX 10 TABLET Works

ISOLOX 10 TABLET work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

introduction:
Introduction About CLINDOT N GEL

CLINDOT N GEL is a combination of Clindamycin and Nicotinamide which belongs to a group of medicines called Lincomycin antibiotics and Vitamin B3 complex, respectively. CLINDOT N GEL is used to manage mild to moderate acne which is a skin condition that occurs when hair follicles become plugged with oil and dead skin cells which may occur due to variety of causes such as genetics, fluctuating hormone levels, stress, high humidity or using oily or greasy personal care products which may affect people of all ages.

It is characterized by symptoms such as open or closed plugged pores, small red & tender bumps, pimples, large, solid or painful lumps under the skin and painful & pus-filled lumps under the skin.

Before using CLINDOT N GEL inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, lung or heart diseases. Avoid applying CLINDOT N GEL to a cut, scrapped, sunburnt or eczema affected skin.

CLINDOT N GEL should be used with caution in pregnant and in breastfeeding women. CLINDOT N GEL is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 12 years). Consult your doctor before applying.

The most common side effects of using CLINDOT N GEL are skin inflammation, contact dermatitis (red, itchy rash), inflammation of hair follicles, itchy skin, dry skin and peeling of skin. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

usesDetails:

Manage mild to moderate acne
mechanismOfAction:

CLINDOT N GEL helps to manage acne, where Clindamycin reduces free fatty acid concentrations on the skin and suppresses the growth of Propionibacterium acnes (Corynebacterium acnes), a bacteria found in sebaceous glands and follicles and Nicotinamide exerts anti-inflammatory effect in acne and interrupts sebum production.

Apply CLINDOT N GEL as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Before applying the medicine normally wash and dry the affected area and apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area. Managed areas on the face need not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Do not apply this medicine beyond the recommended duration. Avoid applying CLINDOT N GEL around your eyes, including eyelids. Rinse it off with water if you accidentally get it in these areas.

Introduction About TUFACNE 20MG CAPSULE

TUFACNE 20MG CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take TUFACNE 20MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

TUFACNE 20MG CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.

Benefits of TUFACNE 20MG CAPSULE for Acne:

TUFACNE 20MG CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How TUFACNE 20MG CAPSULE Works

TUFACNE 20MG CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

name: AB NEXT Gel 20gm
introduction:
Introduction About AB NEXT GEL

AB NEXT GEL is a combination of Adapalene and Benzoyl peroxide which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiacne agents. It is used in the management of acne.

Acne vulgaris (commonly known as acne) is an inflammatory skin condition that occurs when the hair follicles present in the skin are clogged with excess oil and/or dead skin cells. It can also be aggravated by few bacteria (such as Propionibacterium acnes) and is highly common among on the teenagers and the young adults.

It primarily affects the face, upper arms, trunk or back and is often characterized by pus-filled pimples, red bumps with inflammatory and non-inflammatory lesions. AB NEXT GEL is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 9 years or older).

Apply a thin layer of AB NEXT GEL on the affected skin areas. Avoid contact of this medicine with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose or with open wounds. You must also protect your skin against sun light and against other light sources (such as UV lamps).

Do not use AB NEXT GEL if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. AB NEXT GEL can be used in breastfeeding women if required. The most common side effects of using AB NEXT GEL are dry skin, mild burning sensation and skin irritation, redness or scaling. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Manage acne
usesDetails:
Uses Of AB NEXT GEL

It is used in adults, children and in adolescents (aged 9 years or older) to:

Manage acne
mechanismOfAction:
How AB NEXT GEL Works

AB NEXT GEL is a combination of two medicines namely, adapalene and benzoyl peroxide.

Adapalene is a topical retinoid (a type of vitamin A). It modulates the skin cell cycle and manages the accumulation of excess sebum (natural oil produced by the skin) and dead skin cells on the hair follicles of the skin. It also reduces inflammation on the skin.

Benzoyl peroxide is a keratolytic agent with antimicrobial properties. It improves skin’s tendency to exfoliate the dead skin cells naturally. It also reduces the number of acne-causing bacteria on the skin which can reduce the further spread of acne.

Collectively, they unclog the hair follicles of the skin and exfoliates dead skin cells which reduces acne breakouts.
usageDetails:
How to use AB NEXT GEL

Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected skin areas or as directed by the physician. It is for topical use only. Wash your hands before and after application.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Avoid contact of AB NEXT GEL with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose, hair or with open wounds (cuts, scrapes or sunburn).

introduction:
Introduction About NIOCLEAN GEL

NIOCLEAN GEL is a combination of Clindamycin and Nicotinamide which belongs to a group of medicines called Lincomycin antibiotics and Vitamin B3 complex, respectively. NIOCLEAN GEL is used to manage mild to moderate acne which is a skin condition that occurs when hair follicles become plugged with oil and dead skin cells which may occur due to variety of causes such as genetics, fluctuating hormone levels, stress, high humidity or using oily or greasy personal care products which may affect people of all ages.

It is characterized by symptoms such as open or closed plugged pores, small red & tender bumps, pimples, large, solid or painful lumps under the skin and painful & pus-filled lumps under the skin.

Before using NIOCLEAN GEL inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, lung or heart diseases. Avoid applying NIOCLEAN GEL to a cut, scrapped, sunburnt or eczema affected skin.

NIOCLEAN GEL should be used with caution in pregnant and in breastfeeding women. NIOCLEAN GEL is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 12 years). Consult your doctor before applying.

The most common side effects of using NIOCLEAN GEL are skin inflammation, contact dermatitis (red, itchy rash), inflammation of hair follicles, itchy skin, dry skin and peeling of skin. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

Managed areas on the face need not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Do not apply this medicine beyond the recommended duration. Avoid applying NIOCLEAN GEL around your eyes, including eyelids. Rinse it off with water if you accidentally get it in these areas.

introduction:
Introduction About TRETIVA

TRETIVA contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take TRETIVA exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

TRETIVA is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.
uses: Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRETIVA
Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of TRETIVA for Acne:

TRETIVA is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How TRETIVA Works

TRETIVA work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.
usageInstructions: Take TRETIVA exactly as prescribed by your doctor.
Swallow the capsule whole with a glass of water; do not crush or chew it.
It is recommended to take the capsule with food to improve absorption and reduce stomach discomfort.
Take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels of the medication in your body.
Follow the prescribed dosage and duration carefully. Do not stop the medication abruptly without consulting your doctor, even if your symptoms improve.
Regular follow-ups and blood tests may be required to monitor your progress and ensure safe usage.
Avoid alcohol, excessive sun exposure, and waxing or laser treatments during the treatment period. Use sunscreen and moisturizers as recommended by your doctor.

What if I Forget to take TRETIVA:

If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose—do not double the dose to make up for it.

In case you or anybody else accidently take too much of TRETIVA, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of TRETIVA overdose are severe headache, abdominal pain, nausea, dizziness, redness of face, vomiting, somnolence, irritability, and itching.

name: CLINOL Gel 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About CLINOL GEL

CLINOL GEL contains Clindamycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of acne vulgaris. Acne vulgaris is a common skin condition that occurs when hair follicles get blocked with oil and dead skin cells. Symptoms include whiteheads, blackheads, small red, tender bumps, pimples, and pus-filled lumps on the skin.

Before applying CLINOL GEL, inform your doctor if you have or ever had diarrhea, bloody diarrhea and pseudomembranous colitis. CLINOL GEL is not recommended for use if you have a history of regional enteritis (inflammation of the small intestine), ulcerative colitis (inflammation of the large intestine) or antibiotic-associated colitis.

CLINOL GEL should be used with caution during pregnancy or by breastfeeding women only if clearly needed. The safety and effectiveness of CLINOL GEL in children under the age of 12 has not been established. The most common side effects of applying CLINOL GEL are burning, itching, and redness of the skin. Consult your doctor if symptoms worsen.

Manage acne vulgaris
mechanismOfAction:
How CLINOL GEL Works

CLINOL GEL acts against the bacteria by binding to the 50S subunit of the bacterial ribosome (site of protein synthesis), which in turn manages protein synthesis and works against the infection-causing bacteria.
usageDetails:
How to use CLINOL GEL

Apply CLINOL GEL as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before use. Wash and dry the whole area, apply a thin film once daily to the skin where acne lesions appear and use enough to cover the entire affected area. In case of contact with the eyes, mouth or nostrils, rinse it off immediately and thoroughly with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ACNORM LOTION

Acnorm Lotion is a dermatological preparation used for managing acne. It contains Calamine, Zinc oxide, Glycerin, and Precipitated Sulphur as active ingredients.

Glycerin is an excellent moisturizer. It hydrates your skin, manages water loss and makes your skin soft and supple. Precipitated Sulphur absorbs all the excess oil produced by the skin and dries it out, which helps in management of further acne breakouts.

Acnorm Lotion is suitable for use in oily and acne prone skin. It is for external use only. Apply Acnorm Lotion on the acne affected skin areas including your face, chest and upper back. Leave the lotion to dry on your skin overnight and wash if off next morning. Avoid contact of this lotion with your eyes, ears, nose or mouth. In case of accidental contact, wash it off with plenty of water.

introduction:
Introduction About ACTREAT GEL(TOPICAL)

ACTREAT GEL(TOPICAL) is a combination of Clindamycin and Nicotinamide which belongs to a group of medicines called Lincomycin antibiotics and Vitamin B3 complex, respectively. ACTREAT GEL(TOPICAL) is used to manage mild to moderate acne which is a skin condition that occurs when hair follicles become plugged with oil and dead skin cells which may occur due to variety of causes such as genetics, fluctuating hormone levels, stress, high humidity or using oily or greasy personal care products which may affect people of all ages.

It is characterized by symptoms such as open or closed plugged pores, small red & tender bumps, pimples, large, solid or painful lumps under the skin and painful & pus-filled lumps under the skin.

Before using ACTREAT GEL(TOPICAL) inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, lung or heart diseases. Avoid applying ACTREAT GEL(TOPICAL) to a cut, scrapped, sunburnt or eczema affected skin.

ACTREAT GEL(TOPICAL) should be used with caution in pregnant and in breastfeeding women. ACTREAT GEL(TOPICAL) is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 12 years). Consult your doctor before applying.

The most common side effects of using ACTREAT GEL(TOPICAL) are skin inflammation, contact dermatitis (red, itchy rash), inflammation of hair follicles, itchy skin, dry skin and peeling of skin. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

Managed areas on the face need not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Do not apply this medicine beyond the recommended duration. name: Pinoin 5mg Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About PINOIN 5MG CAPSULE

PINOIN 5MG CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take PINOIN 5MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

PINOIN 5MG CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.
uses: Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)

Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of PINOIN 5MG CAPSULE for Acne:

PINOIN 5MG CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.

How PINOIN 5MG CAPSULE Works

PINOIN 5MG CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

Swallow the capsule whole with a glass of water; do not crush or chew it.
It is recommended to take the capsule with food to improve absorption and reduce stomach discomfort.
Take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels of the medication in your body.
Follow the prescribed dosage and duration carefully. Do not stop the medication abruptly without consulting your doctor, even if your symptoms improve.
Regular follow-ups and blood tests may be required to monitor your progress and ensure safe usage.
Avoid alcohol, excessive sun exposure, and waxing or laser treatments during the treatment period. Use sunscreen and moisturizers as recommended by your doctor.

What if I Forget to take PINOIN 5MG CAPSULE:

If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose—do not double the dose to make up for it.

Overdosage of PINOIN 5MG CAPSULE –

In case you or anybody else accidently take too much of PINOIN 5MG CAPSULE, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of PINOIN 5MG CAPSULE overdose are severe headache, abdominal pain, nausea, dizziness, redness of face, vomiting, somnolence, irritability, and itching.

Pregnancy
CONTRAINDICATED
Human and animal studies have shown that isotretinoin is teratogenic in nature. Birth defects such as abnormalities of the face, eyes, ears, skull, central nervous system, cardiovascular system, and thymus and parathyroid glands or IQ less than score of 85 have been reported in female patients who were pregnant or became pregnant while on therapy with isotretinoin. Women of childbearing potential must use a reliable contraceptive method to avoid becoming pregnant. If you accidentally became pregnant while taking this medicine, stop taking it and consult your gynaecologist for further evaluation.

introduction:
Introduction About MINOZ BPO GEL

MINOZ BPO GEL is a combination of Adapalene and Benzoyl peroxide which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiacne agents. It is used in the management of acne.

Acne vulgaris (commonly known as acne) is an inflammatory skin condition that occurs when the hair follicles present in the skin are clogged with excess oil and/or dead skin cells. It can also be aggravated by few bacteria (such as Propionibacterium acnes) and is highly common among on the teenagers and the young adults.

It primarily affects the face, upper arms, trunk or back and is often characterized by pus-filled pimples, red bumps with inflammatory and non-inflammatory lesions. MINOZ BPO GEL is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 9 years or older).

Apply a thin layer of MINOZ BPO GEL on the affected skin areas. Avoid contact of this medicine with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose or with open wounds. You must also protect your skin against sun light and against other light sources (such as UV lamps).

Do not use MINOZ BPO GEL if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. MINOZ BPO GEL can be used in breastfeeding women if required. The most common side effects of using MINOZ BPO GEL are dry skin, mild burning sensation and skin irritation, redness or scaling. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
