mechanismOfAction:
How MINOZ BPO GEL Works

MINOZ BPO GEL is a combination of two medicines namely, adapalene and benzoyl peroxide.

Adapalene is a topical retinoid (a type of vitamin A). It modulates the skin cell cycle and manages the accumulation of excess sebum (natural oil produced by the skin) and dead skin cells on the hair follicles of the skin. It also reduces inflammation on the skin.

Benzoyl peroxide is a keratolytic agent with antimicrobial properties. It improves skin’s tendency to exfoliate the dead skin cells naturally. It also reduces the number of acne-causing bacteria on the skin which can reduce the further spread of acne.

Collectively, they unclog the hair follicles of the skin and exfoliates dead skin cells which reduces acne breakouts.
usageDetails:
How to use MINOZ BPO GEL

Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected skin areas or as directed by the physician. It is for topical use only. Wash your hands before and after application.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Avoid contact of MINOZ BPO GEL with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose, hair or with open wounds (cuts, scrapes or sunburn).

introduction:
Introduction About DERIVA I 20 CAPSULE

DERIVA I 20 CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take DERIVA I 20 CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

DERIVA I 20 CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.

introduction:
Introduction About AZOBRIL FORTE CREAM

AZOBRIL FORTE CREAM contains Azelaic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Dicarboxylic acids. It is used to manage common acne (acne vulgaris). It is also used for the management of mild to moderate papulopustular rosacea.

Acne is a skin condition that occurs when the hair follicles become plugged with oil and dead skin cells. It causes whiteheads, blackheads or pimples. Rosacea is a skin condition that causes blushing or redness, pus-filled bumps and small visible blood vessels in the face.

AZOBRIL FORTE CREAM should be applied with caution in patients with lung problems such as asthma. Consult your doctor before applying it.

Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before applying this medicine. Your doctor will decide whether you can use this medicine.

AZOBRIL FORTE CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children under 12 years of age for the management of acne and also not recommended for use in children under 18 years of age for the management of rosacea. Consult your doctor before applying it.

The most common side effects of applying AZOBRIL FORTE CREAM are burning, itching or redness of the skin (erythema) at the application site, scaling, pain, dryness, skin discolouration or irritation at the application site. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How AZOBRIL FORTE CREAM Works

AZOBRIL FORTE CREAM attacks the bacteria called propionibacterium acnes, which plays an essential part in causing acne. It also reduces growth of the harder outermost skin cells (keratin surface cells) that block the pores of the skin to cause blackheads and whiteheads.

Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, mouth and other mucous membranes or open wounds. If it does, wash the eyes, mouth or other mucous membranes immediately with large amounts of cool water.

introduction:
Introduction About ISONAK 10 SOFT GELATIN CAPSULE

ISONAK 10 SOFT GELATIN CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take ISONAK 10 SOFT GELATIN CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

ISONAK 10 SOFT GELATIN CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.

Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

Introduction About A RET 0.025% GEL

A RET 0.025% GEL contains Tretinoin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Retinoids. It is used to manage acne. It can also be used to manage wrinkles, skin spots and rough skin. Acne is defined as a skin disease involving inflammation of the sebaceous follicles of the face and upper body, characterized by lesions on the face, back, upper chest and shoulders.

Before using A RET 0.025% GEL, inform your doctor if you have any sunburn, sun sensitivity or any other skin problems. A RET 0.025% GEL should be used in pregnancy only if specifically directed by your doctor. A RET 0.025% GEL should be used with caution in breastfeeding women.

The safety and effectiveness of A RET 0.025% GEL in children (aged less than 12 years) have not been established, so consult your doctor before using it. The most common side effect of using A RET 0.025% GEL is skin irritation like redness, burning, stinging, dryness and peeling. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About SOTRET 30MG CAPSULE

SOTRET 30MG CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take SOTRET 30MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

SOTRET 30MG CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.

Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of SOTRET 30MG CAPSULE for Acne:

SOTRET 30MG CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How SOTRET 30MG CAPSULE Works

SOTRET 30MG CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

introduction:
Introduction About ACNEWAR GEL

ACNEWAR GEL contains Dapsone which belongs to the group of medicines called Sulfone antibiotics. It is used in the management of acne vulgaris (a skin condition that occurs when the hair follicles are blocked with dead skin cells, bacteria and sebum). The most common symptoms of acne vulgaris are pimples, redness, blackhead and white heads.

Before using ACNEWAR GEL, inform your doctor if you have glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency, methemoglobinemia (a type of blood disorder) and if you are using other products including cosmetics or medicines applied to the skin.

ACNEWAR GEL should be used during pregnancy and breast-feeding only if clearly advised by the doctor. Consult your doctor before using the medicine.

This medicine is not recommended for use in children (younger than 12 years of age). ACNEWAR GEL should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before using the medicine.

The most common side effects associated with the use of ACNEWAR GEL are oiliness/ peeling, redness and dryness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
uses: Manage acne vulgaris
usesDetails:
Uses Of ACNEWAR GEL
Manage acne vulgaris
mechanismOfAction:
How ACNEWAR GEL Works

ACNEWAR GEL works as both anti-bacterial and anti-inflammatory agent in the management of acne vulgaris. As an antibacterial agent, it works by inhibiting the synthesis of folic acid which is necessary for the growth of bacteria. Thus, stops the multiplication of bacteria. As an anti-inflammatory agent, it decreases inflammation and heals the breakout.
usageDetails:
How to use ACNEWAR GEL

Always apply ACNEWAR GEL as directed by your doctor. It is for topical use only. Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the areas of your skin that have acne. Avoid contact with eyes, mouth and mucous membranes. Rub the medicine gently and completely. Wash your hands after applying ACNEWAR GEL. Your doctor will decide the duration and frequency of this medicine depending upon severity of the condition.

introduction:
Introduction About SOTRET NF 24 CAPSULE

SOTRET NF 24 CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take SOTRET NF 24 CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

SOTRET NF 24 CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.

Benefits of SOTRET NF 24 CAPSULE for Acne:

SOTRET NF 24 CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How SOTRET NF 24 CAPSULE Works

SOTRET NF 24 CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

CONTRAINDICATED
Human and animal studies have shown that isotretinoin is teratogenic in nature. Birth defects such as abnormalities of the face, eyes, ears, skull, central nervous system, cardiovascular system, and thymus and parathyroid glands or IQ less than score of 85 have been reported in female patients who were pregnant or became pregnant while on therapy with isotretinoin. Women of childbearing potential must use a reliable contraceptive method to avoid becoming pregnant. If you accidentally became pregnant while taking this medicine, stop taking it and consult your gynaecologist for further evaluation.

introduction:
Introduction About PERSOL PLUS GEL

PERSOL PLUS GEL is a combination of Adapalene and Benzoyl peroxide which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiacne agents. It is used in the management of acne.

Acne vulgaris (commonly known as acne) is an inflammatory skin condition that occurs when the hair follicles present in the skin are clogged with excess oil and/or dead skin cells. It can also be aggravated by few bacteria (such as Propionibacterium acnes) and is highly common among on the teenagers and the young adults.

It primarily affects the face, upper arms, trunk or back and is often characterized by pus-filled pimples, red bumps with inflammatory and non-inflammatory lesions. PERSOL PLUS GEL is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 9 years or older).

Apply a thin layer of PERSOL PLUS GEL on the affected skin areas. Avoid contact of this medicine with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose or with open wounds. You must also protect your skin against sun light and against other light sources (such as UV lamps).

Do not use PERSOL PLUS GEL if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. PERSOL PLUS GEL can be used in breastfeeding women if required. The most common side effects of using PERSOL PLUS GEL are dry skin, mild burning sensation and skin irritation, redness or scaling. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How PERSOL PLUS GEL Works

PERSOL PLUS GEL is a combination of two medicines namely, adapalene and benzoyl peroxide.

Adapalene is a topical retinoid (a type of vitamin A). It modulates the skin cell cycle and manages the accumulation of excess sebum (natural oil produced by the skin) and dead skin cells on the hair follicles of the skin. It also reduces inflammation on the skin.

Benzoyl peroxide is a keratolytic agent with antimicrobial properties. It improves skin’s tendency to exfoliate the dead skin cells naturally. It also reduces the number of acne-causing bacteria on the skin which can reduce the further spread of acne.

Collectively, they unclog the hair follicles of the skin and exfoliates dead skin cells which reduces acne breakouts.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Avoid contact of PERSOL PLUS GEL with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose, hair or with open wounds (cuts, scrapes or sunburn).

introduction:
Introduction About BENZRIN AC 2.5% GEL(TOPICAL)

BENZRIN AC 2.5% GEL(TOPICAL) contains Benzoyl peroxide which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-bacterial and Anti-inflammatory agents. It is used in the management of acne (pimples) in the face, chest and back. It is also used to unplug the blocked pores (blackheads and whiteheads) and absorb excess oil from the skin.

Before using BENZRIN AC 2.5% GEL(TOPICAL), inform your doctor if you are having any allergy to foods, preservatives or dyes or if you are already under any medication for acne.

It is not recommended to use hard cleansers, scrubs, medicated soap or cosmetic products containing alcohol while using this medicine.

BENZRIN AC 2.5% GEL(TOPICAL) is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless clearly needed. Consult your doctor before using the medicine.

Avoid repeated exposure to sunlight or other sources of UV light (such as sun bed). In case of accidental contact, rinse thoroughly with warm water and pat dry.

Most common side effects of BENZRIN AC 2.5% GEL(TOPICAL) are skin redness and irriation, burning, stinging sensation in the skin. Consult your doctor if any of above symptoms worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How BENZRIN AC 2.5% GEL(TOPICAL) Works

BENZRIN AC 2.5% GEL(TOPICAL) works against the acne-causing bacteria. This medicine after applying on the affected skin gets absorbed and is converted to benzoic acid. This benzoic acid gets metabolized by skin proteins and releases active free-radical oxygen species that results in the alteration of bacterial proteins. This helps to manage acne or pimples. BENZRIN AC 2.5% GEL(TOPICAL) also acts as a keratolytic agent which promotes peeling of the skin and absorb excess oil from the skin further managing acne formation and skin irritation.

Always apply BENZRIN AC 2.5% GEL(TOPICAL) as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area as instructed by the doctor.

Avoid contact with eyes, lips, mouth, nose, mucous membranes and sensitive areas of the neck. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending you’re your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ACTAME 30 CAPSULE

ACTAME 30 CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take ACTAME 30 CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

ACTAME 30 CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.
uses: Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
usesDetails:
Uses Of ACTAME 30 CAPSULE
Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of ACTAME 30 CAPSULE for Acne:

ACTAME 30 CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How ACTAME 30 CAPSULE Works

ACTAME 30 CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

CONTRAINDICATED
Human and animal studies have shown that isotretinoin is teratogenic in nature. Birth defects such as abnormalities of the face, eyes, ears, skull, central nervous system, cardiovascular system, and thymus and parathyroid glands or IQ less than score of 85 have been reported in female patients who were pregnant or became pregnant while on therapy with isotretinoin. Women of childbearing potential must use a reliable contraceptive method to avoid becoming pregnant. If you accidentally became pregnant while taking this medicine, stop taking it and consult your gynaecologist for further evaluation.

introduction:
Introduction About FACECLIN AT GEL

FACECLIN AT GEL is used in the management of acne (pimple). It contains a combination of Adapalene and Clindamycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called topical retinoids and lincomycin antibiotics.

Adapalene is a form of vitamin A that acts as an antiacne agent by binding directly to the receptor of the skin, which increases the rate of cell turnover (cell regeneration) and decreases oil secretion, preventing clogging of the hair follicles and pores and also decreasing swelling and inflammation. Clindamycin works by binding to the ribosomal unit of the bacteria and disrupting the production of the protein essential for its survival.

Before recommending FACECLIN AT GEL, your doctor may advise you to have tests to understand your existing condition in order to plan effective management methods. Stay well hydrated and protect your skin from exposure to sunlight or UV light.

Do not apply FACECLIN AT GEL if you are allergic to adapalene or clindamycin, have a disorder of the digestive system (colitis), a disorder of the immune system, or have bruises, cuts, or burns on the skin. The common side effects of using this medicine may include dry skin, burning, itching, redness or irritative sensation of the skin, scaling, peeling of the skin, etc.

introduction:
Introduction About BENZOYL PEROXIDE (NANZ) GEL

BENZOYL PEROXIDE (NANZ) GEL contains Benzoyl peroxide which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-bacterial and Anti-inflammatory agents. It is used in the management of acne (pimples) in the face, chest and back. It is also used to unplug the blocked pores (blackheads and whiteheads) and absorb excess oil from the skin.

Before using BENZOYL PEROXIDE (NANZ) GEL, inform your doctor if you are having any allergy to foods, preservatives or dyes or if you are already under any medication for acne.

It is not recommended to use hard cleansers, scrubs, medicated soap or cosmetic products containing alcohol while using this medicine.

BENZOYL PEROXIDE (NANZ) GEL is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless clearly needed. Consult your doctor before using the medicine.

Avoid repeated exposure to sunlight or other sources of UV light (such as sun bed). In case of accidental contact, rinse thoroughly with warm water and pat dry.

Most common side effects of BENZOYL PEROXIDE (NANZ) GEL are skin redness and irriation, burning, stinging sensation in the skin. Consult your doctor if any of above symptoms worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How BENZOYL PEROXIDE (NANZ) GEL Works

BENZOYL PEROXIDE (NANZ) GEL works against the acne-causing bacteria. This medicine after applying on the affected skin gets absorbed and is converted to benzoic acid. This benzoic acid gets metabolized by skin proteins and releases active free-radical oxygen species that results in the alteration of bacterial proteins. This helps to manage acne or pimples. BENZOYL PEROXIDE (NANZ) GEL also acts as a keratolytic agent which promotes peeling of the skin and absorb excess oil from the skin further managing acne formation and skin irritation.

Avoid contact with eyes, lips, mouth, nose, mucous membranes and sensitive areas of the neck. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ACTAME F FOAMING FACE WASH

ACTAME F FOAMING Face Wash is an antiacne agent used for moderate to severe acne. It contains nordihydroguaiaretic acid & oleanolic acid, salicylic acid, tea tree oil, aloe vera, zinc PCA as active ingredients.

Nordihydroguaiaretic acid & oleanolic acid helps to fight against acne causing microorganism and reduces hyperkeratinisation, which may manage acne. Salicyclic acid helps to reduce swelling, redness and unclogging blocked pores, allowing pimples to shrink. Tea tree oil and aloe vera helps to fight against acne causing bacteria. Zinc PCA helps to reduce swelling, redness and sebum secretion.

Apply ACTAME F FOAMING Face Wash as advised by the doctor. It is for external use only. Wash your hands thoroughly with water. Wet your face with water. Pump 2 or 3 pumps of ACTAME F FOAMING Face Wash into the palms of the hands. Rub your hands together to spread the face wash onto the hands.

Apply the ACTAME F FOAMING Face Wash to your face by rubbing your hands along your entire face. Spread it to your forehead, along your cheekbones and nose, and on your chin. Rub the ACTAME F FOAMING Face Wash gently into your skin in a circular motion with your fingertips up to 1 to 2 minutes. Rinse off with water and dab your face dry with a clean towel.

introduction:
Introduction About PERNEX AC 5% GEL

Pernex AC 5% Gel is an antibacterial and anti-inflammatory agent used to topically manage mild to moderate acne vulgaris in patients 12 years of age and older. It has microsponge technology which reduces skin irritation and facial sebum accumulation. It contains Benzoyl Peroxide as an active ingredient which helps manage acne.

Benzoyl peroxide is an antibacterial and anti-inflammatory agent, which kills the Cutibacterium acnes bacteria (germs), which is one of the main causes of acne.

Always apply Pernex AC 5% Gel as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Avoid contact with lips, eyes, eyelids, and mucous membranes. It should not be used on damaged skin.

Caution should be exercised when applying Pernex AC 5% Gel to the neck and other sensitive areas. Avoid too much exposure to sunlight or other sources of UV light (Ex. sun bed). Do not use Pernex AC 5% Gel during pregnancy and breastfeeding unless advised by the doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About BDIFF A GEL

BDIFF A GEL is a combination of Adapalene and Benzoyl peroxide which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiacne agents. It is used in the management of acne.

Acne vulgaris (commonly known as acne) is an inflammatory skin condition that occurs when the hair follicles present in the skin are clogged with excess oil and/or dead skin cells. It can also be aggravated by few bacteria (such as Propionibacterium acnes) and is highly common among on the teenagers and the young adults.

It primarily affects the face, upper arms, trunk or back and is often characterized by pus-filled pimples, red bumps with inflammatory and non-inflammatory lesions. BDIFF A GEL is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 9 years or older).

Apply a thin layer of BDIFF A GEL on the affected skin areas. Avoid contact of this medicine with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose or with open wounds. You must also protect your skin against sun light and against other light sources (such as UV lamps).

Do not use BDIFF A GEL if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. BDIFF A GEL can be used in breastfeeding women if required. The most common side effects of using BDIFF A GEL are dry skin, mild burning sensation and skin irritation, redness or scaling. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How BDIFF A GEL Works

BDIFF A GEL is a combination of two medicines namely, adapalene and benzoyl peroxide.

Adapalene is a topical retinoid (a type of vitamin A). It modulates the skin cell cycle and manages the accumulation of excess sebum (natural oil produced by the skin) and dead skin cells on the hair follicles of the skin. It also reduces inflammation on the skin.

Benzoyl peroxide is a keratolytic agent with antimicrobial properties. It improves skin’s tendency to exfoliate the dead skin cells naturally. It also reduces the number of acne-causing bacteria on the skin which can reduce the further spread of acne.

Collectively, they unclog the hair follicles of the skin and exfoliates dead skin cells which reduces acne breakouts.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Avoid contact of BDIFF A GEL with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose, hair or with open wounds (cuts, scrapes or sunburn).

name: CLINMISKIN AD Gel 20gm
introduction:
Introduction About CLINMISKIN AD GEL

CLINMISKIN AD GEL contains a combination of Adapalene and Clindamycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called topical retinoids and lincomycin antibiotics. It is used in the management of skin acne (pimple). Acne is a condition of the skin when the root of your hair (hair follicle) or skin pores gets clogged by oil or dead skin, which becomes prone to bacterial infection and the formation of pimples, blackheads, spots and scars.

Adapalene is a form of vitamin A, that acts as an antiacne agent by binding directly to the receptor of the skin which increases the rate of cell turnover (cell regeneration) and decreases oil secretion managing clogging of the hair follicles and pores, also decreasing swelling/inflammation. Clindamycin works by binding to the ribosomal unit of the bacteria and disrupts the production of the protein essential for its survival. Before recommending CLINMISKIN AD GEL, your doctor may advise you to have tests to understand your existing condition for planning effective management methods. Stay well hydrated and protect your skin from exposure to sunlight or UV light.

Do not apply CLINMISKIN AD GEL if you are allergic to adapalene or clindamycin, a disorder of the digestive system (colitis), a disorder of the immune system or have bruises, cuts or burns on the skin. The common side effects of using this medicine may include dry skin, burning, itching, redness or irritative sensation of the skin, scaling peeling of the skin etc.Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

It also reduces swelling/inflammation of the skin. Clindamycin works by attaching to the bacteria's ribosomal unit and disrupting the production of a protein required for its very own survival.

introduction:
Introduction About SLC ACNE GEL

SLC ACNE GEL contains Salicylic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Keratolytic agents. SLC ACNE GEL is used manage skin conditions such as acne, blemishes (discolored spot-on skin), skin redness, and other skin diseases.

It is also used to manage dandruff, corn & calluses (thickened layers of skin) in affected individuals.

SLC ACNE GEL is not recommended for use in patients allergic to salicylic acid. It is also not recommended for use in patients with active inflammation/dermatitis, infection (at the application site), acute viral infection, skin malignancy, and/or tanned skin.

Before applying SLC ACNE GEL, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for surgery, and/or suffering from any kidney problems.

SLC ACNE GEL is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women. It is considered to be safe to be used in breastfeeding women. Avoid applying the medicine on skin areas which might come in direct contact with infant’s skin.

SLC ACNE GEL should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 1-15 years). It is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before applying the medicine.

The most common side effects of applying SLC ACNE GEL are erythema (skin redness), and/or dryness of skin. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

name: Perobar 2.5% Bar 75gm
introduction:
Introduction About PEROBAR 2.5% BAR

Perobar Soap is a cleansing soap used to manage acne. It is also used to soothe, cleanse, or nourish the skin. It contains Benzoyl Peroxide as active ingredient that kills the infection causing bacteria, removes dirt, excess oil and unclog pores.

Benzoyl Peroxide gets converted into benzoic acid which releases active free-radical oxygen. These free radicals interfere with important bacterial function and survival, hence killing them. It also increases the turnover rate of skin cells which helps in managing acne.

Use Perobar Soap as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wet the skin and apply it on the affected areas. Work up a good lather with it and leave for few minutes, then rinse with water and pat dry the application area. Use it 2-3 times daily. Do not exceed the daily recommended dosages. Consult your doctor if you experience any allergic reactions while using it.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of PEROBAR 2.5% BAR

Perobar Soap may cause local dryness, irritation, eczema (skin inflammation), redness, skin peeling, and itching. Consult your doctor if you notice any such side effects while using this soap.

name: CLINMISKIN Solution 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About CLINMISKIN SOLUTION

CLINMISKIN SOLUTION contains Clindamycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of acne vulgaris. Acne vulgaris is a common skin condition that occurs when hair follicles get blocked with oil and dead skin cells. Symptoms include whiteheads, blackheads, small red, tender bumps, pimples, and pus-filled lumps on the skin.

Before applying CLINMISKIN SOLUTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had diarrhea, bloody diarrhea and pseudomembranous colitis. CLINMISKIN SOLUTION is not recommended for use if you have a history of regional enteritis (inflammation of the small intestine), ulcerative colitis (inflammation of the large intestine) or antibiotic-associated colitis.

CLINMISKIN SOLUTION should be used with caution during pregnancy or by breastfeeding women only if clearly needed. The safety and effectiveness of CLINMISKIN SOLUTION in children under the age of 12 has not been established. The most common side effects of applying CLINMISKIN SOLUTION are burning, itching, and redness of the skin. Consult your doctor if symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage acne vulgaris
usesDetails:
Uses Of CLINMISKIN SOLUTION
Manage acne vulgaris
mechanismOfAction:
How CLINMISKIN SOLUTION Works

CLINMISKIN SOLUTION acts against the bacteria by binding to the 50S subunit of the bacterial ribosome (site of protein synthesis), which in turn manages protein synthesis and kills the infection-causing bacteria.
usageDetails:
How to use CLINMISKIN SOLUTION

Apply CLINMISKIN SOLUTION as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before use. Wash and dry the whole area, apply a thin film once daily to the skin where acne lesions appear and use enough to cover the entire affected area. In case of contact with the eyes, mouth or nostrils, rinse it off immediately and thoroughly with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Before using REVIZE MICRO 0.04% GEL, inform your doctor if you have any sunburn, sun sensitivity or any other skin problems. REVIZE MICRO 0.04% GEL should be used in pregnancy only if specifically directed by your doctor. REVIZE MICRO 0.04% GEL should be used with caution in breastfeeding women.

introduction:
Introduction About ZIT 10 CAPSULE

ZIT 10 CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take ZIT 10 CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

ZIT 10 CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.
uses: Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZIT 10 CAPSULE
Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of ZIT 10 CAPSULE for Acne:

ZIT 10 CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How ZIT 10 CAPSULE Works

ZIT 10 CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

Birth defects such as abnormalities of the face, eyes, ears, skull, central nervous system, cardiovascular system, and thymus and parathyroid glands or IQ less than score of 85 have been reported in female patients who were pregnant or became pregnant while on therapy with isotretinoin. Introduction About EZANIC 20% GEL

EZANIC 20% GEL contains Azelaic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Dicarboxylic acids. It is used to manage common acne (acne vulgaris). It is also used for the management of mild to moderate papulopustular rosacea.

Acne is a skin condition that occurs when the hair follicles become plugged with oil and dead skin cells. It causes whiteheads, blackheads or pimples. Rosacea is a skin condition that causes blushing or redness, pus-filled bumps and small visible blood vessels in the face.

EZANIC 20% GEL should be applied with caution in patients with lung problems such as asthma. Consult your doctor before applying it.

Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before applying this medicine. Your doctor will decide whether you can use this medicine.

EZANIC 20% GEL is generally not recommended for use in children under 12 years of age for the management of acne and also not recommended for use in children under 18 years of age for the management of rosacea. Consult your doctor before applying it.

The most common side effects of applying EZANIC 20% GEL are burning, itching or redness of the skin (erythema) at the application site, scaling, pain, dryness, skin discolouration or irritation at the application site. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How EZANIC 20% GEL Works

EZANIC 20% GEL attacks the bacteria called propionibacterium acnes, which plays an essential part in causing acne. It also reduces growth of the harder outermost skin cells (keratin surface cells) that block the pores of the skin to cause blackheads and whiteheads.

Apply EZANIC 20% GEL as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water before and after using EZANIC 20% GEL. Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area and rub it gently into the skin.

Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, mouth and other mucous membranes or open wounds. If it does, wash the eyes, mouth or other mucous membranes immediately with large amounts of cool water.

introduction:
Introduction About GLOTRET 5MG TABLET

GLOTRET 5MG TABLET contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take GLOTRET 5MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

GLOTRET 5MG TABLET is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.
uses: Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
usesDetails:
Uses Of GLOTRET 5MG TABLET
Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of GLOTRET 5MG TABLET for Acne:

GLOTRET 5MG TABLET is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How GLOTRET 5MG TABLET Works

GLOTRET 5MG TABLET work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose—do not double the dose to make up for it.

Pregnancy
CONTRAINDICATED
Human and animal studies have shown that isotretinoin is teratogenic in nature. Birth defects such as abnormalities of the face, eyes, ears, skull, central nervous system, cardiovascular system, and thymus and parathyroid glands or IQ less than score of 85 have been reported in female patients who were pregnant or became pregnant while on therapy with isotretinoin. Therefore, GLOTRET 5MG TABLET is considered unsafe for use during pregnancy.
Women of childbearing potential must use a reliable contraceptive method to avoid becoming pregnant. If you accidentally became pregnant while taking this medicine, stop taking it and consult your gynaecologist for further evaluation.
It is also not recommended for you to get pregnant for one month after stopping isotretinoin tablets because some medicine may still be left in your body. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About LITESKIN CREAM

LITESKIN CREAM is a combination of Hydroquinone, Tretinoin, Mometasone furoate which belongs to the group of medicines called Depigmenting agents, Retinoids and Corticosteroids respectively. It is used in adults for the management of moderate to severe melasma (dark spots on the skin) in association with sun-avoidance measures, like using sunscreens and wearing protective clothing. Melasma is one of the most frequently acquired hyperpigmentation (excess melanin production) disorders with symptoms such as symmetrical brown patches on sun exposed areas mainly on face.

It is advised to avoid exposure to sun during management with LITESKIN CREAM for better results. While going out apply sunscreens and wear full covering protective clothes. Before using LITESKIN CREAM inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung or heart diseases.

Safety and efficacy of LITESKIN CREAM is not established in pregnant women and in children below 12 years of age. Ask for your doctor’s advice before using. LITESKIN CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of using LITESKIN CREAM are mild burning, stinging, redness and dryness. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.

mechanismOfAction:
How LITESKIN CREAM Works

LITESKIN CREAM helps in managing melasma where Hydroquinone is a skin bleaching agent that blocks enzyme tyrosinase which is responsible for the production of melanin that cause pigmentation. Thus, it helps for fading of dark spots in skin. Tretinoin helps to recover the damage to the skin caused by sun exposure (photodamage) by thickening skin layer and loss of keratinized cells.it helps to rejuvenate the skin. Mometasone furoate blocks prostaglandin synthesis and reduces redness, swelling and itching caused by tretinoin and other skin infections.
usageDetails:

Apply LITESKIN CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before and after applying LITESKIN CREAM. Wash your face with a mild soap and dry properly. Apply LITESKIN CREAM at night and gently massage it in until it is absorbed. Avoid contact with your eyes, nose, mouth, mucous membrane. Avoid exposure to sunlight while using this medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

faqs.question: Q: Do I need to take any precaution while using LITESKIN CREAM?
faqs.answer: A: It is advised to reduce exposure to sun during management with LITESKIN CREAM for better results. While going out apply sunscreens and wear full covering protective clothes. Exposure to sunlight or ultra-violet light will cause repigmentation of lightened skin. Do not apply LITESKIN CREAM to broken skin.

faqs.question: Q: What is the best time to use LITESKIN CREAM?
faqs.answer: A: It is advised to use LITESKIN CREAM before bedtime. This will reduce the chances of exposure of the managed skin to sun. However, ask for your doctor’s advice before using.

introduction:
Introduction About AZOBRIL 15% CREAM

AZOBRIL 15% CREAM contains Azelaic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Dicarboxylic acids. It is used to manage common acne (acne vulgaris). It is also used for the management of mild to moderate papulopustular rosacea.

Acne is a skin condition that occurs when the hair follicles become plugged with oil and dead skin cells. It causes whiteheads, blackheads or pimples. Rosacea is a skin condition that causes blushing or redness, pus-filled bumps and small visible blood vessels in the face.

AZOBRIL 15% CREAM should be applied with caution in patients with lung problems such as asthma. Consult your doctor before applying it.

Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before applying this medicine. Your doctor will decide whether you can use this medicine.

AZOBRIL 15% CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children under 12 years of age for the management of acne and also not recommended for use in children under 18 years of age for the management of rosacea. Consult your doctor before applying it.

The most common side effects of applying AZOBRIL 15% CREAM are burning, itching or redness of the skin (erythema) at the application site, scaling, pain, dryness, skin discolouration or irritation at the application site. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Common acne (acne vulgaris)
Mild to moderate papulopustular rosacea
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How AZOBRIL 15% CREAM Works

AZOBRIL 15% CREAM attacks the bacteria called propionibacterium acnes, which plays an essential part in causing acne. It also reduces growth of the harder outermost skin cells (keratin surface cells) that block the pores of the skin to cause blackheads and whiteheads.
usageDetails:
How to use AZOBRIL 15% CREAM

Apply AZOBRIL 15% CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water before and after using AZOBRIL 15% CREAM. Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area and rub it gently into the skin.

Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, mouth and other mucous membranes or open wounds. If it does, wash the eyes, mouth or other mucous membranes immediately with large amounts of cool water.

introduction:
Introduction About ISOTANE 20MG CAPSULE

ISOTANE 20MG CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take ISOTANE 20MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

ISOTANE 20MG CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.
uses: Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
usesDetails:
Uses Of ISOTANE 20MG CAPSULE
Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of ISOTANE 20MG CAPSULE for Acne:

ISOTANE 20MG CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How ISOTANE 20MG CAPSULE Works

ISOTANE 20MG CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.
usageInstructions: Take ISOTANE 20MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor.
Swallow the capsule whole with a glass of water; do not crush or chew it.
It is recommended to take the capsule with food to improve absorption and reduce stomach discomfort.
Take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels of the medication in your body.
Follow the prescribed dosage and duration carefully. Do not stop the medication abruptly without consulting your doctor, even if your symptoms improve.
Regular follow-ups and blood tests may be required to monitor your progress and ensure safe usage.
Avoid alcohol, excessive sun exposure, and waxing or laser treatments during the treatment period. Use sunscreen and moisturizers as recommended by your doctor.

If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose—do not double the dose to make up for it.

warningsRaw:
Warning & Precautions
Pregnancy
CONTRAINDICATED
Human and animal studies have shown that isotretinoin is teratogenic in nature. Birth defects such as abnormalities of the face, eyes, ears, skull, central nervous system, cardiovascular system, and thymus and parathyroid glands or IQ less than score of 85 have been reported in female patients who were pregnant or became pregnant while on therapy with isotretinoin. Therefore, ISOTANE 20MG CAPSULE is considered unsafe for use during pregnancy.
Women of childbearing potential must use a reliable contraceptive method to avoid becoming pregnant. If you accidentally became pregnant while taking this medicine, stop taking it and consult your gynaecologist for further evaluation.
It is also not recommended for you to get pregnant for one month after stopping isotretinoin tablets because some medicine may still be left in your body. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Breastfeeding
CONTRAINDICATED

It is not known whether this medicine is excreted in human milk. Because of the potential for adverse effects, nursing mothers should not receive ISOTANE 20MG CAPSULE

Driving and Using Machines
USE WITH CAUTION

Do not drive or operate machinery if you experience dizziness, drowsiness or decreased night vision after taking ISOTANE 20MG CAPSULE.

Alcohol
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

Avoid consuming alcohol while taking ISOTANE 20MG CAPSULE as it may increase side effects. Inform your doctor if you have an habit of chronic alcoholism.

Kidney
USE WITH CAUTION

ISOTANE 20MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CONTRAINDICATED

ISOTANE 20MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Allergy
CONTRAINDICATED

Do not take ISOTANE 20MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to Isotretinoin, soya, peanuts or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

Lungs
USE WITH CAUTION

ISOTANE 20MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients having asthma. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Use In Pediatrics
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

The use of isotretinoin tablets in pediatric patients less than 12 years of age has not been studied. The use of isotretinoin for severe recalcitrant nodular acne in adolescents ages 12 to 17 years under careful medical supervision. Extreme caution should be taken if the child is suffering from metabolic or structural bone disease.

Use In Geriatrics
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking ISOTANE 20MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Vitamin A supplements
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. minocycline, doxycycline)
Phenytoin (used to manage fits)

introduction:
Introduction About CLINBID 1.0% GEL

CLINBID 1.0% GEL contains Clindamycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of acne vulgaris. Acne vulgaris is a common skin condition that occurs when hair follicles get blocked with oil and dead skin cells. Symptoms include whiteheads, blackheads, small red, tender bumps, pimples, and pus-filled lumps on the skin.

Before applying CLINBID 1.0% GEL, inform your doctor if you have or ever had diarrhea, bloody diarrhea and pseudomembranous colitis. CLINBID 1.0% GEL is not recommended for use if you have a history of regional enteritis (inflammation of the small intestine), ulcerative colitis (inflammation of the large intestine) or antibiotic-associated colitis.

CLINBID 1.0% GEL should be used with caution during pregnancy or by breastfeeding women only if clearly needed. The safety and effectiveness of CLINBID 1.0% GEL in children under the age of 12 has not been established. The most common side effects of applying CLINBID 1.0% GEL are burning, itching, and redness of the skin. Consult your doctor if symptoms worsen.

usesDetails:
Uses Of CLINBID 1.0% GEL
Manage acne vulgaris
mechanismOfAction:
How CLINBID 1.0% GEL Works

CLINBID 1.0% GEL acts against the bacteria by binding to the 50S subunit of the bacterial ribosome (site of protein synthesis), which in turn manages protein synthesis and works against the infection-causing bacteria.
usageDetails:
How to use CLINBID 1.0% GEL

Apply CLINBID 1.0% GEL as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before use. Wash and dry the whole area, apply a thin film once daily to the skin where acne lesions appear and use enough to cover the entire affected area. In case of contact with the eyes, mouth or nostrils, rinse it off immediately and thoroughly with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About PINOIN

PINOIN contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take PINOIN exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

PINOIN is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.
uses: Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
usesDetails:
Uses Of PINOIN
Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of PINOIN for Acne:

PINOIN is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How PINOIN Works

PINOIN work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

TRONIN 0.05% CREAM contains Tretinoin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Retinoids. It is used to manage acne. It can also be used to manage wrinkles, skin spots and rough skin. Acne is defined as a skin disease involving inflammation of the sebaceous follicles of the face and upper body, characterized by lesions on the face, back, upper chest and shoulders.

Before using TRONIN 0.05% CREAM, inform your doctor if you have any sunburn, sun sensitivity or any other skin problems. TRONIN 0.05% CREAM should be used in pregnancy only if specifically directed by your doctor. TRONIN 0.05% CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women.

The safety and effectiveness of TRONIN 0.05% CREAM in children (aged less than 12 years) have not been established, so consult your doctor before using it. The most common side effect of using TRONIN 0.05% CREAM is skin irritation like redness, burning, stinging, dryness and peeling. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About ACTAME 20 SOFTGEL

ACTAME 20 SOFTGEL contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take ACTAME 20 SOFTGEL exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

ACTAME 20 SOFTGEL is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.
uses: Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
usesDetails:
Uses Of ACTAME 20 SOFTGEL
Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of ACTAME 20 SOFTGEL for Acne:

ACTAME 20 SOFTGEL is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How ACTAME 20 SOFTGEL Works

ACTAME 20 SOFTGEL work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

Swallow the capsule whole with a glass of water; do not crush or chew it.

Regular follow-ups and blood tests may be required to monitor your progress and ensure safe usage.
Avoid alcohol, excessive sun exposure, and waxing or laser treatments during the treatment period. Use sunscreen and moisturizers as recommended by your doctor.

warningsRaw:
Warning & Precautions
Pregnancy
CONTRAINDICATED
Human and animal studies have shown that isotretinoin is teratogenic in nature. Birth defects such as abnormalities of the face, eyes, ears, skull, central nervous system, cardiovascular system, and thymus and parathyroid glands or IQ less than score of 85 have been reported in female patients who were pregnant or became pregnant while on therapy with isotretinoin. Therefore, ACTAME 20 SOFTGEL is considered unsafe for use during pregnancy.
Women of childbearing potential must use a reliable contraceptive method to avoid becoming pregnant. If you accidentally became pregnant while taking this medicine, stop taking it and consult your gynaecologist for further evaluation.
It is also not recommended for you to get pregnant for one month after stopping isotretinoin tablets because some medicine may still be left in your body. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Introduction About GLOTRET 20MG TABLET

GLOTRET 20MG TABLET contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take GLOTRET 20MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

GLOTRET 20MG TABLET is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.

Benefits of GLOTRET 20MG TABLET for Acne:

GLOTRET 20MG TABLET is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How GLOTRET 20MG TABLET Works

GLOTRET 20MG TABLET work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

introduction:
Introduction About FEMCINOL A GEL

FEMCINOL A GEL is a combination of Clindamycin and Nicotinamide which belongs to a group of medicines called Lincomycin antibiotics and Vitamin B3 complex, respectively. FEMCINOL A GEL is used to manage mild to moderate acne which is a skin condition that occurs when hair follicles become plugged with oil and dead skin cells which may occur due to variety of causes such as genetics, fluctuating hormone levels, stress, high humidity or using oily or greasy personal care products which may affect people of all ages.

It is characterized by symptoms such as open or closed plugged pores, small red & tender bumps, pimples, large, solid or painful lumps under the skin and painful & pus-filled lumps under the skin.

Before using FEMCINOL A GEL inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, lung or heart diseases. Avoid applying FEMCINOL A GEL to a cut, scrapped, sunburnt or eczema affected skin.

FEMCINOL A GEL should be used with caution in pregnant and in breastfeeding women. FEMCINOL A GEL is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 12 years). Consult your doctor before applying.

The most common side effects of using FEMCINOL A GEL are skin inflammation, contact dermatitis (red, itchy rash), inflammation of hair follicles, itchy skin, dry skin and peeling of skin. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

Managed areas on the face need not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Do not apply this medicine beyond the recommended duration. Avoid applying FEMCINOL A GEL around your eyes, including eyelids. Rinse it off with water if you accidentally get it in these areas.

Introduction About SALIWIN 12% OINTMENT

SALIWIN 12% OINTMENT contains Salicylic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Keratolytic agents. SALIWIN 12% OINTMENT is used manage skin conditions such as psoriasis, dry, scaly skin conditions and acne. It is also used to manage dandruff, corn and calluses (thickened layers of skin) in affected individuals.

SALIWIN 12% OINTMENT is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Salicylic acid. It is also not recommended for use in patients with active inflammation/dermatitis, infection (at the application site), acute viral infection, skin malignancy, and/or tanned skin. Before applying SALIWIN 12% OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for surgery, and/or suffering from any kidney problems. SALIWIN 12% OINTMENT is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women. If you are a breastfeeding women, consult your doctor before using the medicine. Avoid applying the medicine on skin areas which might come in direct contact with infant’s skin.

SALIWIN 12% OINTMENT should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 1-15 years). It is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before applying the medicine. The most common side effects of applying SALIWIN 12% OINTMENT are erythema (skin redness) or skin dryness. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About BENCLEAR 5% GEL

BENCLEAR 5% GEL contains Benzoyl peroxide which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-bacterial and Anti-inflammatory agents. It is used in the management of acne (pimples) in the face, chest and back. It is also used to unplug the blocked pores (blackheads and whiteheads) and absorb excess oil from the skin.

Before using BENCLEAR 5% GEL, inform your doctor if you are having any allergy to foods, preservatives or dyes or if you are already under any medication for acne.

It is not recommended to use hard cleansers, scrubs, medicated soap or cosmetic products containing alcohol while using this medicine.

BENCLEAR 5% GEL is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless clearly needed. Consult your doctor before using the medicine.

Avoid repeated exposure to sunlight or other sources of UV light (such as sun bed). In case of accidental contact, rinse thoroughly with warm water and pat dry.

Most common side effects of BENCLEAR 5% GEL are skin redness and irriation, burning, stinging sensation in the skin. Consult your doctor if any of above symptoms worsens.
uses: Manage acne (pimples) formation
Remove excessive oil from the skin
Unplug blocked pores
