mechanismOfAction:
How BENCLEAR 5% GEL Works

BENCLEAR 5% GEL works against the acne-causing bacteria. This medicine after applying on the affected skin gets absorbed and is converted to benzoic acid. This benzoic acid gets metabolized by skin proteins and releases active free-radical oxygen species that results in the alteration of bacterial proteins. This helps to manage acne or pimples. BENCLEAR 5% GEL also acts as a keratolytic agent which promotes peeling of the skin and absorb excess oil from the skin further managing acne formation and skin irritation.
usageDetails:
How to use BENCLEAR 5% GEL

Always apply BENCLEAR 5% GEL as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area as instructed by the doctor.

Avoid contact with eyes, lips, mouth, nose, mucous membranes and sensitive areas of the neck. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending you’re your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About PAPULEX CLEANSING GEL

Papulex Soap Free Cleansing Gel provides an effective and complete skincare regimen for managing acne. It contains nicotinamide and zinc as active ingredients to effectively control inflammation, reduce oil secretion, fight against acne-causing bacteria, lessen the risk of scarring and moisturize the skin.

Nicotinamide is an anti-inflammatory agent that reduces acne by reducing sebum. It improves skin barrier function by reducing water loss through the epidermis (the outer skin layer) thus enhancing skin hydration. It also improves complexion by improving the pigmentation, blotchiness and redness of aging skin. Zinc suppresses sebum production through its antiandrogenic activity.

Always use Papulex Soap Free Cleansing Gel as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply gel on the face and affected areas in the morning and evening by massaging delicately to facilitate absorption. Rinse thoroughly and dry the skin without dragging it. Avoid contact with eyes, in case of accidental contact with eyes wash immediately.

name: BENLITE A Gel 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About BENLITE A GEL

BENLITE A GEL is a combination of Adapalene and Benzoyl peroxide which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiacne agents. It is used in the management of acne.

Acne vulgaris (commonly known as acne) is an inflammatory skin condition that occurs when the hair follicles present in the skin are clogged with excess oil and/or dead skin cells. It can also be aggravated by few bacteria (such as Propionibacterium acnes) and is highly common among on the teenagers and the young adults.

It primarily affects the face, upper arms, trunk or back and is often characterized by pus-filled pimples, red bumps with inflammatory and non-inflammatory lesions. BENLITE A GEL is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 9 years or older).

Apply a thin layer of BENLITE A GEL on the affected skin areas. Avoid contact of this medicine with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose or with open wounds. You must also protect your skin against sun light and against other light sources (such as UV lamps).

Do not use BENLITE A GEL if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. BENLITE A GEL can be used in breastfeeding women if required. The most common side effects of using BENLITE A GEL are dry skin, mild burning sensation and skin irritation, redness or scaling. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Manage acne

mechanismOfAction:
How BENLITE A GEL Works

BENLITE A GEL is a combination of two medicines namely, adapalene and benzoyl peroxide.

Adapalene is a topical retinoid (a type of vitamin A). It modulates the skin cell cycle and manages the accumulation of excess sebum (natural oil produced by the skin) and dead skin cells on the hair follicles of the skin. It also reduces inflammation on the skin.

Benzoyl peroxide is a keratolytic agent with antimicrobial properties. It improves skin’s tendency to exfoliate the dead skin cells naturally. It also reduces the number of acne-causing bacteria on the skin which can reduce the further spread of acne.

Collectively, they unclog the hair follicles of the skin and exfoliates dead skin cells which reduces acne breakouts.
usageDetails:
How to use BENLITE A GEL

Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected skin areas or as directed by the physician. It is for topical use only. Wash your hands before and after application.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Avoid contact of BENLITE A GEL with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose, hair or with open wounds (cuts, scrapes or sunburn).

name: Clindot Gel 20gm
introduction:
Introduction About CLINDOT GEL

CLINDOT GEL contains Clindamycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of acne vulgaris. Acne vulgaris is a common skin condition that occurs when hair follicles get blocked with oil and dead skin cells. Symptoms include whiteheads, blackheads, small red, tender bumps, pimples, and pus-filled lumps on the skin.

Before applying CLINDOT GEL, inform your doctor if you have or ever had diarrhea, bloody diarrhea and pseudomembranous colitis. CLINDOT GEL is not recommended for use if you have a history of regional enteritis (inflammation of the small intestine), ulcerative colitis (inflammation of the large intestine) or antibiotic-associated colitis.

CLINDOT GEL should be used with caution during pregnancy or by breastfeeding women only if clearly needed. The safety and effectiveness of CLINDOT GEL in children under the age of 12 has not been established. The most common side effects of applying CLINDOT GEL are burning, itching, and redness of the skin. Consult your doctor if symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage acne vulgaris
usesDetails:
Uses Of CLINDOT GEL
Manage acne vulgaris
mechanismOfAction:
How CLINDOT GEL Works

CLINDOT GEL acts against the bacteria by binding to the 50S subunit of the bacterial ribosome (site of protein synthesis), which in turn manages protein synthesis and kills the infection-causing bacteria.
usageDetails:
How to use CLINDOT GEL

Apply CLINDOT GEL as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before use. Wash and dry the whole area, apply a thin film once daily to the skin where acne lesions appear and use enough to cover the entire affected area. In case of contact with the eyes, mouth or nostrils, rinse it off immediately and thoroughly with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About SALICARE 12% OINTMENT

SALICARE 12% OINTMENT contains Salicylic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Keratolytic agents. SALICARE 12% OINTMENT is used manage skin conditions such as psoriasis, dry, scaly skin conditions and acne. It is also used to manage dandruff, corn and calluses (thickened layers of skin) in affected individuals.

SALICARE 12% OINTMENT is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Salicylic acid. It is also not recommended for use in patients with active inflammation/dermatitis, infection (at the application site), acute viral infection, skin malignancy, and/or tanned skin. Before applying SALICARE 12% OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for surgery, and/or suffering from any kidney problems. SALICARE 12% OINTMENT is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women. If you are a breastfeeding women, consult your doctor before using the medicine. Avoid applying the medicine on skin areas which might come in direct contact with infant’s skin.

SALICARE 12% OINTMENT should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 1-15 years). It is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before applying the medicine. The most common side effects of applying SALICARE 12% OINTMENT are erythema (skin redness) or skin dryness. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About GEONOIN 20MG CAPSULE

GEONOIN 20MG CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take GEONOIN 20MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

GEONOIN 20MG CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.

Benefits of GEONOIN 20MG CAPSULE for Acne:

GEONOIN 20MG CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How GEONOIN 20MG CAPSULE Works

GEONOIN 20MG CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

ACNESOL GEL contains Clindamycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of acne vulgaris. Acne vulgaris is a common skin condition that occurs when hair follicles get blocked with oil and dead skin cells. Symptoms include whiteheads, blackheads, small red, tender bumps, pimples, and pus-filled lumps on the skin.

Before applying ACNESOL GEL, inform your doctor if you have or ever had diarrhea, bloody diarrhea and pseudomembranous colitis. ACNESOL GEL is not recommended for use if you have a history of regional enteritis (inflammation of the small intestine), ulcerative colitis (inflammation of the large intestine) or antibiotic-associated colitis.

ACNESOL GEL should be used with caution during pregnancy or by breastfeeding women only if clearly needed. The safety and effectiveness of ACNESOL GEL in children under the age of 12 has not been established. The most common side effects of applying ACNESOL GEL are burning, itching, and redness of the skin. Consult your doctor if symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About ACTAME 10 SOFTGEL

ACTAME 10 SOFTGEL contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take ACTAME 10 SOFTGEL exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

ACTAME 10 SOFTGEL is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.

Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of ACTAME 10 SOFTGEL for Acne:

ACTAME 10 SOFTGEL is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How ACTAME 10 SOFTGEL Works

ACTAME 10 SOFTGEL work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

warningsRaw:
Warning & Precautions
Pregnancy
CONTRAINDICATED
Human and animal studies have shown that isotretinoin is teratogenic in nature. Birth defects such as abnormalities of the face, eyes, ears, skull, central nervous system, cardiovascular system, and thymus and parathyroid glands or IQ less than score of 85 have been reported in female patients who were pregnant or became pregnant while on therapy with isotretinoin. Therefore, ACTAME 10 SOFTGEL is considered unsafe for use during pregnancy.
Women of childbearing potential must use a reliable contraceptive method to avoid becoming pregnant. If you accidentally became pregnant while taking this medicine, stop taking it and consult your gynaecologist for further evaluation.
It is also not recommended for you to get pregnant for one month after stopping isotretinoin tablets because some medicine may still be left in your body. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Breastfeeding
CONTRAINDICATED

It is not known whether this medicine is excreted in human milk. Because of the potential for adverse effects, nursing mothers should not receive ACTAME 10 SOFTGEL

Driving and Using Machines
USE WITH CAUTION

Do not drive or operate machinery if you experience dizziness, drowsiness or decreased night vision after taking ACTAME 10 SOFTGEL.

Alcohol
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

Avoid consuming alcohol while taking ACTAME 10 SOFTGEL as it may increase side effects. Inform your doctor if you have an habit of chronic alcoholism.

Kidney
USE WITH CAUTION

ACTAME 10 SOFTGEL should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CONTRAINDICATED

ACTAME 10 SOFTGEL is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CONTRAINDICATED

Lungs
USE WITH CAUTION

ACTAME 10 SOFTGEL should be used with caution in patients having asthma. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Use In Pediatrics
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

The use of isotretinoin tablets in pediatric patients less than 12 years of age has not been studied. Human and animal studies have shown that isotretinoin is teratogenic in nature. Birth defects such as abnormalities of the face, eyes, ears, skull, central nervous system, cardiovascular system, and thymus and parathyroid glands or IQ less than score of 85 have been reported in female patients who were pregnant or became pregnant while on therapy with isotretinoin. name: NAX Gel 20gm
introduction:
Introduction About NAX GEL

NAX GEL contains Allantoin, Nicotinamide and Clindamycin which belongs to the group of medicines called Dermatologic agent, Vitamin B complex and Antibiotics. It is used to manage acne, skin infections caused due to bacteria and oily skin.

Before using NAX GEL, inform your doctor if you have any kidney, liver, heart, or lung diseases. In pregnant and breast-feeding women, NAX GEL should be used with caution.NAX GEL should not be used by children under the age of 12.

The most common side effects of NAX GEL are skin burning or itching, skin redness, oily skin, skin peeling, skin irritation, and an upset stomach. Contact your doctor if any of these worsen or don’t improve.

Manage skin infections caused due to bacteria
Manage oily skin
usesDetails:
Uses Of NAX GEL
Manage acne
Manage skin infections caused due to bacteria
Manage oily skin
mechanismOfAction:
How NAX GEL Works

NAX GEL helps in the management of various skin conditions. Allantoin is a dermatological agent that stimulates wound healing and tissue repair by forming new cells. It also repairs dry, rough, scaly, and itchy skin by increasing the blood flow, forming new blood vessels, and increasing collagen production at the site of application.

Nicotinamide is a vitamin B complex that has an anti-inflammatory effect by blocking various substances that cause redness and swelling, as well as aiding in the reduction of sebum production. 

Clindamycin is an Antibacterial agent which acts on the bacterial cell wall and interferes with its important life functions leading to its destruction. Together, they help in the management of various skin problems.
usageDetails:
How to use NAX GEL

Always apply NAX GEL as directed by your physician. Clean and dry the affected area before the application. It is for external use only. Wash hands before and after the application NAX GEL. Do not apply NAX GEL on the skin surface that is cut, scraped, sunburned or eczema affected. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids, nose, and mouth.

name: CLINDAFIN N Gel 20gm
introduction:
Introduction About CLINDAFIN N GEL

CLINDAFIN N GEL is a combination of Clindamycin and Nicotinamide which belongs to a group of medicines called Lincomycin antibiotics and Vitamin B3 complex, respectively. CLINDAFIN N GEL is used to manage mild to moderate acne which is a skin condition that occurs when hair follicles become plugged with oil and dead skin cells which may occur due to variety of causes such as genetics, fluctuating hormone levels, stress, high humidity or using oily or greasy personal care products which may affect people of all ages.

It is characterized by symptoms such as open or closed plugged pores, small red & tender bumps, pimples, large, solid or painful lumps under the skin and painful & pus-filled lumps under the skin.

Before using CLINDAFIN N GEL inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, lung or heart diseases. Avoid applying CLINDAFIN N GEL to a cut, scrapped, sunburnt or eczema affected skin.

CLINDAFIN N GEL should be used with caution in pregnant and in breastfeeding women. CLINDAFIN N GEL is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 12 years). Consult your doctor before applying.

The most common side effects of using CLINDAFIN N GEL are skin inflammation, contact dermatitis (red, itchy rash), inflammation of hair follicles, itchy skin, dry skin and peeling of skin. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage mild to moderate acne
usesDetails:

Manage mild to moderate acne
mechanismOfAction:
How CLINDAFIN N GEL Works

CLINDAFIN N GEL helps to manage acne, where Clindamycin reduces free fatty acid concentrations on the skin and suppresses the growth of Propionibacterium acnes (Corynebacterium acnes), a bacteria found in sebaceous glands and follicles and Nicotinamide exerts anti-inflammatory effect in acne and interrupts sebum production.
usageDetails:
How to use CLINDAFIN N GEL

Apply CLINDAFIN N GEL as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Before applying the medicine normally wash and dry the affected area and apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area. Managed areas on the face need not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Do not apply this medicine beyond the recommended duration. Avoid applying CLINDAFIN N GEL around your eyes, including eyelids. Rinse it off with water if you accidentally get it in these areas.

introduction:
Introduction About BENLITE 5% GEL

BENLITE 5% GEL contains Benzoyl peroxide which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-bacterial and Anti-inflammatory agents. It is used in the management of acne (pimples) in the face, chest and back. It is also used to unplug the blocked pores (blackheads and whiteheads) and absorb excess oil from the skin.

Before using BENLITE 5% GEL, inform your doctor if you are having any allergy to foods, preservatives or dyes or if you are already under any medication for acne.

It is not recommended to use hard cleansers, scrubs, medicated soap or cosmetic products containing alcohol while using this medicine.

BENLITE 5% GEL is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless clearly needed. Consult your doctor before using the medicine.

Avoid repeated exposure to sunlight or other sources of UV light (such as sun bed). In case of accidental contact, rinse thoroughly with warm water and pat dry.

Most common side effects of BENLITE 5% GEL are skin redness and irriation, burning, stinging sensation in the skin. Consult your doctor if any of above symptoms worsens.
uses: Manage acne (pimples) formation
Remove excessive oil from the skin
Unplug blocked pores

Manage acne (pimples) formation

mechanismOfAction:
How BENLITE 5% GEL Works

BENLITE 5% GEL works against the acne-causing bacteria. This medicine after applying on the affected skin gets absorbed and is converted to benzoic acid. This benzoic acid gets metabolized by skin proteins and releases active free-radical oxygen species that results in the alteration of bacterial proteins. This helps to manage acne or pimples. BENLITE 5% GEL also acts as a keratolytic agent which promotes peeling of the skin and absorb excess oil from the skin further managing acne formation and skin irritation.
usageDetails:
How to use BENLITE 5% GEL

Always apply BENLITE 5% GEL as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area as instructed by the doctor.

Avoid contact with eyes, lips, mouth, nose, mucous membranes and sensitive areas of the neck. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending you’re your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About BENZONIX XL GEL WASH

BENZONIX GEL Wash is used in the management of acne. It is used on the face, chest, or back where the skin has a lot of blackheads, spots, and pimples. It contains Benzoyl peroxide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-bacterial and Anti-inflammatory agents that attack the bacteria known as Propionibacterium acnes, one of the main causes of acne.

BENZONIX GEL Wash is not recommended for severe acne and/or on the skin with deeper pits and dents, broken and/or damaged skin, or for people who are allergic to benzoyl peroxide and/or any other ingredient found in BENZONIX GEL Wash.

It is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless necessary. Consult your doctor before using BENZONIX GEL Wash.

It is recommended to use only those products that are labelled as non-comedogenic to prevent clogging of pores.

Avoid applying BENZONIX GEL Wash around your eyes, including eyelids and other mucous membranes. Also, care must be taken not to apply BENZONIX GEL Wash to broken or damaged skin or to skin with dents or scars.

The most common side effects of using BENZONIX GEL Wash are skin tension, burning, stinging, itching, peeling, and reddening of the skin. Consult your doctor if any of the above reactions bother you.
uses: To manage acne
usesDetails:
Uses Of BENZONIX XL GEL WASH
To manage acne
mechanismOfAction:
How BENZONIX XL GEL WASH Works

BENZONIX GEL Wash works against acne-causing bacteria. This medicine, after being applied to the affected skin, gets absorbed and is converted to benzoic acid. This benzoic acid gets metabolized by skin proteins and releases active free-radical oxygen species that result in the alteration of bacterial proteins. This helps to manage acne or pimples. BENZONIX GEL Wash also acts as a keratolytic agent, which promotes peeling of the skin and absorbs excess oil from the skin, further preventing acne formation and skin irritation.
usageDetails:
How to use BENZONIX XL GEL WASH

Always use BENZONIX GEL Wash as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you, depending on your disease condition.

Wet the area to be managed. Wash hands before use and place a small amount of BENZONIX GEL Wash your hands to wash the affected area. Wash and rinse thoroughly with water after application.

introduction:
Introduction About ISAC 20MG CAPSULE

ISAC 20MG CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take ISAC 20MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

ISAC 20MG CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.
uses: Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
usesDetails:
Uses Of ISAC 20MG CAPSULE
Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of ISAC 20MG CAPSULE for Acne:

ISAC 20MG CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How ISAC 20MG CAPSULE Works

ISAC 20MG CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

Pregnancy
CONTRAINDICATED
Human and animal studies have shown that isotretinoin is teratogenic in nature. Birth defects such as abnormalities of the face, eyes, ears, skull, central nervous system, cardiovascular system, and thymus and parathyroid glands or IQ less than score of 85 have been reported in female patients who were pregnant or became pregnant while on therapy with isotretinoin. Therefore, ISAC 20MG CAPSULE is considered unsafe for use during pregnancy.
Women of childbearing potential must use a reliable contraceptive method to avoid becoming pregnant. If you accidentally became pregnant while taking this medicine, stop taking it and consult your gynaecologist for further evaluation.
It is also not recommended for you to get pregnant for one month after stopping isotretinoin tablets because some medicine may still be left in your body. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE

TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.
uses: Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE
Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE for Acne:

TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE Works

TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose—do not double the dose to make up for it.

In case you or anybody else accidently take too much of TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Pregnancy
CONTRAINDICATED
Human and animal studies have shown that isotretinoin is teratogenic in nature. Birth defects such as abnormalities of the face, eyes, ears, skull, central nervous system, cardiovascular system, and thymus and parathyroid glands or IQ less than score of 85 have been reported in female patients who were pregnant or became pregnant while on therapy with isotretinoin. Therefore, TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE is considered unsafe for use during pregnancy.
Women of childbearing potential must use a reliable contraceptive method to avoid becoming pregnant. If you accidentally became pregnant while taking this medicine, stop taking it and consult your gynaecologist for further evaluation.
It is also not recommended for you to get pregnant for one month after stopping isotretinoin tablets because some medicine may still be left in your body. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Before using BENZONAK 2.5% LOTION, inform your doctor if you are having any allergy to foods, preservatives or dyes or if you are already under any medication for acne.

It is not recommended to use hard cleansers, scrubs, medicated soap or cosmetic products containing alcohol while using this medicine.

BENZONAK 2.5% LOTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless clearly needed. Consult your doctor before using the medicine.

Avoid repeated exposure to sunlight or other sources of UV light (such as sun bed). In case of accidental contact, rinse thoroughly with warm water and pat dry.

Most common side effects of BENZONAK 2.5% LOTION are skin redness and irriation, burning, stinging sensation in the skin. Consult your doctor if any of above symptoms worsens.

BENZONAK 2.5% LOTION works against the acne-causing bacteria. This medicine after applying on the affected skin gets absorbed and is converted to benzoic acid. BENZONAK 2.5% LOTION also acts as a keratolytic agent which promotes peeling of the skin and absorb excess oil from the skin further managing acne formation and skin irritation.

introduction:
Introduction About ULTRABRITE CREAM

ULTRABRITE CREAM is a combination of Hydroquinone, Tretinoin, Mometasone furoate which belongs to the group of medicines called Depigmenting agents, Retinoids and Corticosteroids respectively. It is used in adults for the management of moderate to severe melasma (dark spots on the skin) in association with sun-avoidance measures, like using sunscreens and wearing protective clothing. Melasma is one of the most frequently acquired hyperpigmentation (excess melanin production) disorders with symptoms such as symmetrical brown patches on sun exposed areas mainly on face.

It is advised to avoid exposure to sun during management with ULTRABRITE CREAM for better results. While going out apply sunscreens and wear full covering protective clothes. Before using ULTRABRITE CREAM inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung or heart diseases.

Safety and efficacy of ULTRABRITE CREAM is not established in pregnant women and in children below 12 years of age. Ask for your doctor’s advice before using. ULTRABRITE CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of using ULTRABRITE CREAM are mild burning, stinging, redness and dryness. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.

How ULTRABRITE CREAM Works

ULTRABRITE CREAM helps in managing melasma where Hydroquinone is a skin bleaching agent that blocks enzyme tyrosinase which is responsible for the production of melanin that cause pigmentation. Thus, it helps for fading of dark spots in skin. Tretinoin helps to recover the damage to the skin caused by sun exposure (photodamage) by thickening skin layer and loss of keratinized cells.it helps to rejuvenate the skin. Mometasone furoate blocks prostaglandin synthesis and reduces redness, swelling and itching caused by tretinoin and other skin infections.

Apply ULTRABRITE CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before and after applying ULTRABRITE CREAM. Wash your face with a mild soap and dry properly. Apply ULTRABRITE CREAM at night and gently massage it in until it is absorbed. Avoid contact with your eyes, nose, mouth, mucous membrane. Avoid exposure to sunlight while using this medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: CLINDASIL Gel 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About CLINDASIL GEL

CLINDASIL GEL is a combination of Clindamycin and Nicotinamide which belongs to a group of medicines called Lincomycin antibiotics and Vitamin B3 complex, respectively. CLINDASIL GEL is used to manage mild to moderate acne which is a skin condition that occurs when hair follicles become plugged with oil and dead skin cells which may occur due to variety of causes such as genetics, fluctuating hormone levels, stress, high humidity or using oily or greasy personal care products which may affect people of all ages.

It is characterized by symptoms such as open or closed plugged pores, small red & tender bumps, pimples, large, solid or painful lumps under the skin and painful & pus-filled lumps under the skin.

Before using CLINDASIL GEL inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, lung or heart diseases. Avoid applying CLINDASIL GEL to a cut, scrapped, sunburnt or eczema affected skin.

CLINDASIL GEL should be used with caution in pregnant and in breastfeeding women. CLINDASIL GEL is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 12 years). Consult your doctor before applying.

The most common side effects of using CLINDASIL GEL are skin inflammation, contact dermatitis (red, itchy rash), inflammation of hair follicles, itchy skin, dry skin and peeling of skin. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

usesDetails:

Manage mild to moderate acne
mechanismOfAction:
How CLINDASIL GEL Works

CLINDASIL GEL helps to manage acne, where Clindamycin reduces free fatty acid concentrations on the skin and suppresses the growth of Propionibacterium acnes (Corynebacterium acnes), a bacteria found in sebaceous glands and follicles and Nicotinamide exerts anti-inflammatory effect in acne and interrupts sebum production.

Apply CLINDASIL GEL as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Before applying the medicine normally wash and dry the affected area and apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area. Managed areas on the face need not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Do not apply this medicine beyond the recommended duration. Avoid applying CLINDASIL GEL around your eyes, including eyelids. Rinse it off with water if you accidentally get it in these areas.

introduction:
Introduction About D ACNE I 10MG CAPSULE

D ACNE I 10MG CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take D ACNE I 10MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

D ACNE I 10MG CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.
uses: Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
usesDetails:
Uses Of D ACNE I 10MG CAPSULE
Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of D ACNE I 10MG CAPSULE for Acne:

D ACNE I 10MG CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How D ACNE I 10MG CAPSULE Works

D ACNE I 10MG CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

Pregnancy
CONTRAINDICATED
Human and animal studies have shown that isotretinoin is teratogenic in nature. Birth defects such as abnormalities of the face, eyes, ears, skull, central nervous system, cardiovascular system, and thymus and parathyroid glands or IQ less than score of 85 have been reported in female patients who were pregnant or became pregnant while on therapy with isotretinoin. Therefore, D ACNE I 10MG CAPSULE is considered unsafe for use during pregnancy.
Women of childbearing potential must use a reliable contraceptive method to avoid becoming pregnant. If you accidentally became pregnant while taking this medicine, stop taking it and consult your gynaecologist for further evaluation.
It is also not recommended for you to get pregnant for one month after stopping isotretinoin tablets because some medicine may still be left in your body. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CONTRAINDICATED

Introduction About SYNORET 10 CAPSULE

SYNORET 10 CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take SYNORET 10 CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

SYNORET 10 CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.

Benefits of SYNORET 10 CAPSULE for Acne:

SYNORET 10 CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. mechanismOfAction:
How SYNORET 10 CAPSULE Works

SYNORET 10 CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

introduction:
Introduction About TETILIN MS GEL

TETILIN MS GEL is used to manage acne. It can also be used to manage wrinkles, skin spots and rough skin. It contains Tretinoin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Retinoids that works by modifying the abnormal cavity formation that comes from the excessive conversion of cytoplasm to keratin (a strong protein that is the main substance that forms hair, skin) of epithelial cells, promoting detachment of tough cells and enhancing shedding.

Before using TETILIN MS GEL, inform your doctor if you have any sunburn, sun sensitivity or any other skin problems. TETILIN MS GEL should be used in pregnancy only if specifically directed by your doctor. TETILIN MS GEL should be used with caution in breastfeeding women.

The safety and effectiveness of TETILIN MS GEL in children and adolescents (aged less than 12 years) have not been established, so consult your doctor before using the medicine. The most common side effect of using TETILIN MS GEL is skin irritation like redness, burning, stinging, dryness and peeling. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About ISOZIP 20 SOFTGEL CAPSULE

ISOZIP 20 SOFTGEL CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take ISOZIP 20 SOFTGEL CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

ISOZIP 20 SOFTGEL CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.
uses: Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
usesDetails:
Uses Of ISOZIP 20 SOFTGEL CAPSULE
Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of ISOZIP 20 SOFTGEL CAPSULE for Acne:

ISOZIP 20 SOFTGEL CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How ISOZIP 20 SOFTGEL CAPSULE Works

ISOZIP 20 SOFTGEL CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

Swallow the capsule whole with a glass of water; do not crush or chew it.
It is recommended to take the capsule with food to improve absorption and reduce stomach discomfort.
Take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels of the medication in your body.
Follow the prescribed dosage and duration carefully. Do not stop the medication abruptly without consulting your doctor, even if your symptoms improve.
Regular follow-ups and blood tests may be required to monitor your progress and ensure safe usage.
Avoid alcohol, excessive sun exposure, and waxing or laser treatments during the treatment period. Use sunscreen and moisturizers as recommended by your doctor.

If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose—do not double the dose to make up for it.

In case you or anybody else accidently take too much of ISOZIP 20 SOFTGEL CAPSULE, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of ISOZIP 20 SOFTGEL CAPSULE overdose are severe headache, abdominal pain, nausea, dizziness, redness of face, vomiting, somnolence, irritability, and itching.

D ACNE I 20MG CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take D ACNE I 20MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

D ACNE I 20MG CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.
uses: Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
usesDetails:
Uses Of D ACNE I 20MG CAPSULE
Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of D ACNE I 20MG CAPSULE for Acne:

D ACNE I 20MG CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How D ACNE I 20MG CAPSULE Works

D ACNE I 20MG CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.
usageInstructions: Take D ACNE I 20MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor.
Swallow the capsule whole with a glass of water; do not crush or chew it.
It is recommended to take the capsule with food to improve absorption and reduce stomach discomfort.
Take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels of the medication in your body.
Follow the prescribed dosage and duration carefully. Do not stop the medication abruptly without consulting your doctor, even if your symptoms improve.
Regular follow-ups and blood tests may be required to monitor your progress and ensure safe usage.
Avoid alcohol, excessive sun exposure, and waxing or laser treatments during the treatment period. Use sunscreen and moisturizers as recommended by your doctor.

How to use D ACNE I 20MG CAPSULE
Take D ACNE I 20MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor.
Swallow the capsule whole with a glass of water; do not crush or chew it.
It is recommended to take the capsule with food to improve absorption and reduce stomach discomfort.
Take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels of the medication in your body.

Regular follow-ups and blood tests may be required to monitor your progress and ensure safe usage.
Avoid alcohol, excessive sun exposure, and waxing or laser treatments during the treatment period. Use sunscreen and moisturizers as recommended by your doctor.
What if I Forget to take D ACNE I 20MG CAPSULE:

If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose—do not double the dose to make up for it.

Overdosage of D ACNE I 20MG CAPSULE –

In case you or anybody else accidently take too much of D ACNE I 20MG CAPSULE, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of D ACNE I 20MG CAPSULE overdose are severe headache, abdominal pain, nausea, dizziness, redness of face, vomiting, somnolence, irritability, and itching.

Do not drive or operate machinery if you experience dizziness, drowsiness or decreased night vision after taking D ACNE I 20MG CAPSULE.
Avoid consuming alcohol while taking D ACNE I 20MG CAPSULE as it may increase side effects. Inform your doctor if you have an habit of chronic alcoholism.
D ACNE I 20MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking it.
D ACNE I 20MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take D ACNE I 20MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to Isotretinoin, soya, peanuts or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.
D ACNE I 20MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients having asthma. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The use of isotretinoin tablets in pediatric patients less than 12 years of age has not been studied. The use of isotretinoin for severe recalcitrant nodular acne in adolescents ages 12 to 17 years under careful medical supervision. Extreme caution should be taken if the child is suffering from metabolic or structural bone disease.
There is no proper information about the use of D ACNE I 20MG CAPSULE in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

D ACNE I 20MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have:

High blood fat levels
High levels of Vitamin A

Before taking D ACNE I 20MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you:

Have or had mental illness or family history of mental illness such as depression, mood disorders, psychosis, aggressive behaviour, or hurting or killing self
Have diabetes
Are fructose intolerant
Are overweight

Warning & Precautions
Pregnancy
CONTRAINDICATED
Human and animal studies have shown that isotretinoin is teratogenic in nature. Birth defects such as abnormalities of the face, eyes, ears, skull, central nervous system, cardiovascular system, and thymus and parathyroid glands or IQ less than score of 85 have been reported in female patients who were pregnant or became pregnant while on therapy with isotretinoin. Therefore, D ACNE I 20MG CAPSULE is considered unsafe for use during pregnancy.
Women of childbearing potential must use a reliable contraceptive method to avoid becoming pregnant. If you accidentally became pregnant while taking this medicine, stop taking it and consult your gynaecologist for further evaluation.
It is also not recommended for you to get pregnant for one month after stopping isotretinoin tablets because some medicine may still be left in your body. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Breastfeeding

It is not known whether this medicine is excreted in human milk. Because of the potential for adverse effects, nursing mothers should not receive D ACNE I 20MG CAPSULE

name: FUROSONE + Cream 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About FUROSONE + CREAM

FUROSONE + CREAM is a combination of Hydroquinone, Tretinoin, Mometasone furoate which belongs to the group of medicines called Depigmenting agents, Retinoids and Corticosteroids respectively. It is used in adults for the management of moderate to severe melasma (dark spots on the skin) in association with sun-avoidance measures, like using sunscreens and wearing protective clothing. Melasma is one of the most frequently acquired hyperpigmentation (excess melanin production) disorders with symptoms such as symmetrical brown patches on sun exposed areas mainly on face.

It is advised to avoid exposure to sun during management with FUROSONE + CREAM for better results. While going out apply sunscreens and wear full covering protective clothes. Before using FUROSONE + CREAM inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung or heart diseases.

Safety and efficacy of FUROSONE + CREAM is not established in pregnant women and in children below 12 years of age. Ask for your doctor’s advice before using. FUROSONE + CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of using FUROSONE + CREAM are mild burning, stinging, redness and dryness. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.
uses: Manages moderate to severe melasma (dark spots on the skin)
usesDetails:
Uses Of FUROSONE + CREAM

It is used in adults to

Manages moderate to severe melasma (dark spots on the skin)
mechanismOfAction:
How FUROSONE + CREAM Works

FUROSONE + CREAM helps in managing melasma where Hydroquinone is a skin bleaching agent that blocks enzyme tyrosinase which is responsible for the production of melanin that cause pigmentation. Thus, it helps for fading of dark spots in skin. Tretinoin helps to recover the damage to the skin caused by sun exposure (photodamage) by thickening skin layer and loss of keratinized cells.it helps to rejuvenate the skin. Mometasone furoate blocks prostaglandin synthesis and reduces redness, swelling and itching caused by tretinoin and other skin infections.
usageDetails:
How to use FUROSONE + CREAM

Apply FUROSONE + CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before and after applying FUROSONE + CREAM. Wash your face with a mild soap and dry properly. Apply FUROSONE + CREAM at night and gently massage it in until it is absorbed. Avoid contact with your eyes, nose, mouth, mucous membrane. Avoid exposure to sunlight while using this medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ISOTINOIN 20 CAPSULE

ISOTINOIN 20 CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take ISOTINOIN 20 CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

ISOTINOIN 20 CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.
uses: Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)

Uses Of ISOTINOIN 20 CAPSULE
Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of ISOTINOIN 20 CAPSULE for Acne:

ISOTINOIN 20 CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How ISOTINOIN 20 CAPSULE Works

ISOTINOIN 20 CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose—do not double the dose to make up for it.

Human and animal studies have shown that isotretinoin is teratogenic in nature. Birth defects such as abnormalities of the face, eyes, ears, skull, central nervous system, cardiovascular system, and thymus and parathyroid glands or IQ less than score of 85 have been reported in female patients who were pregnant or became pregnant while on therapy with isotretinoin. Before using BENZONAK 2.5% LOTION, inform your doctor if you are having any allergy to foods, preservatives or dyes or if you are already under any medication for acne.

introduction:
Introduction About TETILIN 20MG CAPSULE

TETILIN 20MG CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take TETILIN 20MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

TETILIN 20MG CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.

Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age)
Benefits of TETILIN 20MG CAPSULE for Acne:

TETILIN 20MG CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How TETILIN 20MG CAPSULE Works

TETILIN 20MG CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

introduction:
Introduction About ROX ADP GEL

ROX ADP GEL is a combination of Adapalene and Benzoyl peroxide which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiacne agents. It is used in the management of acne.

Acne vulgaris (commonly known as acne) is an inflammatory skin condition that occurs when the hair follicles present in the skin are clogged with excess oil and/or dead skin cells. It can also be aggravated by few bacteria (such as Propionibacterium acnes) and is highly common among on the teenagers and the young adults.

It primarily affects the face, upper arms, trunk or back and is often characterized by pus-filled pimples, red bumps with inflammatory and non-inflammatory lesions. ROX ADP GEL is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 9 years or older).

Apply a thin layer of ROX ADP GEL on the affected skin areas. Avoid contact of this medicine with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose or with open wounds. You must also protect your skin against sun light and against other light sources (such as UV lamps).

Do not use ROX ADP GEL if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. ROX ADP GEL can be used in breastfeeding women if required. The most common side effects of using ROX ADP GEL are dry skin, mild burning sensation and skin irritation, redness or scaling. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How ROX ADP GEL Works

ROX ADP GEL is a combination of two medicines namely, adapalene and benzoyl peroxide.

Adapalene is a topical retinoid (a type of vitamin A). It modulates the skin cell cycle and manages the accumulation of excess sebum (natural oil produced by the skin) and dead skin cells on the hair follicles of the skin. It also reduces inflammation on the skin.

Benzoyl peroxide is a keratolytic agent with antimicrobial properties. It improves skin’s tendency to exfoliate the dead skin cells naturally. It also reduces the number of acne-causing bacteria on the skin which can reduce the further spread of acne.

Collectively, they unclog the hair follicles of the skin and exfoliates dead skin cells which reduces acne breakouts.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Avoid contact of ROX ADP GEL with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose, hair or with open wounds (cuts, scrapes or sunburn).

introduction:
Introduction About D ACNE I 10MG CAPSULE

D ACNE I 10MG CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take D ACNE I 10MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

D ACNE I 10MG CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.

Benefits of D ACNE I 10MG CAPSULE for Acne:

D ACNE I 10MG CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition.
mechanismOfAction:
How D ACNE I 10MG CAPSULE Works

D ACNE I 10MG CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions.

CONTRAINDICATED
Human and animal studies have shown that isotretinoin is teratogenic in nature. introduction:
Introduction About SAFERET 5MG TABLET

SAFERET 5MG TABLET contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back.

Take SAFERET 5MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice.

This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

SAFERET 5MG TABLET is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.

How SAFERET 5MG TABLET Works

Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort.

ZITVIN ISO CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness.
